claves: Continent that Wraps Around the World
entradas.resumen: The Red Line is a ring-shaped continent that encircles the entire planet. It divides the world’s seas and acts as a natural barrier across the globe.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Red Line is a ring-shaped continent that encircles the entire planet. It divides the world’s seas and acts as a natural barrier across the globe.

Overview
The Red Line separates:
- East Blue and South Blue
- North Blue and West Blue
- the two halves of the Grand Line (Paradise and the New World)

It is composed of red mineral earth and stretches continuously around the planet.

Structure
The Red Line is extremely tall and deep.

Key Properties
- extends high above sea level, making it nearly impossible to cross
- reaches deep below the ocean, connecting to Fish-Man Island
- functions as a connected chain of landmasses rather than a single uniform wall
- contains climate variations

Durability
The Red Line is considered indestructible. Even extremely powerful abilities are unable to break through it.

Crossing Points
There are only a few known methods to pass the Red Line.

1. Mary Geoise Route
Travelers may cross by passing through the Holy Land at the top.

Condition
- requires permission from the World Government
- ships cannot pass directly; a new vessel is needed afterward

2. Fish-Man Island Route
Ships can be coated and travel underwater through a passage beneath the Red Line.

Result
- connects Paradise to the New World through an underwater tunnel

Notable Locations

1. Mary Geoise
The capital of the World Government, located at the top intersection of the Red Line and Grand Line.

2. Red Port
Ports located at the base of the Red Line on both sides, featuring lifts that transport people to Mary Geoise.

3. Reverse Mountain
A unique mountain where water from the four Blues flows upward and into the Grand Line.

History
The Red Line was once known as the “Land of Gods,” inhabited by the Lunarian race.

entradas.resumen: Mary Geoise is the capital of the World Government, located atop the Red Line, where its highest authorities and the Celestial Dragons reside.
entradas.texto:
Mary Geoise is the capital of the World Government, located atop the Red Line, where its highest authorities and the Celestial Dragons reside.

Role
It serves as the political center of the world and hosts the Levely, a council of allied nations held every four years.

Location
- Positioned on top of the Red Line
- Opposite side of the world from Reverse Mountain
- Acts as an official crossing point between the Grand Line halves (restricted to lawful travel)

Access
- Legal access via Red Port using Bondolas (elevator-like transport)
- Unauthorized individuals must pass under the Red Line through Fish-Man Island

Geography
- Extremely elevated, surrounded by clouds and fog
- European-style architecture (18th–19th century influence)
- Contains artificial forests and waterways
- Travelators powered by slave labor move throughout the city

Structure
The city is built around a central intersection connecting:
- Pangaea Castle
- Domain of the Gods
- Red Ports (multiple directions via gated entrances)

Security
- Highly fortified and isolated
- Direct assaults are rare and historically significant
- Vulnerable to resource shortages due to reliance on imports

Key Locations

Pangaea Castle
- Central government seat and meeting place
- Location of the Levely
- Contains the Empty Throne (symbol of no singular ruler)
- Surrounded by defenses and guarded entrances

Domain of the Gods
- Residential area of the Celestial Dragons
- Composed of large estates and city structures
- Includes public structures and storage facilities

Celestial Dragon Gate
- Secured passage between Pangaea Castle and the Domain
- Restricted to World Nobles

Shangara
- Headquarters of the Knights of God
- Temple-centered complex with surrounding structures

Artifacts
- Houses a hidden national treasure with world-level significance (details unknown)

Citizens
Residents include:
- World Government leadership (Imu, Five Elders, Commander-in-Chief)
- Knights of God
- Celestial Dragons (ruling class)

Celestial Dragons
- Descendants of founding royal families
- Possess absolute privilege and authority
- Supported by enslaved individuals

claves: Official Route Across the Red Line
Legal Crossing of the Red Line
entradas.resumen: Red Port is a World Government-controlled transit hub used to legally cross the Red Line on the Grand Line.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Red Port is a World Government-controlled transit hub used to legally cross the Red Line on the Grand Line.

Role
It functions as the official passage point between the two halves of the Grand Line.

Access
- Requires World Government approval
- Travel involves a fee
- Travelers must abandon their ship and obtain a new one on the opposite side

Structure
- Two ports exist (one on each side of the Red Line)
- Located behind Marine strongholds

Locations
- Paradise Side: behind G-1 (former Marineford)
- New World Side: behind New Marineford

Transport System
Bondolas
- Large bubble-based lift vessels
- Transport people between Red Port and Mary Geoise
- Capable of carrying large groups and massive individuals

Layout
- Built on Yarukiman Mangrove (bubble-producing environment)
- Features floating bubbles similar to Sabaody Archipelago
- Contains docking areas and small structures (shops, facilities)

claves: One of the Entrances to the Grand Line
entradas.resumen: Reverse Mountain is a Red Line mountain that serves as one of the two known entrances to the Grand Line.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Reverse Mountain is a Red Line mountain that serves as one of the two known entrances to the Grand Line.

Role
It functions as a natural gateway where water from the four Blues converges and flows into Paradise.

Location
- Situated on the Red Line
- Opposite side of the world from Mary Geoise

Structure
- Composed of five rivers:
  - Four ascending rivers (one from each Blue Sea)
  - One descending river into the Grand Line

Flow System
- Ocean currents flow upward against gravity
- Rivers merge at the summit, then descend into Paradise

Access Route
- Ships must ride the upward currents to reach the summit
- Entry requires precise navigation due to extreme conditions

Hazards
- Violent currents and storms
- High risk of crashing into mountain walls
- Many inexperienced crews fail to reach the top

Environment
- Classified as a Winter Island
- Temperature differences influence current behavior

Key Location
Twin Cape
- Located at the base on the Grand Line side
- Marks the exit point into Paradise

entradas.resumen: Blue Sea is the primary ocean covering the world, containing nearly all landmasses except sky-based regions. Terminology
entradas.texto:
Blue Sea is the primary ocean covering the world, containing nearly all landmasses except sky-based regions.

Terminology
- The term “Blue Sea” is primarily used by inhabitants of the White Sea and White-White Sea

Structure
The Blue Sea is divided by the Red Line and Calm Belts into five major regions:

Regions
- North Blue
- South Blue
- East Blue
- West Blue
- Grand Line

Grand Line
- Enclosed by Calm Belts
- Split by the Red Line into:
  - Paradise (first half)
  - New World (second half)

Barriers
- Red Line: separates seas vertically
- Calm Belts: restrict movement between regions

World Control
- World Government governs ~170 nations across the Blue Sea
- Revolutionary Army opposes and controls select territories
- Four Emperors dominate the New World

History
- Sea level was ~200 meters lower over 800–1000 years ago
- Void Century war caused massive sea level rise, submerging continents
- Resulted in formation of modern islands and loss of ancient civilizations

Current Changes
- Sea levels have begun rising again (e.g., post-Lulusia event)
- Future projections indicate continued global flooding

Environment
- Vast global ocean with scattered islands
- Underwater ruins exist from submerged ancient civilizations

- Known for advanced technology and military development

claves: Sea that Wraps Around the World
entradas.resumen: The Grand Line is a global ocean route enclosed by the Calm Belts and divided by the Red Line.
entradas.texto:
The Grand Line is a global ocean route enclosed by the Calm Belts and divided by the Red Line.

Role
- Primary route for circumnavigating the world
- Central region of major power activity and events

Structure
- Surrounded north and south by the Calm Belt
- Split into two halves by the Red Line

Halves

Paradise
- First half of the Grand Line
- Extends from Reverse Mountain to the Red Line midpoint
- Considered less dangerous compared to the New World

New World
- Second half of the Grand Line
- Begins beyond the Red Line midpoint
- Dominated by the strongest forces (e.g., major pirate powers, Marines)

Reputation
- Known as the "Pirate's Graveyard"
- Home to the world’s strongest individuals and factions

Environment

Climate
- Extremely unstable and unpredictable
- Rapid shifts (storms, heat, blizzards, fog)
- Caused by conflicting island climates and magnetic fields

Islands
- Each island has a fixed climate type
- Creates 16 seasonal variations overall
- Cultures and technology vary drastically between islands

Navigation

Log Pose
- Required due to unique magnetic fields per island
- Locks onto one island at a time and resets after arrival

New World Log Pose
- Uses three needles for multiple route options
- Accounts for unstable magnetism

Eternal Pose
- Permanently locked to a specific island
- Used for direct travel

Routes
- Multiple starting paths from Reverse Mountain
- Routes eventually converge, then split again in the New World
- Final known destination via standard navigation is Lodestar Island

Restrictions

Calm Belt
- Borders the Grand Line on both sides
- No wind or currents → standard sailing impossible
- Inhabited by Sea Kings, making passage highly dangerous

entradas.resumen: Paradise is the first half of the Grand Line, named by those who survived the New World due to its comparatively lower difficulty.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Paradise is the first half of the Grand Line, named by those who survived the New World due to its comparatively lower difficulty.

Location
- Lies between the East Blue and South Blue
- Extends from Reverse Mountain (Twin Cape) to Mary Geoise

Role
It serves as the initial stage of Grand Line navigation and progression for pirates and crews.

Navigation
- Uses Log Pose for island tracking
- Entry begins at Reverse Mountain
- Travelers choose between seven distinct routes

Routes
- Seven starting paths, each leading through different island chains
- All routes converge at Sabaody Archipelago
- Routes vary in environment but are equal in overall difficulty

Environment
- Highly unstable weather and sea conditions
- Magnetic interference between islands causes erratic climate shifts
- Conditions are most chaotic near the entry point

Progression
- Difficulty increases with distance traveled
- Each island presents unique environmental and survival challenges

Outcome
- Only a small number of crews successfully reach Sabaody Archipelago
- Often described as a survival filter for entering the New World

claves: Far Side of the Grand Line
entradas.resumen: The New World is the second half of the Grand Line and the most dangerous region of the sea.
entradas.texto:
The New World is the second half of the Grand Line and the most dangerous region of the sea.

Location
- Extends from Mary Geoise to the opposite side of Reverse Mountain
- Positioned between North Blue and West Blue

Role
- Main stage of the New Era
- Domain of the strongest pirates, including the Four Emperors
- Final route toward Laugh Tale and the Pirate King title

Navigation
- Requires a New World Log Pose due to unstable magnetic fields
- Erratic needle movement indicates dangerous or abnormal islands

Environment
- Extremely volatile and unpredictable conditions
- Weather and phenomena often defy natural laws

Power Structure

Four Emperors (Yonko)
- Dominant ruling forces of the New World
- Control large territories across multiple islands

Territories
- Islands claimed by powerful forces (primarily Emperors)
- Provide protection or exploitation depending on the ruler
- Not all islands are controlled (some belong to Marines or independent powers)

Key Elements
- Marine Headquarters relocated here to counter the Emperors
- Contains major locations, including Laugh Tale
- Only Gol D. Roger and his crew are known to have fully explored it

Risk Level
- Considered far more dangerous than the first half ("Paradise")
- Even powerful individuals risk total loss or defeat

entradas.resumen: Island Climatic Types are the fixed seasonal environments of Grand Line islands, where each island maintains a dominant climate year-round. (Only Grand Line Islands).
entradas.texto:
Island Climatic Types are the fixed seasonal environments of Grand Line islands, where each island maintains a dominant climate year-round. (Only Grand Line Islands).

Types
- Winter Island — cold climate, frequent snow
- Spring Island — mild climate, abundant plant life
- Summer Island — hot, dry climate
- Autumn Island — temperate climate with falling foliage

Core Rule
Each island remains in a constant seasonal state regardless of the global season.

Environmental Effect
- Surrounding seas reflect the island’s climate
- Nearby waters stabilize when approaching an island
- Intersections between climates cause extreme, unstable weather

Grand Line Behavior
- Weather between islands is chaotic due to conflicting climate zones
- Early Grand Line seas are especially unstable due to overlapping influences

New World Variation
- Climate effects are more intense and unpredictable
- Magnetic fields may destabilize or disappear
- Standard Log Pose navigation becomes unreliable

entradas.resumen: A map is a visual representation of locations and geography used for navigation and spatial reference.
entradas.texto:
A map is a visual representation of locations and geography used for navigation and spatial reference.

Role
Maps are used to guide movement, identify locations, and plan routes across land or sea.

Usage
- Navigation across islands, seas, and regions
- Route planning and hazard avoidance
- Locating specific destinations or landmarks

Types
- Island Maps
- Regional Maps
- World Maps (rare/incomplete)
- Sea Charts (ocean navigation)

Navigation
Maps are typically read and interpreted by navigators to ensure safe travel and prevent disorientation.

Treasure Maps
- Mark hidden locations (commonly with an “X”)
- Used to locate stored valuables or objectives

World Mapping
A complete world map does not currently exist, making full global navigation incomplete.

Cartography
Cartography is the practice of creating maps.

Function
- Converts geographic data into usable visual form
- Essential for accurate navigation and exploration

Skill Level
- Skilled cartographers produce precise, readable maps
- Unskilled maps may only provide rough orientation

Importance
- Critical for long-distance travel and ocean navigation
- Required to reach specific locations using coordinate-based systems

Example Use
- Mapping coordinates to locate destinations such as hidden or unknown locations

entradas.resumen: Clouds are masses of condensed water vapor that float in the sky and form a core part of weather systems.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Clouds are masses of condensed water vapor that float in the sky and form a core part of weather systems.

Nature
- Exist in many natural and abnormal forms depending on composition and environment
- Some possess unique physical properties beyond standard clouds

Types

Imperial Cumulus
- Massive, ancient cloud formation near Jaya
- Extremely dense; blocks sunlight and darkens areas below
- Does not produce rain or follow normal atmospheric behavior
- Supports sky environments (Sea Clouds, Island Clouds, Skypiea)

Sea Clouds
- Water-like clouds forming seas in the sky
- Less dense than water; objects sink faster
- No sea floor, but affect Devil Fruit users like real seas
- Formed from pyrobloin (Seastone) reacting with water vapor
- Normally cannot exist at Blue Sea level

Milky Road
- Artificial Sea Clouds shaped into aerial rivers

Island Clouds
- Dense clouds capable of supporting land and structures
- Form sky islands
- Created similarly to Sea Clouds (pyrobloin + vapor)
- Density determines formation type

Ball Clouds
- Spherical clouds used as platforms or traps

String Clouds
- Thin, nearly invisible clouds with high tensile strength
- Used for binding or trapping

Swamp Clouds
- Cloud mass with swamp-like properties
- Causes sinking and drowning due to lack of air

Iron Clouds
- Highly durable clouds with metallic strength
- Retain flexibility and shape manipulation

Sugar Clouds
- Produce cotton candy-like snowfall
- Found near Totto Land regions

entradas.resumen: The Calm Belts are two ocean regions bordering the north and south of the Grand Line.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Calm Belts are two ocean regions bordering the north and south of the Grand Line.

Role
They act as natural barriers preventing entry and exit from the Grand Line.

Environment
- No wind or ocean currents
- Ships without propulsion cannot move

Dangers
- Nesting grounds of massive Sea Kings
- Sea Kings attack any ship attempting to cross

Navigation

Standard Route
- Reverse Mountain is the primary method to enter or exit the Grand Line

Marine Method
- Ships use Seastone lining to avoid detection by Sea Kings
- Method is not completely reliable

Locations

Islands
- Scattered, highly dangerous

Known Locations
- Amazon Lily (inhabited, Kuja tribe)
- Rusukaina (natural island)
- Impel Down (underwater prison)

Security
- Natural protection from isolation and Sea Kings
- Impel Down is reinforced with extreme security, making escape nearly impossible

entradas.resumen: Florian Triangle is a fog-covered sea region in Paradise known for frequent ship disappearances.
entradas.texto:
Florian Triangle is a fog-covered sea region in Paradise known for frequent ship disappearances.

Role
It is a required route between Water 7 and Fish-Man Island.

Characteristics
- Covered in extremely dense fog that blocks sunlight
- Visibility is severely limited; time of day is indistinguishable

Phenomena
- Over 100 ships disappear annually
- Ships are often found later without crews
- Activity predates known human interference

Unknown Entities
- Massive unidentified beings inhabit the area
- Large enough to dwarf island-sized ships
- Possess glowing red eyes
- Capable of remaining concealed within the fog

Threat Factors
- Natural hazard (fog, disorientation)

Historical Activity

Thriller Bark Presence
- Gecko Moria established Thriller Bark within the region
- Targeted passing ships to steal shadows
- Used traffic flow to sustain operations

Pre-Moria Activity
- Disappearances occurred long before Thriller Bark
- Indicates independent underlying cause

entradas.resumen: All Blue is a legendary sea where the North, South, East, and West Blues are said to converge. Status
entradas.texto:
Definition
All Blue is a legendary sea where the North, South, East, and West Blues are said to converge.

Status
- Unconfirmed location
- Widely considered a myth

Location Theory
- Believed to exist somewhere in the Grand Line

Characteristics
- Contains marine life from all four seas
- Provides unmatched diversity of fish and ingredients

Cultural Significance
- Considered the ultimate destination for chefs
- Represents the ideal source of all culinary resources

Belief
- Known among chefs but often dismissed as a legend
- Supported by rare anomalies in ocean currents and species distribution

Narrative Role
- Central dream of Sanji
- Pursued by Zeff in the past and passed on to Sanji

entradas.texto:
Definition
Hot-Hot Sea is a region of ocean in the New World where extreme heat causes the sea to boil.

Characteristics
- Ocean temperature is high enough to produce constant boiling
- Creates a hazardous marine environment

Location
- New World

Native Animals
- Armored Stonefish
- Flamingo Salmon (non-canon)

entradas.resumen: Edd War is a historical sea in the New World where the Roger Pirates and Golden Lion Pirates clashed 27 years ago. Region
entradas.texto:
Definition
Edd War is a historical sea in the New World where the Roger Pirates and Golden Lion Pirates clashed 27 years ago.

Region
- New World

Event

1. Encounter
- Shiki approached Gol D. Roger after learning he possessed knowledge of an ancient weapon
- Offered alliance to conquer the world

2. Conflict
- Roger refused, prioritizing freedom over conquest
- Battle initiated between both crews

3. Outcome
- Roger Pirates fought against a vastly larger fleet
- A sudden hurricane destroyed half of Shiki’s fleet
- Shiki was injured (wheel lodged in head)
- Golden Lion Pirates retreated
- Roger gained Shiki’s respect

entradas.resumen: The Sea Floor is the bottom region of the ocean, characterized by extreme pressure and low oxygen conditions.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Sea Floor is the bottom region of the ocean, characterized by extreme pressure and low oxygen conditions.

Nature
- Exists beneath the ocean surface under harsh environmental conditions
- Despite this, multiple settlements and locations are present

Cultural Reference
- Known in pirate folklore as “Davy Jones’ Locker”
- Associated with the legendary pirate Davy Jones

Known Locations
- Fish-Man Island
- Goldfish Empire
- Headband Catfish Village
- Underworld of the Sea
- Sea Forest

entradas.resumen: Dawn Island is an island in the East Blue that contains the Goa Kingdom.
entradas.texto:
Dawn Island is an island in the East Blue that contains the Goa Kingdom.

Role
It serves as the origin point of Monkey D. Luffy and several key figures, and marks the beginning of his journey.

Region
- East Blue

Affiliation
- Goa Kingdom

Geography
- Island largely composed of rural land and farmland
- Goa Kingdom spans most of the island
- Capital city is surrounded by forested mountains

Key Locations

Foosha Village
- Rural village and Luffy’s birthplace
- Starting point of his pirate journey

Mt. Colubo
- Forested mountain inhabited by bandits
- Training ground for Luffy, Ace, and Sabo

Midway Forest
- Forest area between major regions

Gray Terminal
- Junkyard settlement with crime and poverty
- Located near Mt. Colubo

Pirate’s Bay
- Cove previously used by pirates

Goa Kingdom (Capital Region)
- Central governing area of the island

Sub-Locations
- Capital City
- High Town (nobility district)
- Edge Town
- Town Center
- Royal Palace
- Great Gate (connects regions)

Inhabitants
- Primarily civilians of Goa Kingdom
- Includes nobles, villagers, and outlaws (bandits)

Wildlife
- Standard livestock in villages
- Dangerous wildlife in Mt. Colubo (large predators)

entradas.resumen: Shells Town is a town located in the Yotsuba Island Region of East Blue. Region
entradas.texto:
Definition
Shells Town is a town located in the Yotsuba Island Region of East Blue.

Region
- East Blue
- Yotsuba Island Region

Characteristics
- Skyline of tower structures resembling power plants

Food Foo

entradas.resumen: Baratie is an ocean-going restaurant ship located in the East Blue, operated by Zeff and his crew.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Baratie is an ocean-going restaurant ship located in the East Blue, operated by Zeff and his crew.

Role
It serves as a mobile restaurant and combat-capable vessel, catering to travelers and defending itself from threats.

Location
- East Blue (Sambas Region)
- Near the entrance to the Grand Line (Paradise side)

Structure
- Large oval-shaped ship with a fish-head prow
- Multi-level design:

Levels
- Lower Deck: main restaurant
- Middle Deck: primary kitchen
- Upper Deck: living quarters for cooks

Features
- Side cannons for defense
- Expandable fins for stabilization and combat platforms
- Detachable fish-head unit (Sabagashira I) equipped with cannons

Support Vessels
- Includes smaller boats for supply and transport

Post-Timeskip Changes
- Expanded size and structure
- Additional floors added
- Accompanied by sister ships

Staff

Leadership
- Zeff: owner and head chef

Composition
- Staff consists mainly of outcasts, former pirates, and rejected cooks

Combat Style
- Chefs are trained fighters
- Primarily use kitchen tools (knives, forks) as weapons
- Defend the restaurant from hostile customers and pirates

entradas.resumen: Conomi Islands are an archipelago located in the northwestern region of the East Blue.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Conomi Islands are an archipelago located in the northwestern region of the East Blue.

Role
Primarily agricultural islands consisting of multiple small communities.

Structure
- Contains 20+ settlements
- Known for rice fields and orange plantations

Governance
- Under jurisdiction of Marine Branch 16
- Other branches (e.g., 77) may operate when needed

Notable Areas
- Cocoyasi Village: central settlement and Nami’s home
- Arlong Park: former base of the Arlong Pirates

History
The islands were originally peaceful until the Arlong Pirates occupied the region.

Arlong Rule
- Imposed monthly tribute:
  - 100,000 Beli per adult
  - 50,000 Beli per child
- Non-payment resulted in violence or destruction of settlements

entradas.resumen: Ohara is an island in West Blue known as a center of archaeology and historical research.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Ohara is an island in West Blue known as a center of archaeology and historical research.

Role
It functioned as a global hub for scholars studying ancient history and forbidden knowledge.

Identity
- Primarily inhabited by archaeologists
- Birthplace of Nico Robin

Geography
- Located in West Blue
- Featured a central settlement surrounded by natural terrain

Key Feature

Tree of Knowledge

- Contained extensive historical records and research

Layout

Society

Significance

entradas.resumen: Ilisia Kingdom is a World Government-affiliated nation located in the West Blue. Status
entradas.texto:
Definition

entradas.resumen: Impel Down is the World Government’s maximum-security prison for the most dangerous criminals, located underwater in the Calm Belt and connected to the Tarai Current.
entradas.texto:
Impel Down is the World Government’s maximum-security prison for the most dangerous criminals, located underwater in the Calm Belt and connected to the Tarai Current.

Role
It functions as one of the Government’s main strongholds and serves as a prison built to confine, break, and isolate high-level offenders.

Affiliation
- World Government
- Marines

Location
- Underwater in the Calm Belt
- Part of the Tarai Current
- Protected by Sea Kings and Marine warships

Structure
- Massive submerged prison tower reaching the seabed
- Built with Seastone cells to suppress Devil Fruit users
- Contains cells, torture chambers, surveillance systems, medical facilities, and prison control rooms

Security
- Surrounded by Sea Kings
- Guarded by Marine forces
- Uses Seastone restraints and prison architecture to prevent escape
- Considered nearly impossible to infiltrate or escape

Monitoring
- Surveillance Den Den Mushi monitor activity throughout the prison
- Feeds are sent to a central monitor room

Internal Facilities
- Medical laboratory for emergency treatment
- Generator room connected to prison functions and the Gates of Justice controls

Level System
Prisoners are assigned by danger level, strength, and criminal severity. Lower levels hold more dangerous inmates.

Level 1: Crimson Hell
- Entry-level prison floor
- Filled with blade-like trees and needle grass
- Prisoners are driven through the environment as torture

Level 2: Wild Beast Hell
- Contains violent beasts used to hunt prisoners
- Designed around fear, pursuit, and animal-based punishment

Level 3: Starvation Hell
- Desert-like level with extreme heat and severe deprivation
- Prisoners are kept in near-death condition through limited food and water

Level 4: Blazing Hell
- Extreme heat zone centered around boiling blood and fire
- Used for severe physical torture and forced labor
- Contains Magellan’s office and prison kitchen

Level 5: Freezing Hell
- Extreme cold zone for higher-level prisoners
- Causes freezing, frostbite, and sensory isolation
- Also inhabited by wolves

Level 5.5: Newkama Land
- Hidden secret sublevel between Levels 5 and 6
- Refuge created by escaped or disappeared prisoners
- Operates as an underground society outside official prison control

Level 6: Eternal Hell
- Lowest and most secret level
- Holds the most dangerous, infamous, or politically threatening prisoners
- Prisoners here are effectively erased from public history
- Used mainly for permanent confinement or execution holding

Entry Process
Arrival
Prisoners entering Impel Down are typically transported through the Tarai Current using Seastone-lined Marine ships.

Sterilization
- Prisoners are subjected to a boiling-water disinfection process

Clothing
- Standard prisoners are changed into prison uniforms
- Some special prisoners retain certain items or original clothing

Assignment
- Prisoners are placed into levels based on danger, crimes, and overall threat

Visits
- Government personnel and authorized individuals may enter with approval
- Unauthorized entry is treated as intrusion
- Even approved outsiders may be searched and restrained

Exit Conditions
Most prisoners do not leave alive.

Exceptions
- transfer for execution
- temporary imprisonment
- official release
- escape

Reputation
Impel Down is regarded as an inescapable hell-fortress, infamous for its brutality, layered defenses, and history of near-impossible breakouts.

entradas.texto:
Definition
Sabaody Archipelago is a massive mangrove forest at sea that serves as the final island in Paradise before the New World.

Role
It functions as the primary staging and preparation point for crossing the Red Line.

Location
- Positioned near the Red Line
- Located at the only crossing point between Paradise and the New World

Structure
- Composed of 79 Yarukiman Mangrove trees
- Each tree (grove) functions as an individual island
- Connected by bridges across roots

Navigation
- Does not produce magnetic signals
- Cannot be tracked by Log Pose

Environment
- Mangrove-based ecosystem producing natural bubbles
- Bubble properties influence transportation, structures, and tools

Layout
- Divided into numbered groves (GR system)
- Different groves serve different functions (residential, commercial, lawless zones)

Connectivity
- Directly linked to:
  - Red Port (surface crossing via Mary Geoise)
  - Fish-Man Island (submerged crossing route)

Functionality

1. Transit Preparation
- Primary location for ship coating required for underwater travel
- Used by travelers preparing to enter the New World

2. Trade and Activity Hub
- High traffic area due to strategic location
- Supports commerce, services, and black-market activity

Control and Stability
- Presence of Marine forces (limited enforcement range)
- Law enforcement weakens further from controlled groves
- Overall stability fluctuates due to traffic and location

Societal Conditions
- Influenced by proximity to Mary Geoise
- Supports illegal systems such as slave trade and trafficking

Technology
- Bubble-based systems used for:
  - transportation (e.g., bubble vehicles)
  - infrastructure
  - entertainment and lodging

entradas.resumen: Marineford is the former headquarters island of the Marines, serving as the central base of operations for Marine Headquarters.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Marineford is the former headquarters island of the Marines, serving as the central base of operations for Marine Headquarters.

Role
It functions as the primary military command center of the Marines, housing leadership, forces, and operational infrastructure.

Location
- Located in Paradise
- Positioned near Sabaody Archipelago
- Adjacent to Mary Geoise on the Red Line

Access
- Primary access controlled through the Gates of Justice
- Highly restricted and fortified entry system

Structure
- Crescent-shaped island constructed of brick and steel
- Perimeter lined with cannons for coastal defense

Central Facility

Marine Headquarters
- Main command building of the Marines
- Multi-story structure with traditional architectural influence
- Serves as residence and operations center for high-ranking officers

Defense System

Encircling Wall
- Massive retractable steel walls surrounding the bay
- Emerges from the sea to trap and contain targets
- Equipped with mounted cannons for bombardment

Key Areas

Marineford Bay
- Central harbor area
- Enclosed by the Encircling Wall system

Marineford Town
- Large residential district
- Inhabited primarily by Marine personnel families

Oris Plaza
- Central open area of the island
- Contains the execution platform
- Acts as a primary gathering and operational space

entradas.resumen: Karakuri Island is a winter island in Paradise known for housing the technologically advanced Future Country Baldimore.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Karakuri Island is a winter island in Paradise known for housing the technologically advanced Future Country Baldimore.

Role
It serves as a major center of advanced science and engineering, recognized as the origin point of high-level mechanical technology.

Affiliation
- World Government (indirect through research and facilities)

Location
- Grand Line (Paradise)
- Classified as a Winter Island

Key Region

Baldimore (Future Country)
- Primary settlement on the island
- Specializes in advanced technology, including cyborgs and automation
- Known as the birthplace of Vegapunk

Technology
- Mechanical engineering
- Cyborg development
- Automated systems (automata)

Key Figures
- Vegapunk (origin)
- Dr. Tsukimi (automata creator)

Infrastructure

Laboratories
- Vegapunk’s research facilities (multiple rooms and secured areas)

Marine Presence
- Local Marine base stationed on the island

entradas.resumen: Momoiro Island is a Paradise island and the location of the Kamabakka Kingdom, associated with the Revolutionary Army.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Momoiro Island is a Paradise island and the location of the Kamabakka Kingdom, associated with the Revolutionary Army.

Location
- Located in Paradise
- Near Lulusia Kingdom

Environment
- Dominated by pink flora and fauna
- Even wildlife reflects the island’s cultural traits

Kingdom
Kamabakka Kingdom
- Inhabited by individuals with “a heart of a maiden”
- Population consists primarily of okama (gender-nonconforming individuals)
- Society is unified by shared identity and lifestyle

Leadership
- Ruled by Emporio Ivankov

Affiliation
- Strong ties to the Revolutionary Army

Culture

Combat Capability
- Inhabitants are skilled fighters

Enhancement
- Known for Attack Cuisine, which boosts physical ability

entradas.resumen: Boin Archipelago is a group of flower-shaped islands in Paradise composed of giant carnivorous plants.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Boin Archipelago is a group of flower-shaped islands in Paradise composed of giant carnivorous plants.

Nature
- Islands are living organisms called "Stomach Baron"
- Function as massive plant predators that consume large prey

Geography
- Covered in dense, food-based environments
- Includes areas like the Forest of Gluttony

Forest of Gluttony
- Contains edible terrain (fruit, crops, prepared food)
- Inhabited by giant insects and man-eating plants
- Becomes more dangerous deeper within

Ecosystem
- Home to Pop Greens, specialized plant species
- Variety increases toward inner regions
- Outer areas guarded by giant beetles

Danger
- High entrapment risk; escape becomes harder deeper inside
- Known for consuming those who cannot escape

entradas.resumen: Namakura Island is a Grand Line island located in the Paradise region. Region
entradas.texto:

entradas.texto:

G-1 is a Marine base currently located in Paradise at the former site of Marine Headquarters (Marineford).

- Marines

entradas.resumen: Kenzan Island is an island in Paradise that serves as the location of the Tehna Gehna Kingdom (Longarm Kingdom). Region
entradas.texto:

entradas.resumen: Hachinosu is a New World island known as a pirate stronghold and “Pirate Paradise,” operating outside standard world law.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Hachinosu is a New World island known as a pirate stronghold and “Pirate Paradise,” operating outside standard world law.

Role
It serves as a central hub for pirate activity, gatherings, and operations.

Reputation
- Known as a haven for pirates
- Associated with the origin of the Davy Back Fight
- Historically linked to major pirate organizations

Affiliation
- Controlled by pirate forces (no formal World Government authority)

Geography
- Medium-sized island with dark rock foundation
- Dominated by a massive skull-shaped rock formation at its center
- Surrounded by a dense cluster of buildings and large palm trees

Structure

Central Skull Fortress
- Giant skull-shaped structure overlooking the island
- Interior carved into a fortress-like base
- Features large openings (eyes, nose) used as windows and access points

City Layout
- Surrounding settlement of tightly packed buildings
- Structures are simple, block-like, and utilitarian
- Functions as the main living and activity zone

Notable Features
- Contains underground resources (including gold deposits)
- Houses a Poneglyph somewhere on the island

Environment
- Chaotic, lawless atmosphere
- Designed around pirate lifestyle and activity rather than order or governance

entradas.resumen: Wano Country is an isolated, independent nation in the New World, unaffiliated with the World Government. Status
entradas.texto:
Definition
Wano Country is an isolated, independent nation in the New World, unaffiliated with the World Government.

Status
- Located in the New World
- Naturally fortified and difficult to access
- Historically known as the Country of Gold

Government
- Ruled by the Kouzuki shogunate
- Structured under a central shogun and regional daimyo

Major Families
- Kouzuki Family — shogunate
- Shimotsuki Family
- Kurozumi Family
- Uzuki Family
- Amatsuki Family
- Fugetsu Family

Isolationism
A closed-country policy restricting foreign contact and citizen movement.

Effects
- Outsiders treated as intruders
- Minimal foreign influence
- Independent cultural development

Currency
Uses independent coinage instead of Belly.
- Silver
- Gold
- Platinum

Craftsmanship
Renowned for advanced metallurgy and production.
- Legendary swordsmithing
- High-grade blades
- Seastone processing
- Poneglyph creation (Kouzuki lineage)

Military
Samurai serve as the primary military force.
- Highly skilled swordsmen
- Feared by external powers
- Elevated social status

Justice
Strict legal system with enforced order.
- Punishment regardless of status
- Seppuku recognized
- Law upheld through class authority

Culture
Traditional, isolation-shaped society.
- Honor and dignity emphasized
- Bushido influence
- Unique speech, naming, fashion
- Chonmage as status symbol

Beliefs
Independent interpretations due to isolation.
- Devil Fruits seen as sorcery
- Armament Haki known as Ryuo
- Foreign concepts viewed through folklore

Literacy
Strong literary tradition.
- Historically high literacy
- Traditional writing systems
- Kouzuki preserve Poneglyph knowledge

Funerary Customs
Formal burial traditions.
- Processions and cremation
- Marked graves
- Family graveyards
- Burial of personal items

Fire Festival
Annual event honoring the dead and offering prayers.

Geography
Highly fortified and regionally diverse.
- Surrounded by walls and waterfalls
- Divided by rivers
- Hazardous surrounding waters

Access
Extremely limited entry points.
- Waterfall ascent
- Hidden internal routes

Climate
Region-dependent climates.
- Spring-like
- Autumn-like
- Snow regions

Wildlife
Region-specific fauna.
- Giant koi, octopus
- Komainu, baboons, boars, tigers
- Tanishi communication snails

Resources
Abundant natural and crafted materials.
- Precious metals
- Seastone
- Timber, fertile land

Regions

Key Regions

Flower Capital
- Political and cultural center

Kuri
- Former frontier region

Kibi
- Established settlements

Udon
- Internal industrial importance

Hakumai
- Port and transport region

Ringo
- Cold region, burial sites

Onigashima
- External island territory

Ancient Wano
Formerly at sea level before geological elevation.

Legacy
- Submerged ruins remain
- Pluton located beneath
- Isolation tied to historical purpose

entradas.resumen: The Flower Capital is the central city of Wano Country and the seat of the shogun’s rule.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Flower Capital is the central city of Wano Country and the seat of the shogun’s rule.

Role
It functions as Wano’s political, cultural, and economic center.

Governance
- Currently ruled by Kouzuki Momonosuke
- Formerly controlled by Kurozumi Orochi

Conditions (Past)
- Only prosperous region during Orochi’s rule
- Strict wealth-based law: citizens without money were exiled
- Crime persisted despite prosperity (corruption, theft, violence)

Structure
- Divided into multiple districts covering various streets

Red-Light District
- Area for commercial services and exploitation

Rasetsu Town
- Detention zone for prisoners opposing the shogun
- Contains a public prison used for punishment display

Landmarks

Shogun Castle
- Central residence of the shogun
- Houses a Road Poneglyph in a hidden basement chamber

School
- Used to spread state-controlled historical propaganda

Bath House
- Public gathering location
- Common site for information exchange

Soba Stands
- Food vendors located throughout districts

Sakyo
- Area behind the castle containing key structures

Pawn Shop / Longhouses

Outside the City

Mt. Fuji
- Located southwest of the capital
- Contains access to the Road Poneglyph

Dock
- External port area for travel

Shrine
- Memorial site honoring Kouzuki Oden and allies

Ebisu Town
- Nearby impoverished settlement

entradas.resumen: Kuri is a region of Wano Country known for its rugged terrain, settlements, and coastal access.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Kuri is a region of Wano Country known for its rugged terrain, settlements, and coastal access.

Role
It functions as a major regional district containing residential areas, ports, and resource zones within Wano.

Environment
- Mix of wilderness, forests, and coastal land
- Includes mountains, rivers, and open terrain
- Supports wildlife and natural resources

Kuri is divided into towns, landmarks, and natural areas.

Towns

Amigasa Village

- Features nearby river access
- Houses built from bamboo in traditional styles

Okobore Town

Bakura Town

Kuri Beach

Paradise Farm

Mt. Atama

Graveyard
- Designated burial site within the region

Itachi Port

- Used for ship docking, storage, and transport

entradas.resumen: G-5 is a Marine branch base located in the New World near the Red Line. Affiliation

entradas.resumen: Laugh Tale is the final island of the New World and the location of the One Piece.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Laugh Tale is the final island of the New World and the location of the One Piece.

Role
It represents the endpoint of the Grand Line and the ultimate destination for those seeking the One Piece.

Discovery
- Reached and named by Gol D. Roger
- Named after discovering Joy Boy’s treasure

Access

- Standard navigation paths end at Lodestar Island

True Navigation

Road Poneglyphs
- Four special red Poneglyphs each reveal a location
- The intersection of all four points determines Laugh Tale’s position

Requirement

- Covered in dense wilderness
- Contains possible structures or ruins

- Prevents discovery of Laugh Tale and its contents

entradas.resumen: Totto Land is a large archipelago in the New World that functions as a unified nation and territorial domain of a Yonko crew.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Totto Land is a large archipelago in the New World that functions as a unified nation and territorial domain of a Yonko crew.

Role
It operates as a centralized regime controlling multiple islands under a single authority, designed as a multi-racial society.

Structure
- Composed of 35 islands (central island + 34 subsidiary islands)
- Arranged in concentric formation around the central island
- Each island is governed by an assigned minister

Central Island
Whole Cake Island serves as the political and operational center of the territory.

Island System
- Islands are themed by food types
- Towns and regions correspond to specific ingredients or categories
- Some environments include liquid-based ecosystems (e.g., juice rivers forming seas)

Environment
- Unique weather phenomena (e.g., edible snowfall)
- Artificially modified terrain and ecosystems
- Navigable using New World Log Pose

Defense System

Tartes
- Coastal defense ships shaped like confectionery tarts
- Form the primary naval defense network
- Automatically engage unauthorized vessels

Surveillance
- Sea-based creatures relay alerts across the territory
- Integrated with communication systems for rapid response

Population
- Inhabited by multiple races and hybrid species
- Includes sentient constructs (Homies)
- Designed as a unified multi-species society

Restrictions
- Certain races are absent or extremely limited
- Population composition is controlled and curated

Governance
- Central authority holds absolute control
- Islands are managed through a ministerial system
- Highly structured and bureaucratic administration

Law
- Citizens must pay a periodic life-based tax
- Non-compliance results in removal from the territory

Military Forces

Chess Soldiers
- Standard infantry units
- Organized by rank (Pawn → King hierarchy)
- Used for patrol, enforcement, and defense

Biscuit Soldiers
- Specialized constructed units
- Durable, large-scale combat forces
- Used primarily for island-level security

entradas.resumen: Whole Cake Island is the central island of Totto Land and the primary base of operations within the archipelago.

Whole Cake Island is the central island of Totto Land and the primary base of operations within the archipelago.

Role
- Core hub of Totto Land
- Central authority and residential island

Location
- New World
- Center of the Totto Land archipelago

- Built over with massive cake-like structures

Structure

Sweet City

- Structures made from edible materials (candy, biscuits, sweets)
- Contains living structures and terrain
- Includes a flowing juice-based river system

Whole Cake Chateau

- Multi-layered castle resembling a cake
- Central landmark dominating the island’s layout

Seducing Woods

- Includes juice rivers and waterfalls

Lake Aprico

Northeastern Coast

Infrastructure
- Pathways connect major locations across the island
- Ports and coastal access points support sea travel

Population
- Inhabited by a highly diverse mix of races
- Includes sentient animals and animated objects
- Living entities are often food-based or anthropomorphic

Living System
- Many objects and environments are animated and capable of interaction

entradas.resumen: Punk Hazard is a World Government-controlled island in the New World used as a large-scale research and testing facility.

entradas.resumen: Dressrosa is a kingdom island in the New World and one of the Twenty Kingdoms that founded the World Government. Title
entradas.texto:
Definition
Dressrosa is a kingdom island in the New World and one of the Twenty Kingdoms that founded the World Government.

Title
- Land of Love and Passion

Affiliation
- World Government (Riku Family)

Geography
- Located in the New World
- Surrounded by large rock formations with harbors between them
- Connected to nearby islands via proximity and sea routes

Environment
- Known for flower fields, cuisine, and vibrant culture
- Belief in “fairies” exists among residents

Architecture
- Spanish-inspired design
- Colorful, ornate buildings with patterned roofs
- Mix of urban towns and elevated royal structures

Structure
The island is organized around a central elevated formation:

King’s Plateau
- Massive central structure supporting the Royal Palace
- Acts as the island’s highest point

Major Regions
- Port towns distributed around the island
- Central plateau zone
- Underground network beneath the island

Cities
- Acacia (port town, primary harbor)
- Sebio (southern town)
- Primula (northwestern town)
- Carta (eastern town, forest-based)
- Balsa (northern region)

Key Landmarks

Corrida Colosseum
- Large arena for combat-based entertainment
- One of the island’s main attractions

Flower Hill
- Central elevated area covered in flowers
- Located near the King’s Plateau

Royal Palace
- Main governing structure of the kingdom
- Positioned atop the King’s Plateau

Toys House
- Access structure located at the base of the plateau
- Connects surface areas to underground systems

Underground System
A hidden network beneath Dressrosa used for large-scale operations:

- Underground Trade Port
- SMILE Factory
- Scrap Heap
- Officer’s Tower

These areas are interconnected and linked to surface structures via lifts and passages.

Transport and Connectivity
- Internal lifts connect underground, plateau, and palace

Culture
- Passion-driven society with strong emotional expression
- Competitive and combat-based entertainment culture

entradas.texto:

Definition
The tribu Mink is a race of furry mammalian humanoids, also known as the Warrior Beast Tribe.

Homeland
- Primarily native to Zou
- Most live in the Mokomo Dukedom
- Largely isolated from human civilization for around 1,000 years

Characteristics
- Humanoids with traits based on mammalian animals
- Bodies are covered in fur, which they consider a point of pride
- Each mink resembles a specific animal species
- Males tend to appear more beast-like
- Females tend to appear more human-like
- Possess humanoid hands and feet, though some retain paw traits

Biology
- Species traits are not strictly hereditary
- Offspring may resemble different mammalian lineages within their ancestry
- All minks are natural-born warriors regardless of age
- Maintain strong physical ability even in old age
- Possess fast recovery and strong metabolism
- Thick fur makes them vulnerable to heat

Inter-Species Relations
- Often call humans “Lesser los Mink” due to viewing them as sparsely furred relatives
- Do not inherently hate humans
- Some admire, trust, or live among them
- Welcoming to guests despite their isolationist reputation
- Highly loyal to allies and willing to sacrifice themselves to protect them
- Valued heavily in the slave trade

Strength
- Physically superior to normal humans
- Naturally agile, strong, and stealth-capable
- Skilled fighters from birth
- Capable of high-level combat even without formal training

Electro
Definition
Electro is the natural ability of all minks to generate and discharge electricity.

Rule
Lack of Electro indicates an animal-like being is not a mink.

Sulong
Definition
Sulong is the mink tribe’s full-moon transformation, considered their true form.

Trigger
- Activated by looking directly at the full moon

Beliefs and Culture
- Fur is a major part of mink identity
- They appear to revere deities
- Recognize internal species distinctions within the tribe
- Avoid eating animals with fur
- Freely eat fish, reptiles, amphibians, and non-furred animals

Customs
- “Garchu” is used as both greeting and thanks
- Show affection through “minkship,” including cuddling, licking, nibbling, and exchanging clothes
- Tend to openly follow instincts tied to their animal nature

Speech
- Some use distinctive verbal patterns tied to gender
- This trait may fade in minks who live away from Zou

entradas.resumen: Egghead is a World Government-controlled winter island in the New World that serves as Dr. Vegapunk’s primary research base, designed as a “future island.”
entradas.texto:
Definition
Egghead is a World Government-controlled winter island in the New World that serves as Dr. Vegapunk’s primary research base, designed as a “future island.”

Role
- Central hub for advanced scientific research and experimentation
- Headquarters of Vegapunk and SSG-related technology

Location
- Southeast of Wano
- Southwest of Elbaph

Structure
Egghead is divided into two primary layers:

Fabiriophase (Surface Layer)
- Industrial and public-use zone
- Contains factories, research staff, and displayed technology

Labophase (Upper Layer)
- Elevated on Island Clouds
- Main laboratory and core research zone

Geography
- Originally a winter island
- Climate altered to tropical via Island A.C.
- Surrounding seas remain hazardous (ice, currents, warm eddies)

Fabiriophase

Function
- Production, testing, and public tech display

Key Features
- Central Factory
- Scrapyard (failed inventions, ancient robot)
- Cloud Plant (produces Island Clouds for Labophase support)

Labophase

Function
- Core research and high-level development

Structure
- Located inside giant egg-shaped structure
- Composed of Buildings A, B, C

Key Systems
- Frontier Dome (laser defense barrier)
- Punk Records (Vegapunk’s externalized brain storage and data network)
- Surveillance system (Den Den Mushi monitoring)

Transport
- Vacuum Rocket system connects Fabiriophase ↔ Labophase

Technology

General
- Highly advanced, experimental systems
- Limited to Egghead due to cost and complexity

Island A.C.
- Regulates full island climate and environment

Holograms
- 3D projections made tangible via special equipment

Automatic Cooking Machines
- Instantly produce meals (paid system, enforced by Pacifista)

Security

Sea Defense
- Mechanized Sea Beast Weapons attack approaching ships

Internal Security
- Pacifista units act as police force
- Mark III units serve as advanced enforcement

Inhabitants
- Dr. Vegapunk
- Vegapunk Satellites
- Researchers and staff
- World Government (SSG presence)

entradas.resumen: Fish-Man Island is an underwater island beneath the Red Line that serves as the homeland of fish-men and merfolk and a gateway to the New World.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Fish-Man Island is an underwater island beneath the Red Line that serves as the homeland of fish-men and merfolk and a gateway to the New World.

Role
- Primary residence of fish-men and merfolk
- Houses the Ryugu Kingdom
- Functions as an alternative route to the New World for those unable to cross the Red Line legally

Location
- Situated 10,000 meters below sea level
- Located directly beneath the Red Line inside a deep ocean trench

Access
- Requires ship coating from Sabaody Archipelago
- Only a portion of ships survive the descent
- Entry is regulated through inspection

Environment
- Enclosed in a massive double-layered bubble
- Contains both breathable air and aquatic zones
- Illuminated by the Sunlight Tree Eve

Structure
- Main island within a large bubble
- Ryugu Palace located in a smaller elevated bubble
- Entire territory governed by the Ryugu Kingdom

Protection
- Formerly protected by Whitebeard and Big Mom
- Currently under Straw Hat influence

Society

Population
- Primarily fish-men and merfolk

Social Structure
- Divided by class and species
- Wealthier residents live in upper, well-lit areas
- Lower classes reside in deeper, darker zones
- Fish-Man District isolates poorer populations

Culture
- Intermarriage between fish-men and merfolk allowed
- Blood transfusion between humans and fish-men forbidden
- Fish-Man Karate practiced and taught locally

System Role
- Acts as the primary underwater transit point beneath the Red Line (illegal route alternative to Red Port)

coral_hill>
Definition
Coral Hill is a port town located on Fish-Man Island.

Notable Locations

Mermaid Cafe
A popular restaurant owned by Madam Shyarly and staffed by mermaids.

Staff
- Employees live together in Mermaid Cove
- Known for charm-based service style

Menu
- Sea-based dishes and desserts (no meat or fish)
Examples
- sea fruits
- seaweed desserts
- shellfish meals

Notes
- Highly popular destination

entradas.resumen: Fish-Man District is a separate settlement associated with the Ryugu Kingdom, known as a harsh and lawless region of Fish-Man Island.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Fish-Man District is a separate settlement associated with the Ryugu Kingdom, known as a harsh and lawless region of Fish-Man Island.

Role
It serves as a gathering area for outcasts and marginalized individuals, developing into a self-contained community outside standard kingdom control.

Origin
Originally established as a large institution for orphaned children.

Development
- Loss of administrative control led to social collapse
- Transitioned into an unregulated district
- Became populated by independent and displaced fish-men

Structure
- Centered around a massive ark-like structure
- Residents live within and around the main structure

Location
- Situated outside the main area of Fish-Man Island
- Functions as a distinct zone rather than an integrated district

Characteristics
- Minimal governance
- High resilience environment
- Strong internal survival culture

entradas.resumen: The Sea Forest is a deep-sea region near Fish-Man Island, known as a natural ship graveyard.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Sea Forest is a deep-sea region near Fish-Man Island, known as a natural ship graveyard.

Location
- Positioned on the sea floor northeast of Fish-Man Island
- Illuminated by light from the Sunlight Tree Eve

Environment
- Dense coral growth
- Populated by marine life (fish, whales, Sea Kings)
- Strong currents pull sunken ships into the area

Ship Graveyard
- Accumulation zone of wrecked ships carried by ocean currents
- Contains a graveyard site with notable burials

Notable Site
- Otohime’s Grave: largest marked tomb within the area

Poneglyph
- Contains an apology message from Joy Boy
- References a broken promise to bring Fish-Man Island to the surface using Noah

Missing Artifact
- A Road Poneglyph was previously located here
- Currently removed and considered lost

Significance
- Serves as both a historical site and resting place for ships and figures tied to Fish-Man Island

entradas.resumen: Skypiea is a sky island nation located approximately 10,000 meters above Paradise.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Skypiea is a sky island nation located approximately 10,000 meters above Paradise.

Role
It functions as a sovereign sky-based society centered on cloud terrain, dial technology, and resource-controlled land (Vearth).

Perception
- Considered a myth by most Blue Sea inhabitants

Environment
- Built on an Imperial Cumulus (dense, drifting cloud mass)
- Capable of blocking sunlight over areas below
- Surrounded by White Sea and White-White Sea layers

Access

Heaven's Gate
- Primary entry point from the White Sea
- Requires extremely high toll (Extols)
- Connects to Skypiea via Milky Roads (cloud pathways)

Transport
- Ships are lifted using sea creatures along cloud routes

Society

Population Traits
- Generally peaceful and trusting
- Value soil ("Vearth") as a rare and sacred resource

Currency
- Extols (sky-based currency)
- Exchange rate significantly higher than Beli

Infrastructure

Angel Island
- Main residential and commercial area
- Contains housing, markets, and public facilities

Upper Yard
- Large landmass of natural soil (Vearth)
- Considered sacred and highly valuable
- Contains dense vegetation and major structures

Hidden Cloud Settlements
- Secondary habitation areas built within cloud formations

Technology

Dials
- Core technological system
- Used for energy storage, transport, communication, and combat

Transportation
- Wavers (dial-powered vehicles)
- Cloud pathways (Milky Roads)

Weapons
- Dial-integrated weapon systems

Tools
- Cloudcutters used to shape cloud terrain for construction

Structure
- Composed of multiple cloud-based regions connected by routes
- Centralized around resource distribution (Vearth and Dials)

entradas.resumen: Belly (Beli) is the primary global currency used across the world.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Belly (Beli) is the primary global currency used across the world.

Structure

Denominations
- Coins: 1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 500
- Paper: 1,000, 5,000, 10,000

Properties
- No fractional units
- Exists for over 100 years
- Can be used in physical or check form

Value System

General Scale
- 10,000 Beli: expensive everyday item
- 100,000 Beli: small savings
- 1,000,000+: high-value transaction
- 100,000,000+: major wealth / large operations
- 1,000,000,000+: extreme wealth

Economic Range
- Standard goods: low thousands
- Ships: 100M+ Beli
- Rare materials: 200M+ Beli
- Slaves: 500K–100M+ Beli
- Top bounties / assets: billions

Wealth Distribution
- Common people: limited funds, survival-based economy
- Guilds / pirates: access to large liquid sums
- World Nobles: virtually unlimited wealth (tax-based income)

Inflation
- Currency value has decreased over time
- Older bounties scale significantly higher when reissued

Conversion (Approximate)
- Common estimate: 1 Beli ≈ 1 Yen
- Simplified: ~100 Beli ≈ 1 USD (variable by context)

Other Currencies

Examples
- Extol (Skypiea): 10,000 Extol = 1 Beli
- Gor (Amazon Lily)
- Wano Currency System:
  - Gold
  - Silver
  - Platinum

claves: Something You Would Risk Your Life For
entradas.resumen: Treasure refers to anything of significant value to an individual, group, or civilization.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Treasure refers to anything of significant value to an individual, group, or civilization.

Nature
Treasure is subjective and not limited to material wealth.

Forms
- Material: gold, jewels, artifacts
- Non-material: ideals, memories, symbolic items

Value
The worth of a treasure is defined by personal or cultural importance, often determining how far one will go to protect it.

Categories

Notable Treasures
- One Piece: Roger’s treasure located on Laugh Tale
- Captain John’s Treasure: hidden pirate fortune marked by an armband
- National Treasures: culturally significant assets held by nations

National Examples
- Ryugu Kingdom: Tamatebako
- Fish-Man Island: Energy Steroids
- Wano Country: Shusui (and Ryuma)
- Mary Geoise: unknown hidden treasure tied to the World Nobles

Special Note
Certain treasures possess world-level significance and may influence global power structures.

Personal Treasures
Individuals may value non-material or sentimental items as treasure, often placing them above wealth.

entradas.resumen: A Jolly Roger is the primary emblem of a pirate crew, used to identify its members, ships, territory, and authority. Form
entradas.texto:
Definition
A Jolly Roger is the primary emblem of a pirate crew, used to identify its members, ships, territory, and authority.

Form
- Typically a skull with crossed bones
- Often modified to reflect the captain or crew identity
- Variants may alter or replace traditional elements

Usage
- Displayed on flags and ship sails
- Worn as clothing symbols or tattoos
- Used to mark territory and ownership

Function
- Identifies a crew and its assets
- Signals threat, power, and reputation
- Acts as a recognizable symbol across the world

Meaning
The Jolly Roger carries multiple interpretations depending on the crew:

Power
- Used to intimidate enemies
- Marks controlled territories

Ideals
- Represents freedom, conviction, and identity
- Can symbolize bonds, protection, or rebellion

Symbolic Value
- Treated as an extension of the crew itself
- Loss of a Jolly Roger represents total defeat and loss of identity

Reactions
- Respected or feared by pirates and civilians
- Opposed by the World Government and Marines
- Presence can provoke immediate hostility

Variants

Smileys
- Alternative emblem style replacing skull imagery
- Often linked to specific crews or symbolism
- May include altered expressions (crossed-out, stitched, etc.)

entradas.resumen: The Three Great Powers are the three dominant military forces that maintain global balance across the seas. Composition
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Three Great Powers are the three dominant military forces that maintain global balance across the seas.

Composition
- Marines (Marine Headquarters)
- Four Emperors (Yonko)
- Seven Warlords of the Sea

Role
They function as a power balance system that stabilizes the world and prevents large-scale conflict.

Power Structure
- Marines: Central military force under the World Government
- Four Emperors: Independent pirate forces controlling vast territories
- Seven Warlords: Government-aligned pirates acting as a counterbalance

Balance System
- The three forces are maintained in relative equilibrium
- Each force offsets the others to prevent dominance
- Disruption of one force destabilizes the entire system

Characteristics
- Marines represent order and authority
- Four Emperors represent chaos and independent power
- Seven Warlords operate between both sides

Impact
- Maintains control over the Grand Line
- Suppresses large-scale piracy escalation
- Establishes the Grand Line as a high-risk zone ("Pirate Graveyard")

External Pressure
Other powerful groups can threaten the balance by introducing additional instability.

entradas.resumen: The "D." initial emerged during the Void Century (800–900 years ago) as a symbol of opposition against the alliance that formed the World Government.
entradas.texto:
Origin
The "D." initial emerged during the Void Century (800–900 years ago) as a symbol of opposition against the alliance that formed the World Government.

Early Figures
- Nefertari D. Lili
- Davy D. Jones

Nefertari Line
- Lili opposed the World Government despite being among its founders
- Responsible for scattering the Poneglyphs
- Her will is preserved through a letter passed down in the Nefertari Family

Davy Line
- Believed by descendants to have once ruled the world
- Held deep enmity with Imu
- Bloodline has been actively targeted by the World Government
- A promise exists that Davy’s will will be inherited and eventually oppose Imu

Inheritance
The Will of D. is passed down through generations, with carriers inheriting purpose, conflict, and opposition tied to its origin.

Roger Era
- Gol D. Roger and his crew learned the truth of "D." at Laugh Tale
- The World Government concealed his name as "Gold Roger"
- Roger revealed its meaning to Whitebeard
- Whitebeard stated the will cannot be extinguished and will always be inherited

Awareness
- Some individuals (e.g., scholars, pirates, high-ranking figures) are aware of its significance
- Full meaning remains largely unknown to most carriers

Key Observations
- Individuals with "D." often oppose authority or trigger major events
- The Will is associated with inherited purpose rather than knowledge

World Government Response
- Generally allows the "D." initial to exist publicly
- Suppresses it in high-risk cases (e.g., Roger, Rocks, Luffy)
- Has historically targeted specific bloodlines (notably Davy lineage)

Secrecy
- Some families hide the initial for safety
- Others remain unaware of its meaning

Significance
The Will of D. represents a persistent, inherited force that opposes the World Government and continues to influence global events across generations.

entradas.resumen: The Worst Generation is a group of twelve high-profile pirates composed of eleven Supernovas and one additional pirate recognized at the same level. Composition
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Worst Generation is a group of twelve high-profile pirates composed of eleven Supernovas and one additional pirate recognized at the same level.

Composition
- 11 Supernovas (rookie pirates with bounties over 100,000,000)
- 1 additional pirate of equivalent notoriety

Origin
They emerged as the most prominent pirate group immediately before a major global conflict period.

Core Traits
- All members possess extremely high bounties
- Recognized as major threats by the World Government
- Survived the Grand Line where most crews fail
- Represent different ideologies and approaches to piracy

Supernovas
The Supernovas are elite rookie pirates consisting primarily of captains, with a small number of notable crew members.

Characteristics
- Bounties exceeding 100,000,000
- Originating from all major seas
- Independently leading powerful crews

Threat Level
- Considered destabilizing forces within the world power balance
- Frequently act in opposition to major authorities
- Known for bold and unpredictable actions

Relationships
- Interactions vary between cooperation and conflict
- Temporary alliances may form based on shared objectives
- Mutual recognition exists due to equal status

entradas.resumen: The Void Century is a 100-year period (900–800 years ago) with no recorded history. Significance It contains the “true history” of the world; learning it reveals hidden global truths. Secrecy
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Void Century is a 100-year period (900–800 years ago) with no recorded history.

Significance
It contains the “true history” of the world; learning it reveals hidden global truths.

Secrecy
- Research is forbidden by the World Government
- Knowledge of it is treated as a capital crime
- Entire nations may be destroyed to suppress it

Record Gap
- No surviving historical records exist
- Only Poneglyphs preserve information from this era
- Written in an ancient language readable by very few

World Government Control
- Enforced by Imu, Five Elders, and affiliated forces
- Secrecy maintained at all costs
- Includes use of extreme measures (e.g., Buster Calls)

Discovery
- Roger Pirates uncovered the true history
- Information has not been publicly revealed
- Considered too dangerous to disclose

Narrative Importance
- Central mystery of global history
- Linked to major elements (Poneglyphs, Ancient Weapons, Will of D.)

claves: Hearing the Voices of the World
entradas.resumen: The Voice of All Things is a rare ability that allows a user to perceive messages from beings and objects without spoken language.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Voice of All Things is a rare ability that allows a user to perceive messages from beings and objects without spoken language.

Type
Rare Skill

Function
- Enables communication beyond normal speech
- Messages originate from animals, objects, or individuals
- Perceived mentally (telepathic-like), not audible to others

Scope
- Not universal to all entities
- Observed in:
  - intelligent creatures (humans, Sea Kings, Zunesha)
  - significant objects (e.g., Poneglyphs)

Perception
- Can manifest as overwhelming or unintelligible noise
- Proficiency varies by user
- Some users constantly sense it, others only in specific situations

Capabilities
- Understanding intent or meaning without direct translation
- Does not guarantee full comprehension (e.g., cannot read Poneglyph text)

Advanced Use (Unconfirmed)
- Some users can respond or transmit messages
- May extend to communication with others, including non-users

Inheritance
- Can be hereditary
- Also associated with specific races (e.g., Three-Eye Tribe, requires awakening)

Limitations
- Extremely rare
- Inconsistent clarity and control between users

entradas.resumen: Cloning is the artificial creation of a living duplicate by replicating a subject’s Lineage Factor. Core Mechanics
entradas.texto:
Definition
Cloning is the artificial creation of a living duplicate by replicating a subject’s Lineage Factor.

Core Mechanics
- Produces genetically identical bodies
- Clones possess independent personality and free will
- Genetic modifications can alter traits from the original template

Regulation
- Restricted by the World Government due to high risk
- Unauthorized use is prohibited
- Despite this, the Government actively uses cloning technology

Primary Users

MADS
- First group to achieve successful cloning
- Created Stussy (first successful clone)
- Research formed the foundation for later cloning advancements

Germa 66
- Military force composed entirely of clone soldiers
- Clones grown in accelerated conditions (≈5 years to adult body)
- Specialized types based on physical attributes (strength, speed, endurance)

Traits
- Highly trained and combat-capable
- Loyal to command structure
- Limited awareness of origins

World Government
- Uses advanced cloning for military purposes

Pacifista
- Cyborg clones based on Bartholomew Kuma
- Mindless, fully obedient weapons

Seraphim
- Clones of former Warlords as children
- Enhanced with Lunarian traits and artificial Devil Fruit powers
- Possess limited personality traits

Vegapunk
- Created a perfect clone of himself for independent activity
- Demonstrates advanced personal application of cloning technology

Behavior
- Varies by design
- Some clones retain individuality and emotions
- Others are engineered for obedience or weaponization

Capabilities
- Combat ability determined by genetic design
- Can be enhanced with:
  - racial traits
  - artificial Devil Fruits
  - cybernetic modifications

History
- Enabled by discovery of the Lineage Factor
- Originated through MADS research
- Expanded by Germa 66 and the World Government

entradas.resumen: The Dawn of the World is a long-awaited, undefined event tied to global change, associated with the Void Century and future restoration of the world. Affiliations
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Dawn of the World is a long-awaited, undefined event tied to global change, associated with the Void Century and future restoration of the world.

Affiliations
- Mink Tribe
- Kouzuki Family

Core Concept
- Believed to be an event awaited for centuries
- Likely connected to the Poneglyphs and hidden history
- Earliest reference originates from Nefertari D. Lili (~800 years ago)

Knowledge Scope
- Known among select groups (Minks, Kozuki allies)
- Not widely understood or explained

Beliefs
- Certain individuals believe specific figures will bring the “dawn”
- Often associated with liberation, change, or renewal of the world

Notable Interpretations
- Pedro believed the Straw Hats would lead the world to its dawn
- Yamato implied Momonosuke plays a key role in guiding it
- Ancient texts suggest a cycle of darkness followed by renewal (“sun” symbolism)

Symbolism
- Frequently associated with:
  - The sun / “Sun God”
  - Transition from night to morning
  - The end of an era and beginning of a new one

entradas.resumen: Doriki is a numerical measurement used by CP9 to quantify an individual’s physical power. Function
entradas.texto:
Definition
Doriki is a numerical measurement used by CP9 to quantify an individual’s physical power.

Function
- Determines raw physical strength
- Provides an estimate of Six Powers proficiency

Measurement
Doriki is measured using Fukurou’s “Te-awase” technique, where the target strikes him to gauge force.

Scope
- Measures only physical strength
- Does not account for abilities (e.g., Devil Fruits), though some may indirectly affect results

Scale

Baseline
- Average armed soldier: ~10 Doriki

Threshold
- 500+ Doriki: considered superhuman

Known Values
- Rob Lucci: 4000
- Kaku: 2200
- Jabra: 2180
- Blueno: 820
- Kumadori: 810
- Fukurou: 800
- Kalifa: 630
- Marine soldier: 10
- Spandam: 9

Notes
- High-ranking CP9 agents possess significantly higher Doriki values (2000+ range)
- Extremely low Doriki indicates below-average combat capability

entradas.resumen: A Dream is a personal goal or aspiration that an individual seeks to achieve. Core Concept Dreams represent desires to:
entradas.texto:
Definition
A Dream is a personal goal or aspiration that an individual seeks to achieve.

Core Concept
Dreams represent desires to:
- change one’s status
- discover unknown places or objects
- influence the world or history

Role in Society
- Central motivator for pirates and adventurers
- Major driving force of the Great Pirate Era
- Individuals risk their lives to pursue them

Philosophies

Enduring Dreams
- Dreams never disappear as long as people seek freedom
- Supported by figures like Roger and Blackbeard

Denial of Dreams
- Some reject dreams as unrealistic or outdated
- Associated with declining belief in legendary goals

Reality Outcome
- Dreams frequently shape history when pursued
- Previously doubted goals (e.g., Sky Islands, One Piece) are proven real

Mechanics

Inherited Will
- Dreams can be passed between individuals or generations
- Impact persists even if the original dreamer fails

Manifestation
- Dreams can influence reality itself
- Theory: Devil Fruits originate from human desires to "become" or "do" something

Symbolic Forms
- Figures like Nika represent collective dreams (e.g., liberation)

Common Dream Types

Freedom
- Desire for independence and self-determination

Pirate King
- Goal of reaching the One Piece
- Meaning varies (freedom, power, domination)

New Era
- Desire to reshape the world’s direction or ideals

Racial Harmony
- Goal of unity between different races

World Domination
- Desire to rule or control the entire world

Unknown Dream
- A hidden, shared goal held by Roger and Luffy
- Details unrevealed but strongly impactful

entradas.resumen: Energy is power generated from physical or chemical sources used to produce light, heat, or operate machines.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Energy is power generated from physical or chemical sources used to produce light, heat, or operate machines.

Role
Energy enables technology, machinery, and artificial systems to function continuously.

Global Context
- Most of the world has limited energy production
- Technology level is generally underdeveloped (centuries behind)
- Many societies rely on natural sources (sun, wind, living beings)
- Advanced societies use stable energy sources to power machinery
- Energy scarcity leads to conflict over resources

Concept
Energy can potentially be drawn from the environment (e.g., air), though efficient methods are not yet realized.

Natural Generation
Some beings can generate energy biologically:
- Lunarians → fire
- Mink Tribe → electricity
- Certain Devil Fruits (especially Logia) → large-scale energy output

Types of Energy

Ancient Energy
- Lost power source from the Void Century
- Enabled highly advanced technology (Great Kingdom)
- Capable of powering ancient machines (e.g., Emet)
- Knowledge largely lost; attempts to recreate have failed

Fire
- Most common energy source
- Used for light, heat, and machine power
- Scales from basic use → advanced technology
- Limitations:
  - requires fuel
  - produces smoke/pollution
  - risk of uncontrolled destruction

Mother Flame
- Artificial fire-based energy developed by Vegapunk
- Designed as a near-limitless energy source (currently incomplete)
- Capable of powering Ancient Weapons
- Finite and requires production to sustain

Electricity
- Generated from electrical charges (natural or biological)
- Sources:
  - lightning
  - Mink Electro
  - Devil Fruit abilities
- Rarely used as a stable large-scale power source

Wind
- Natural kinetic energy from air movement
- Used primarily for sailing/navigation
- Cannot sustain machine operation reliably

Carbonated Liquid
- Mechanical energy derived from pressurized carbonation
- Used in cyborg systems and machinery (e.g., cola-powered tech)
- Enables propulsion and force-based output

entradas.resumen: An epithet is a reputational title given to an individual based on notable traits, actions, or characteristics.
entradas.texto:
Definition
An epithet is a reputational title given to an individual based on notable traits, actions, or characteristics.

Purpose
- Identifies and distinguishes individuals
- Amplifies reputation (fear, fame, notoriety)

Usage
- Common among prominent figures (pirates, Marines, etc.)
- May replace a person’s name in recognition or reference
- Sometimes included on wanted posters

Origin
- Assigned by authorities (e.g., World Government)
- Earned through reputation and public perception

Evolution
- Epithets can change as an individual’s reputation develops

Distinction
- Not an alias or codename
