entradas.resumen: Newspapers are printed media used to distribute news locally or globally.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Newspapers are printed media used to distribute news locally or globally.

Role
They function as the primary information network, spreading events, updates, and public notices across regions.

Distribution
- Local papers circulate within specific islands or regions
- Global papers are delivered worldwide via News Coo

Content
- current events and world news
- public information and reports
- wanted posters (often included or attached)
- serialized publications or features

Types
- Global Newspaper: Covers worldwide events and major figures
- Regional Newspaper: Focuses on local or territory-specific news

Function
- informs populations
- shapes public awareness
- connects distant regions through shared information

entradas.resumen: A bounty is a reward placed on a wanted individual, usually for capture or confirmed death. In One Piece, bounties are mainly used to target pirates and other criminals. System Most bounties are issued by the World Government through the Marines, though…
entradas.texto:
Definition
A bounty is a reward placed on a wanted individual, usually for capture or confirmed death. In One Piece, bounties are mainly used to target pirates and other criminals.

System
Most bounties are issued by the World Government through the Marines, though other groups, such as Cross Guild, can also issue them.

Purpose
- identify dangerous criminals
- warn the public
- encourage capture
- measure perceived threat level

Issuing
Bounties are assigned by Marine Headquarters based on how dangerous a person is considered.

What Affects a Bounty
- combat ability
- criminal actions
- opposition to the World Government
- associations with dangerous groups
- public influence or notoriety
- new crimes
- economic change such as inflation

Accuracy
A bounty does not always reflect a person’s true danger level.

Reasons
- incomplete information
- hidden incidents
- government censorship
- mistaken identity
- public misunderstanding

Status
Bounties normally remain active indefinitely unless the target is confirmed dead or placed under special protection.

Frozen Bounties
A bounty may be temporarily suspended under special circumstances.

Examples
- Seven Warlords of the Sea
- slaves of the World Nobles

If that protection ends, the bounty becomes active again and may increase.

Capture Conditions
Standard bounties usually use:
- Dead or Alive

This means the target can be brought in alive or killed for payment, though live capture may be valued more.

Special Clauses
In rare cases, a bounty may require:
- Only Alive

Eligibility
Bounties are generally claimed by lawful parties, not by pirates or major criminals.

Wanted Posters
Bounties are usually distributed through wanted posters.

Poster Information
- name
- portrait
- reward amount
- capture condition

Identification
- posters usually use photographs
- drawings may be used if no proper image exists
- posters may be updated if appearance changes or better images are obtained

Effects
Bounties can:
- isolate criminals from normal society
- build fear or infamy
- serve as a rough public measure of strength
- increase a pirate’s reputation

Limitations
Bounties are shorthand for threat, not exact power.

Examples
- weak or misunderstood targets may receive inflated or reduced bounties
- disguises or false identities can distort recognition
- pets or mascots may receive unusually low bounties

Thresholds
Certain amounts are treated as major benchmarks.

Examples
- 10,000,000 Beli: noteworthy in East Blue
- 100,000,000 Beli: major rookie threat / Super Rookie level
- 300,000,000 Beli: unusually high bounty
- 1,000,000,000 Beli: monstrous even in the New World

Currency
Beli is the standard currency used for bounty values.

Note
Numeric bounty amounts are written in Beli to show the exact reward attached to a target.

entradas.resumen: Liar Noland is a children’s storybook from the North Blue based on the real explorer Mont Blanc Noland.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Liar Noland is a children’s storybook from the North Blue based on the real explorer Mont Blanc Noland.

Role
It serves as a moral tale used to teach children about the consequences of lying.

Content
The story portrays Noland as a habitual liar whose grand tales are not believed.

Key Narrative
- Noland claims to have discovered a mountain of gold
- A king leads an expedition to verify the claim
- The island contains no gold, only jungle
- Noland is executed for lying
- His final claim (the gold sank) is dismissed

Nature
- Fictionalized version of a real historical figure
- Widely known folklore in the North Blue

Theme
- Dishonesty leads to distrust and punishment

entradas.resumen: Weapons are tools designed for combat, used to inflict damage or harm. Core Concept Weapons function as extensions of a user’s personality, fighting style, or physical traits rather than purely standard tools. Scope This includes objects specifically…
entradas.texto:
Definition
Weapons are tools designed for combat, used to inflict damage or harm.

Core Concept
Weapons function as extensions of a user’s personality, fighting style, or physical traits rather than purely standard tools.

Scope
This includes objects specifically intended for combat, not improvised items.

Characteristics
- Wide variety of designs (realistic and fictional)
- Often exaggerated or unconventional
- Can reflect the user’s abilities or individuality

Principle
Effectiveness depends on the user’s skill, creativity, and application rather than the weapon alone.

entradas.resumen: A sword is a handheld bladed weapon designed for melee combat, used for slashing and thrusting.
entradas.texto:
Definition
A sword is a handheld bladed weapon designed for melee combat, used for slashing and thrusting.

Role
Swords are one of the most common weapons, used by individuals ranging from civilians to elite fighters. Skilled users are known as swordsmen.

Structure
A sword consists of three core components:
- Blade: Primary cutting or piercing element
- Hilt: Grip used to control the weapon
- Guard: Protects the wielder’s hands

Function
- Slashing
- Thrusting
- Blocking other weapons

Limitations
- Limited range
- Effectiveness depends heavily on user skill
- Quality impacts performance and durability

Traits
- Variations exist in shape, size, and design
- Some blades include enhancements or specialized features

Sentience (Rare)
Some swords exhibit distinct “personalities”:
- May influence handling difficulty
- Can overwhelm unskilled users
- Often labeled “cursed” when dangerous to wield

Compatibility (Rare)
- Swords may “choose” compatible wielders
- Proper use requires understanding and controlling the blade
- Strong users handle high-risk blades more effectively

Construction
- Forged by swordsmiths
- Higher craftsmanship results in stronger and more valuable weapons

Classifications

Famous Blades
- Named swords known for history, maker, or wielder

Grade Blades (Wazamono)
- Ranked by quality and cutting ability
- Four tiers: Grade, Skillful, Great, Supreme

Black Blades
- Permanently hardened through repeated use and Haki
- Extremely durable and rare
- Can increase a sword’s grade

Cursed Blades
- Considered dangerous due to overwhelming traits
- Often lethal to unworthy users
- Reputation tied to user incompatibility rather than true curse

entradas.resumen: An axe is a bladed weapon consisting of a handle with a single or double-edged head, used primarily for chopping. Usage A user of an axe is referred to as an axeman. Characteristics
entradas.texto:
Definition
An axe is a bladed weapon consisting of a handle with a single or double-edged head, used primarily for chopping.

Usage
A user of an axe is referred to as an axeman.

Characteristics
- Designed for chopping using weight and swing force
- Can be single- or double-bladed
- Some variants include secondary functions (e.g., hammer side)

Combat Properties

Strengths
- High damage per strike (capable of lethal blows)
- Effective even when blunt (can bludgeon)
- Some variants can be thrown

Weaknesses
- Slower attack speed due to swing requirement
- Leaves wielder open to faster weapons (e.g., swords, daggers)

Types

Tool-Based
- Originally designed for labor (e.g., woodcutting)
- Can be used as improvised weapons

Weapon-Based
- Specifically designed for combat
- Heavier with larger blades for increased damage

entradas.resumen: Daggers/Knives are small, portable combat weapons used for close-range or thrown attacks.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Daggers/Knives are small, portable combat weapons used for close-range or thrown attacks.

Role
They function as secondary or backup weapons, complementing a user's primary fighting style.

Usage
- Close combat (stabbing, slashing)
- Ranged attacks (throwing)

Characteristics
- Compact and easy to carry
- Fast and versatile
- Often concealed or integrated into other weapons

Applications
- Support weapon alongside primary combat methods
- Used when a stronger weapon is unnecessary or excessive

Variants
- Standard daggers/knives
- Hidden blades (e.g., concealed in weapons or tools)

entradas.resumen: A firearm is a projectile weapon that launches high-speed shots using explosive ignition within a barrel.
entradas.texto:
Definition
A firearm is a projectile weapon that launches high-speed shots using explosive ignition within a barrel.

Role
Firearms are widely used ranged weapons, valued for ease of use, portability, and lethality.

Usage
- Used by civilians, soldiers, and outlaws
- Specialists are known as gunmen (elite users often function as snipers)

World Context
- Second most common weapon type after swords
- Combines flintlock-era design with exaggerated or advanced functionality
- Often behaves more efficiently than real-world equivalents (e.g., semi-automatic firing)

Core Mechanics

Flintlock Structure
- Barrel: tube that directs the projectile
- Flashpan: holds ignition powder
- Serpent: holds flint for spark generation
- Frizzen: steel surface and powder cover
- Trigger: activates ignition

Ammunition
- Round shot (standard metal spheres)
- Conical or explosive rounds (enhanced variants)

Performance
- Capable of lethal damage to vital areas
- Limited ammo capacity per load
- Reloading is slow and inefficient

Limitations
- Can be countered by armor, abilities, or reflexes
- Effectiveness varies against durable targets
- May be affected by environmental conditions (uncertain)

entradas.resumen: Pistols are one-handed firearms, typically defined by an integrated ammunition chamber within the barrel.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Pistols are one-handed firearms, typically defined by an integrated ammunition chamber within the barrel.

Role
They are the smallest and most accessible firearm type, commonly used by civilians but also utilized by experienced combatants.

Characteristics
- Lightweight and compact
- Simple operation
- Designed for single-hand use

Combat Usage
- Widely used due to ease of handling
- Advanced users may employ specialized variants (e.g., dual-barrel pistols)

Variants
- Standard Pistols
- Dual-Barrel Pistols (multi-shot capability)
- Modified or stylized designs

Examples

Flash Guns
- Dual-barreled flintlocks
- Use Flash Dials to conceal shots

entradas.resumen: A revolver is a firearm that uses a rotating cylinder with multiple chambers to store and fire ammunition.
entradas.texto:
Definition
A revolver is a firearm that uses a rotating cylinder with multiple chambers to store and fire ammunition.

Mechanics
- Each chamber must align with the barrel to fire
- Cylinder rotates after each shot (manual or trigger-based)

Structure
- Similar in size and shape to a pistol
- Features an external multi-chamber cylinder

Characteristics
- Higher mechanical complexity than pistols
- More difficult to maintain and repair

Performance
- More durable construction
- Capable of stronger shots

entradas.resumen: A rifle is a long-barreled firearm designed for accurate long-distance shooting. Usage
entradas.texto:
Definition
A rifle is a long-barreled firearm designed for accurate long-distance shooting.

Usage
- Operated with two hands
- Typically braced against the shoulder or a stable surface

Function
- Optimized for precision and range over standard firearms

Terminology
- Technically refers to barrels with spiral grooves (rifling) that spin projectiles
- Commonly used to describe most long-barreled firearms, including smoothbore types

Role
- Standard-issue weapon for military forces
- Commonly used by snipers for long-range combat

entradas.resumen: A bow is a curved projectile weapon that launches arrows using tension from an elastic string.
entradas.texto:
Definition
A bow is a curved projectile weapon that launches arrows using tension from an elastic string.

Role
Bows are ranged weapons used for precision attacks at distance.

Users
- Wielders are known as archers

Mechanics
- Arrows are fired through stored tension in the string
- Can be enhanced with abilities (e.g., Haki or elemental effects)

Variations
- Standard bows (wooden, traditional design)
- Alternate forms (e.g., Kuja snake-based archery weapons)

entradas.resumen: A slingshot is a small, hand-powered projectile weapon that launches ammunition using elastic force.
entradas.texto:
Definition
A slingshot is a small, hand-powered projectile weapon that launches ammunition using elastic force.

Role
Used for ranged attacks with precision and portability.

Usage
- Primarily used by Usopp

Known Weapons
- Ginga Pachinko (standard slingshot)
- Kabuto (enhanced version)
- Kuro Kabuto (advanced version)

Characteristics
- Compact and lightweight
- Functions as a manual, elastic-based launcher
- Larger variants retain core slingshot mechanics

entradas.resumen: Substances are materials that can be weaponized to inflict direct or indirect harm.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Substances are materials that can be weaponized to inflict direct or indirect harm.

Role
They are used as offensive or support tools in combat, often through application, exposure, or delivery systems.

entradas.resumen: Seastone is a rare mineral that emits energy identical to the sea, nullifying Devil Fruit abilities upon contact.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Seastone is a rare mineral that emits energy identical to the sea, nullifying Devil Fruit abilities upon contact.

Origin
- Naturally found in Wano Country
- Processed and utilized globally (primarily by Marines and World Government)

Properties
- Mimics the sea’s energy in solid form
- Extremely durable (comparable to diamond)
- Contains Pyrobloin (key component linked to cloud formation)

Core Effects

Devil Fruit Interaction
- Nullifies abilities on direct contact
- Drains stamina and weakens the user
- Effect ends immediately when contact is broken

Control
- Strength of suppression depends on purity and density
- Modified forms allow limited mobility (e.g., cuffs)

Resistance
- High endurance users can partially resist effects

Haki Interaction
- May suppress Haki usage (observed but not fully confirmed)

External Interaction
- Devil Fruit abilities can affect Seastone if the user is not in direct contact

Applications

Restraints
- Handcuffs, chains, cages
- Designed to disable abilities while restricting movement

Weapons
- Bullets, nets, and embedded tools used against Devil Fruit users

Infrastructure
- Used in prisons and fortified structures

Marine Usage
- Coating ship hulls masks presence from Sea Kings
- Enables safer travel through dangerous waters (e.g., Calm Belt)

Limitations
- Requires direct contact for full effect
- Masking effect does not make objects completely invisible

entradas.resumen: Chemical weapons are devices or substances that harm targets through the release of toxic liquids or gases. Forms
entradas.texto:
Definition
Chemical weapons are devices or substances that harm targets through the release of toxic liquids or gases.

Forms
- Gas-based (airborne effects)
- Liquid-based (coating, ingestion, or contact)

Effects
- Debilitation (e.g., intoxication-like states)
- Sleep induction
- Poisoning (often lethal)

Common Types

Poison
- Most widespread form
- Used via coatings, injections, or explosives
- Typically causes severe or fatal damage

Usage
- Employed in combat, assassination, or incapacitation
- Used by various fighters and organizations

entradas.resumen: Poison is a toxic substance or chemical weapon that harms organic life through biological disruption. Forms
entradas.texto:
Definition
Poison is a toxic substance or chemical weapon that harms organic life through biological disruption.

Forms
- Liquid
- Gas
- Solid
- Naturally secreted or artificially engineered

Effects
- Illness
- Paralysis
- Organ failure
- Death

Sources
- Chemical production
- Plants
- Animals

Combat Role
- Weakens targets over time
- Bypasses conventional defenses
- Provides advantage by reducing opponent capability

Resistance and Immunity
- Most individuals lack natural resistance
- Repeated exposure can build partial resistance
- Some abilities grant full immunity or absorption

Treatment

Antidotes
- Substances that neutralize poison effects
- Not always available or easily produced

Alternative Methods
- Ability-based extraction or neutralization
- Includes absorption, removal, or biological alteration

Limitations
- Some poisons have no cure
- Effectiveness varies by toxicity and target durability
- Highly lethal toxins can bypass resistance

entradas.resumen: Viruses are biological agents used as weapons, functioning as a form of biochemical warfare. Usage
entradas.texto:
Definition
Viruses are biological agents used as weapons, functioning as a form of biochemical warfare.

Usage
- Employed in combat to infect and spread among targets
- Can be weaponized through delivery systems such as bullets

Application
- Capable of rapid transmission between individuals
- Designed to weaken, incapacitate, or kill targets

Notable User
- Queen: specializes in viral weapon development

entradas.resumen: Ancient Weapons are three weapons of mass destruction with immense, world-altering power, each taking a different form. Core Units
entradas.texto:
Definition
Ancient Weapons are three weapons of mass destruction with immense, world-altering power, each taking a different form.

Core Units
- Pluton
- Poseidon
- Uranus

Nature
- Not limited to objects; may be living beings or constructs
- Each weapon possesses "god-like" destructive capability

History
- Used during the Void Century
- Contributed to global sea level rise and current world geography
- Preserved for future use by Joy Boy (reason unknown)

Global Significance
- Central reason the World Government forbids Void Century research
- Feared as catalysts for global-scale war
- Actively sought by powerful individuals and factions

Known Weapons

Pluton
Type
- Ancient battleship

Capabilities
- Extreme destructive power

Location

Conditions
- Requires destruction of Wano’s borders to access

Notes
- Blueprints once existed as a countermeasure
- Destroyed to prevent misuse

Poseidon
Type
- Living being (mermaid princess)

Ability
- Communicates with and commands Sea Kings

Cycle
- Reincarnates every several centuries

Current Holder
- Shirahoshi

Role
- Controls massive sea-based entities capable of large-scale destruction

Uranus
Type
- Unknown (object or living being)

Status
- No confirmed details

entradas.resumen: Famous Blades (Meitō) are high-quality weapons, primarily swords, known for superior craftsmanship and use by notable combatants.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Famous Blades (Meitō) are high-quality weapons, primarily swords, known for superior craftsmanship and use by notable combatants.

Nature
- Individually forged by master craftsmen
- Possess distinct names, designs, and identities
- Known for sharpness, durability, and overall quality
- Often wielded by highly skilled fighters

Graded Blades
Blades with officially recognized quality rankings.

Recognition
- Can be identified by experts
- Catalogued in official records
- High market value depending on grade

Grades
- Supreme Grade (12 total)
- Great Grade (21 total)
- Skillful Grade (50 total)
- Grade (unknown total)

Ungraded Blades
Some Famous Blades have no official rank but are still well-known.

Scope
While primarily swords, the term may extend to:
- spears
- halberds
- similar high-quality weapons

Blade-Wielder Relationship
- High-grade blades require advanced skill to use
- Some blades are difficult or dangerous to wield (e.g. cursed blades)
- It is often implied a blade "chooses" its wielder

Black Blades
A rare evolved state of a blade.

Properties
- Permanently blackened through extensive combat
- Significantly increased durability and strength
- Retains state regardless of wielder

Mechanism
- Linked to Armament Haki (exact process unknown)
- May increase a blade’s rank upon transformation

entradas.resumen: The 21 Great Grade Blades (Ō Wazamono) are elite swords ranked below the 12 Supreme Grade Blades. Rank
entradas.texto:
Definition
The 21 Great Grade Blades (Ō Wazamono) are elite swords ranked below the 12 Supreme Grade Blades.

Rank
- Second-highest blade class

Characteristics
- High cutting power, durability, and balance
- Capable of competing with Supreme Grade Blades in skilled hands
- Difficult to control due to immense sharpness

Feats
- Can clash with Supreme King Haki users
- Capable of permanently injuring highly durable targets
- Possess large-scale destructive cutting power

Status
- Can achieve legendary status depending on wielder
- Example: Shusui (Black Blade, national treasure of Wano)

Notable Users
- Roronoa Zoro (held multiple)
- Kozuki Oden (dual wielder)

Known Count
- Total: 21

entradas.resumen: The 50 Skillful Grade Blades are high-quality swords superior to standard Grade Blades but below Great Grade and Supreme Grade blades. Rank
entradas.texto:
Definition
The 50 Skillful Grade Blades are high-quality swords superior to standard Grade Blades but below Great Grade and Supreme Grade blades.

Rank
- Below: 21 Great Grade Blades, 12 Supreme Grade Blades
- Above: standard Grade Blades

Characteristics
- High sharpness and durability
- Balanced strength and resilience
- Commonly lightweight, favoring speed-based combat

Combat Use
- Optimized for fast attacks
- Effective for handling multiple opponents in succession

Known Count
- 50 total blades

entradas.resumen: Grade Blades (業物 Wazamono) are the lowest tier within the four recognized blade grades. Hierarchy They rank below:
entradas.texto:
Definition
Grade Blades (業物 Wazamono) are the lowest tier within the four recognized blade grades.

Hierarchy
They rank below:
- Skillful Grade
- Great Grade
- Supreme Grade

Quantity
- Total number unknown

Quality
Despite being the lowest grade, they are still superior to standard weapons.

Attributes
- High durability
- Strong cutting capability
- Reliable performance in combat

Performance
- Can clash with higher-grade blades when wielded by skilled users
- Capable of cutting large or durable targets
- Effectiveness increases significantly with Armament Haki

entradas.resumen: Organizations are independent entities that operate beyond individual characters and drive the world’s political and thematic conflicts.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Organizations are independent entities that operate beyond individual characters and drive the world’s political and thematic conflicts.

Role
They shape power structures, influence events, and act as major forces within the world.

Types
- Governments
- Pirate Crews / Empires
- Underworld Syndicates
- Military Forces

entradas.resumen: The Seven Warlords of the Sea are seven powerful pirates officially allied with the World Government.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Seven Warlords of the Sea are seven powerful pirates officially allied with the World Government.

Role
They function as a controlled pirate force used to counter other pirates and maintain global balance.

System Placement
- One of the Three Great Powers
- Acts as a balance between the Four Emperors and the Marines

Structure
- Limited to seven members at a time
- Members are selected based on strength, influence, or strategic value

Authority
- Operate under World Government sanction
- Granted freedom to act with minimal restriction compared to normal pirates

Privileges
- Bounties are frozen upon joining
- Past crimes are largely pardoned while in service
- Allowed to operate with broad autonomy
- Permitted to plunder enemy ships under government approval
- May access resources and protections unavailable to normal pirates

Duties
- Eliminate or suppress pirate threats
- Support the World Government when required
- Assist the Marines in major conflicts
- Serve as a symbol of government power and deterrence

Selection Criteria
- High combat ability
- Notable reputation or influence
- Strategic usefulness to the World Government
- Ability to intimidate other pirates

Characteristics
- Members are typically elite pirates, often veterans of the New World
- Possess extreme combat ability through Devil Fruits, martial skill, or both
- Most operate independently rather than as a true team
- Relations between members are unstable and based more on coexistence than trust

Benefits and Concessions
- Legal protection from ordinary pirate prosecution
- Freedom to pursue legitimate business or personal operations
- Government tolerance toward actions normally associated with piracy
- Subordinates may also benefit from protection under a Warlord’s authority

Strength
- Collectively recognized as one of the world’s greatest military powers
- Each member is powerful enough to threaten major pirate crews alone
- Their loss or absence can disrupt the balance of the Three Great Powers

Public Image
- Feared by pirates and civilians alike
- Viewed by many as “government dogs”
- Respected as infamous but legitimate pirate authorities

Notes
The Seven Warlords system is defined by contradiction: pirates made lawful in order to control piracy itself.

entradas.resumen: The Four Emperors (Yonkō) are the four most powerful and influential pirate captains in the world. System Placement
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Four Emperors (Yonkō) are the four most powerful and influential pirate captains in the world.

System Placement
- One of the Three Great Powers
- Counterbalance to the Marines and other global forces

Role
They dominate the New World, acting as independent sovereign forces with control over territories, fleets, and subordinate crews.

Structure
- Limited to four individuals at a time
- Each operates independently with no formal alliance
- Maintain separate agendas and territories

Authority
- No official affiliation with the World Government
- Possess de facto sovereignty over controlled regions
- Their actions can influence global stability

Power
- Among the strongest individuals in the world
- Combine extreme combat ability, Haki mastery, and/or Devil Fruit power
- Individual strength exceeds nearly all subordinates

Military Forces
- Command massive crews and fleets
- Supported by elite officers and subordinate pirate groups
- Maintain alliances to expand influence and strength

Territories
- Control multiple islands and regions within the New World
- Provide protection to territories under their rule
- Can claim dominion through reputation and power alone

Influence
- Their presence deters both pirates and government forces
- Small conflicts involving them can escalate into large-scale war
- Their authority is recognized globally without formal enforcement

Balance
- Maintain a four-way power equilibrium
- Rarely engage each other directly due to risk of mutual destruction
- Their existence stabilizes the global power structure through tension

entradas.resumen: Baroque Works is a large-scale undercover criminal syndicate operating as bounty hunters while secretly executing covert operations under centralized leadership. Leadership
entradas.texto:
Definition
Baroque Works is a large-scale undercover criminal syndicate operating as bounty hunters while secretly executing covert operations under centralized leadership.

Leadership
- President: Mr. 0
- Vice: Miss All Sunday

Purpose
- Destabilization and covert manipulation of nations
- Long-term acquisition of high-value objectives

Scale
- 2,000+ members
- Active across the Grand Line (primarily Paradise)

Structure

Command System
- Leader identity hidden from most members
- Strict secrecy; unauthorized knowledge punished

Agent System
Elite operatives assigned codenames and direct orders.

Naming Scheme
- Male Agents: Numbered (lower number = higher rank)
- Female Agents: Holiday/weekday-based (higher rank = “greater” holiday)

Teams
- Organized in male–female pairs
- Built around complementary abilities

Agent Classes

1. Officer Agents
- Highest-ranking operatives (Mr. 1–Mr. 5 teams)
- Primary combat force
- Frequently possess Devil Fruit abilities
- Direct involvement in major operations

2. Frontier Agents
- Mid-tier operatives (Mr. 6–Mr. 12 teams)
- Oversee field operations and funding activities

Subordinates

1. Billions
- Assigned under Officer Agents
- Primary candidates for promotion

2. Millions
- Assigned under Frontier Agents
- Lower-tier workforce

System Traits
- Promotion through achievement or vacancy
- Internal competition encouraged

Operations

Core Activities
- Bounty hunting (funding)
- Espionage and intelligence gathering
- Sabotage and destabilization
- Covert manipulation of populations

Methods
- Smuggling and resource control
- Information warfare and misinformation
- Indirect conflict generation

Special Units

Unluckies
- Animal-based messengers and enforcers
- Handle communication and punishment

Additional Creatures
- Used for transport, execution, and support roles

Strength

Organization
- Highly structured and compartmentalized
- Operates as a covert network rather than open force

Combat Power
- Elite agents significantly above standard members
- Multiple Devil Fruit users among top ranks

Leadership Strength
- Central leadership possesses top-tier combat and strategic capability

entradas.resumen: The Thriller Bark Pirates are a pirate crew led by Gecko Moria, operating as a large-scale undead-based force. Affiliation
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Thriller Bark Pirates are a pirate crew led by Gecko Moria, operating as a large-scale undead-based force.

Affiliation
- Seven Warlords of the Sea (World Government–recognized)

Base of Operations
- Thriller Bark (island-sized ship)

Structure

Core Leadership
Mysterious Four
- Gecko Moria (Captain)
- Hogback
- Absalom
- Perona

Zombie Hierarchy
- General Zombies: high-level commanders (former legendary figures)
- Soldier Zombies: standard combat units
- Surprise Zombies: disguise-based ambush units
- Wild Zombies: animal-based units (enhanced strength)
- Special Zombies: unique high-tier units (e.g., Oars)
- Spider Mice: web-based capture units

Power System
- Zombies are created using stolen shadows via Moria’s Devil Fruit
- Animated bodies function under centralized command
- Shadows determine combat ability and behavior

Force Size
- Approximately 900+ zombie units at peak
- Includes reanimated high-level fighters and creatures

Combat Method
- Night Raids: coordinated midnight attacks to capture targets
- Shadow Extraction: victims’ shadows are removed and repurposed
- Enemy weakening through shadow loss and psychological disruption

Capabilities
- Large-scale army control
- High durability due to undead composition
- Ability to weaponize captured enemies into additional forces

entradas.resumen: The Donquixote Pirates (Donquixote Family) were a powerful pirate crew led by Donquixote Doflamingo. Classification
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Donquixote Pirates (Donquixote Family) were a powerful pirate crew led by Donquixote Doflamingo.

Classification
- Pirate Crew
- Warlord-Aligned Group
- Underworld Organization

Leadership
Captain
- Donquixote Doflamingo

Structure

Core Hierarchy
- Captain (absolute authority)
- Elite Officers (Card Seats: Heart, Club, Diamond, Spade)
- Officers (divided under elites)
- Soldiers (~2000 members)

Elite Officers
- Trebol (Club)
- Diamante (Diamond)
- Pica (Spade)
- Heart seat (reserved position)

Divisions

Trebol Army
- Special abilities / control-based roles

Diamante Army
- Combat-focused division

Pica Army
- Tactical / commando operations

Additional Officers
- Independent operatives operating outside main divisions

Territory & Authority
- Controlled Dressrosa as ruling power
- Captain held position as king

Operations

Underworld Activity
- Weapons trade
- SMILE production and distribution
- Slave trade and black-market dealings

Alliances
- Connected to major underworld figures
- Supplied artificial Devil Fruits to external forces

Resources
- Access to advanced scientific production (SAD, SMILEs)
- Political influence through royal authority

Crew Strength

Scale
- ~2000 members

Devil Fruit Users
- High concentration of ability users (17+ confirmed)
- Includes Logia, Paramecia, and artificial Zoan (SMILE) users

Combat Traits
- Strong division-based coordination
- High-level officer specialization
- Emphasis on overwhelming force and control

Recruitment
- Accepts members from young age
- Harsh training standards
- Advancement based on ability and loyalty

Symbol
- Crossed-out smiley Jolly Roger (used across affiliates)

entradas.resumen: The Knights of God are an elite World Government combat force based in Mary Geoise with authority over the Celestial Dragons. Affiliation
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Knights of God are an elite World Government combat force based in Mary Geoise with authority over the Celestial Dragons.

Affiliation
- World Government

Command
- Supreme Commander (formerly Figarland Garling)
- Commander (sub-leader rank)

Structure
- Core Knights (limited members)
- Devoted Blades (lower-ranking candidates)

Devoted Blades
- Serve as subordinate trainees
- Can be promoted to full Knights
- Promotion grants Covenant upgrade

Headquarters
- Shangara (Mary Geoise)

Role
- Highest-level enforcement force within Mary Geoise
- Act as arbiters among Celestial Dragons
- Supplement Marine forces during major threats
- Execute missions directly ordered by Imu

Authority
- Can judge and punish World Nobles
- Capable of executing Celestial Dragons
- Authority exceeded only by Imu and the Five Elders

Operations
- Primarily operate within Mary Geoise
- Occasionally deployed globally for high-level missions
- Maintain strict secrecy regarding internal activities

Characteristics
- Possess “divine” status among World Nobles
- Do not follow standard Celestial Dragon attire
- Retain autonomy in daily activity and movement

Combat Power
- Among the strongest forces in the World Government
- Highly skilled in combat, strategy, and weapon use
- Some possess Devil Fruit abilities

Covenant System
All members are bound to Imu through a Covenant.

Depths Covenant (Knights)
- Grants:
  - enhanced physical power
  - immortality / regeneration
  - Abyss abilities (teleportation / summoning)
- Enforces absolute subservience to Imu

Shallows Covenant (Devoted Blades)
- Lower-tier version prior to promotion

Limitation
- Imu can override will or control the body of Covenant holders

entradas.resumen: The Revolutionary Army is a global military organization that opposes the World Government and seeks to dismantle its rule.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Revolutionary Army is a global military organization that opposes the World Government and seeks to dismantle its rule.

Role
- Direct opposition force to the World Government
- Conducts uprisings and liberation efforts across nations
- Targets political corruption and Celestial Dragon authority

Objective
- Overthrow the World Government system
- Remove oppressive monarchies aligned with it
- Liberate populations from enforced control and tribute systems

Operations
- Initiates revolutions within allied or oppressed nations
- Supports civilians rather than replacing them as rulers
- Exploits instability to weaken government influence

Recruitment
Members are drawn from:
- liberated civilians
- oppressed populations
- former slaves
- allied rebels

Requirements
- training in weapons and combat tactics
- adherence to organizational discipline

Resources
- acquires weapons through seizure and stockpiling
- funded through allied support and captured assets
- maintains independent military supply chains

Structure

Leadership
- Supreme Commander
- Chief of Staff

Army Divisions
Forces are divided into regional armies:
- Grand Line Army
- North Army
- East Army
- West Army
- South Army

Command System
- Each army led by an Army Commander
- Supported by a Deputy Commander

Characteristics
- Highly organized independent military force
- Members demonstrate strong ideological commitment
- Prioritizes empowerment over direct control

Status
- Considered a major global threat by the World Government
- Operates outside official law and authority

entradas.resumen: Galleila is an ancient warrior group of over 100 giant shipwrights originating from Elbaph. Classification
entradas.texto:
Definition
Galleila is an ancient warrior group of over 100 giant shipwrights originating from Elbaph.

Classification
- Warrior Group
- Shipwright Organization

Affiliation
- Elbaph

Composition
- Giant shipwrights
- Includes Ancient Giants

Characteristics
- Wield large warhammers
- Known for extreme destructive capability
- Considered legendary and largely unknown, even within Elbaph

Reputation
- Regarded as a myth by some (e.g., Elbaph figures)
- Sought after for military power due to their destructive potential

History
- Departed Elbaph for distant lands
- Captured and imprisoned (suspected World Government involvement)
- Sent a message back to Elbaph before disappearance
- Current status unknown

Rumors
- Possible existence of frozen giant remains
- Speculated connection to hidden giant “army” storage locations

entradas.resumen: The Guardians are the nocturnal military force of the Mokomo Dukedom, responsible for defense and protection within Zou. Affiliation
entradas.texto:
The Guardians are the nocturnal military force of the Mokomo Dukedom, responsible for defense and protection within Zou.

Affiliation
- Mokomo Dukedom
- Based in Whale Forest

Leadership
- Nekomamushi (former commander)
- Pedro (former captain, deceased)
- Currently serve under Carrot

Role
- Night-time counterpart to the Musketeer Squad
- Primary defenders of Whale Forest

Duties
- Protect the Road Poneglyph within the Whale Tree
- Monitor and control activity within Whale Forest

Authority
- Oversee external groups stationed on Zou
- Restrict movement (e.g. pirate crews require supervision)

Organization
- Operate primarily at night
- Continue guarding duties during the day when necessary
- Previously followed Nekomamushi, then Pedro

Abilities
- Mink Tribe combatants
- Use Electro (natural racial ability)

Combat Style
- High stealth and coordination
- Capable of undetected positioning and ambush

Weapons
- Spears
- Machetes
- Axes
- Claw-based weapons

Assets
- Unnamed ship used for external travel

entradas.resumen: The Big Mom Pirates are a massive Emperor-class pirate crew led by Charlotte Linlin, centered around the Charlotte Family and based in Totto Land, with Whole Cake Island as their main seat of power.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Big Mom Pirates are a massive Emperor-class pirate crew led by Charlotte Linlin, centered around the Charlotte Family and based in Totto Land, with Whole Cake Island as their main seat of power.

Role
They function as both a pirate crew and a ruling military power, controlling territory, enforcing tribute, and operating as a large pirate fleet.

Base
- Totto Land
- Whole Cake Island
- Main ship: Queen Mama Chanter

Organization
The crew is structured around Big Mom, her family, elite officers, combat divisions, homie forces, and subordinate crews.

Hierarchy
- Captain: Big Mom
- Top Officers: Three Sweet Commanders
- Officers: Charlotte Family elites and senior fighters
- Combatants: ranked non-family fighters
- Soldiers: living troops and homie forces
- Subordinates: allied and subordinate pirate crews

Charlotte Family Core
The Charlotte Family forms the core of the crew’s command structure, with many children serving as officers, commanders, and squad leaders.

Three Sweet Commanders
The Three Sweet Commanders are Big Mom’s highest-ranking officers and strongest fighters beneath her.

Members
- Katakuri
- Smoothie
- Cracker

Role
- Elite combat leadership
- Highest battlefield authority under Big Mom
- Major symbols of the crew’s military power

Officers
The officers consist largely of Charlotte Family members and other elite personnel who command forces, oversee operations, and act as high-level combatants.

Combatants
Combatants are mission-oriented fighters used for external operations and field combat.

Known Rank Themes
- Rook
- Knight
- Bishop

Homies and Soldiers
A major portion of the crew’s army consists of homies and conventional soldiers.

Homie Types
- Special Homies
- Fighting Homies
- Decorative Homies

Forces
- Chess Soldiers
- Biscuit Soldiers
- Tarte Tanks
- Large numbers of living soldiers from multiple races

Subordinates
The crew commands subordinate pirate groups and expands influence through political marriage and forced family ties.

Recruitment Method
External crews or families may be bound to the Big Mom Pirates through marriage alliances tied to the Charlotte Family.

Territory
The Big Mom Pirates rule Totto Land and protect additional territories under a tribute system.

Tribute Rule
Protected territories must provide regular confection-based payments.

Strength
The Big Mom Pirates are one of the most powerful pirate forces in the New World.

Power Factors
- Emperor-level captain
- Elite commanders and officers
- Massive family-based command structure
- Tens of thousands of soldiers and homies
- Large naval forces
- Strong territorial surveillance and defense
- High concentration of Devil Fruit users
- Numerous Haki-proficient elites
- Broad racial diversity and specialized abilities

Military Features
- Large fleet presence
- Strong siege and interception capability
- Heavy territorial control
- Coordinated officer-led operations
- Specialized weapons and equipment

Reputation
They are feared for their scale, political reach, forced summons, and overwhelming retaliation against opposition.

Weaknesses
- Heavy dependence on Big Mom as the crew’s greatest power
- Internal instability caused by her destructive behavior
- Large number of Devil Fruit users creates naval vulnerability

entradas.resumen: The Beasts Pirates are an Emperor-class pirate crew led by Kaidou, built around militarization, Zoan power, and strength-based rule, with Wano Country and Onigashima as their main strongholds.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Beasts Pirates are an Emperor-class pirate crew led by Kaidou, built around militarization, Zoan power, and strength-based rule, with Wano Country and Onigashima as their main strongholds.

Role
They function as both a pirate crew and a military occupation force, using force, hierarchy, and territorial control to dominate the New World.

Base
- Wano Country
- Onigashima

Organization
The crew follows a strength-based hierarchy where rank is earned, challenged, and replaced through power.

Hierarchy
- Governor-General: Kaidou
- Top Executives: All-Stars
- Elite Senior Officers: Tobiroppo
- Officers: Shinuchi
- Elite Soldiers: Gifters
- Mid-Level Soldiers: Pleasures
- Lower Soldiers: Waiters
- Special Units: Numbers, Marys

System
- Advancement is based on strength
- Superiors may be challenged by stronger members
- Internal rivalry is normalized
- Strong outsiders may be recruited or broken into submission

All-Stars
The All-Stars are Kaidou’s highest-ranking officers and strongest subordinates.

Members
- King
- Queen
- Jack

Role
- Top authority under Kaidou
- Executive command
- Oversight of major operations

Traits
- Ancient Zoan users
- Extreme combat power
- Personal command authority

Tobiroppo
The Tobiroppo are elite officers directly below the All-Stars.

Role
- Elite strike force
- High-authority officers
- Candidates for All-Star promotion

Traits
- Mostly Ancient Zoan users
- Command Gifter divisions
- Handle sensitive missions

Shinuchi
The Shinuchi are upper officers who command lower divisions and oversee operations.

Role
- Lead lower-ranked troops
- Govern areas, ships, prisons, or missions
- Serve as field officers

Gifters
Gifters are elite SMILE users and the crew’s main enhanced soldier class.

Traits
- Artificial Zoan abilities
- Core combat force
- Stronger than standard rank-and-file troops

Pleasures
Pleasures are failed SMILE users with no animal powers.

Traits
- Permanent forced laughter
- Standard Devil Fruit weakness
- Rank above Waiters

Waiters
Waiters are the lowest-ranking soldiers still awaiting SMILE enhancement.

Traits
- Standard foot soldiers
- No SMILE traits

Numbers
The Numbers are giant experimental beings used as brute-force assets.

Traits
- Massive size
- Great physical strength
- Monstrous appearance

Marys
The Marys are the crew’s surveillance and communications unit.

Role
- Monitor activity
- Relay information
- Enable internal broadcasting

Traits
- Human and animal-based members
- Used for spying, detection, and communication

Support Structure
The crew expands its power through military alliances, resource systems, and forced incorporation of outsiders.

Major Support
- Wano’s labor and ruling structure
- Weapons production
- SMILE supply network
- Absorbed crews and outside fighters

Territory
The Beasts Pirates control fortified New World territory used for warfare and resource production.

Known Holdings
- Wano Country
- Onigashima
- Additional protected islands

Strength
The Beasts Pirates are one of the world’s strongest pirate forces.

Power Factors
- Emperor-level captain
- Massive membership
- Top-heavy command structure
- Large SMILE user population
- Ancient Zoan-heavy upper ranks
- Surveillance network
- Weapons production
- Seastone access
- Biological and chemical weapon use
- Forced recruitment and brutal discipline

Military Identity
The crew emphasizes:
- overwhelming force
- Zoan militarization
- occupation rule
- internal competition
- warlike culture

Weaknesses
- Fear-based hierarchy
- Internal hostility
- Unstable SMILE system
- Dependence on outside production networks

claves: Organization that Places Bounties on Marines
entradas.resumen: Cross Guild is a New World criminal organization operating as an underworld syndicate and mercenary network. Leadership
entradas.texto:
Definition
Cross Guild is a New World criminal organization operating as an underworld syndicate and mercenary network.

Leadership
- Public Leader: Buggy (figurehead, recognized as Emperor)
- True Leaders: Crocodile and Dracule Mihawk (founders, operational control)

Origin
- Founded by Crocodile and Mihawk
- Formed by absorbing Buggy’s Delivery
- Buggy was unintentionally positioned as leader for public image

Role
- Provides mercenary, security, and black market services
- Acts as a major underworld power with financial and military influence

Core System

Marine Bounty System
Cross Guild issues bounties on Marines, reversing the World Government system.

Function
- Encourages civilians and bounty hunters to target Marines
- Undermines Marine authority and reduces their operational activity
- Expands underworld influence through destabilization

Bounty Structure
- ★ = ~100,000,000 Beli
- Crown = ~1,000,000,000 Beli

General Scaling
- Fleet Admiral: multiple crowns
- Admiral: crowns
- Vice Admiral: stars
- Lower ranks: reduced values

Note
Exceptional individuals may exceed standard rank-based values.

Structure

Members
- Core leadership (Buggy, Crocodile, Mihawk)
- Former Baroque Works agents
- Buggy Pirates and ex-Delivery members
- Impel Down escapees

Allies
- Supported by Underworld organizations

Strength
- High financial, military, and political influence
- Led by former Warlords (high combat capability)
- Collective bounty in the billions

Impact
- Threatens Marine stability and morale
- Creates internal distrust between Marines and civilians
- Alters global power balance

Objective
- Initially tied to Crocodile’s plans
- Now actively competing for the One Piece

entradas.resumen: The Vinsmoke Family is a royal bloodline that rules the Germa Kingdom and commands the military force Germa 66.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Vinsmoke Family is a royal bloodline that rules the Germa Kingdom and commands the military force Germa 66.

Role
They function as a ruling dynasty and an underworld mercenary power, combining political authority with direct military command.

Affiliation
- Germa Kingdom
- Germa 66

Authority
- Sovereign rulers of a mobile kingdom
- Commanders of their own military force
- Possess influence within global systems (e.g. bounty authority, political recognition)

Operations
- Conduct mercenary warfare through Germa 66
- Engage in military campaigns to expand influence
- Maintain active presence in the Underworld

Reputation
- Infamous across the Underworld
- Recognized globally as a powerful and dangerous royal family

Military Power

1. Germa 66
- Standing army under direct family command
- Highly disciplined and expendable forces
- Absolute obedience to royal authority

2. Clone Army
- Mass-produced soldiers
- Programmed for loyalty and sacrifice
- Used for large-scale warfare

3. Command Protocol
- Soldiers can be ordered to shield royals directly (e.g. defensive formations)

Scientific Power

1. Genetic Engineering
- Family members enhanced for superhuman combat ability
- Designed as elite military commanders

2. Cloning Technology
- Enables continuous army production

3. Raid Suits
- Advanced combat gear
- Grants flight, mobility boosts, and enhanced attack power
- Stored in compact canisters and deployed instantly

Structure
- Patriarch-led hierarchy
- One daughter and multiple sons
- Children engineered for specialized combat roles

Characteristics
- Blend of royalty, military command, and scientific advancement
- Direct involvement in combat unlike typical royal families
- Operate as both a nation and a military organization

entradas.resumen: Germa 66 is the military force of the Germa Kingdom and an Underworld mercenary army led by the Vinsmoke Family.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Germa 66 is the military force of the Germa Kingdom and an Underworld mercenary army led by the Vinsmoke Family.

Role
- National military power
- Mercenary force for hire
- Technology-driven warfare organization

Reputation
- Feared worldwide as an “evil army”
- Known in the Underworld and active seas
- Considered mythical by uninformed regions

Operations
- Military conquest and large-scale warfare
- Contract-based mercenary missions
- Rapid elimination of enemy forces

Rules
- Accept missions based on profit
- Do not engage both sides of the same conflict

Military Power
- Capable of defeating entire nations quickly
- Highly mobile across multiple seas
- Large-scale, coordinated combat force

Technology
- Advanced military science and weaponry
- Continuous development through warfare

Enhancements
- Genetically modified commanders with superior abilities
- Combat gear enabling flight, mobility, and power boosts
- Electromagnetic-based weapon systems

Structure

Command
- Led by Vinsmoke Judge (Supreme Commander)
- Command hierarchy includes Vinsmoke family leaders

Scientific Unit
- Develops military technology and enhancements
- Responsible for cloning and genetic modification systems

Clone Army
- Primary military force composed of artificial soldiers

Clone Types
- Type-WB (Woman Balance)
- Type-MB (Man Balance)
- Type-MR (Man Reach)
- Type-MH (Man Heavy)
- Type-MST (Man Strong)
- Type-MSP (Man Speed)

Clone Traits
- Mass-produced and stored in capsules
- Physically varied builds
- Constant training outside combat
- Absolute obedience to commands
- Programmed loyalty, including self-sacrifice

Symbol
- “66” used across uniforms, equipment, and ships
- Variants include skull-like design with stylized digits

Uniform
Soldiers
- Dark suits with “66” marking
- Covered headgear, goggles, and combat gear

Commanders
- Raid Suits stored in capsules
- Fire-resistant, form-fitting combat systems
- Number-coded per user

entradas.resumen: The Five Families of the West are five major mafia organizations that control Underworld operations in West Blue. Affiliation
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Five Families of the West are five major mafia organizations that control Underworld operations in West Blue.

Affiliation
- Underworld

Type
- Mafia Organizations

Location
- West Blue

Power
- Combined bounty: at least 300,000,000 Beli

Structure
- Composed of five independent crime families
- Control regional illegal activities and influence

Instability
- Power structure was frequently disrupted by internal conflict

Notable Factor
Capone Bege
- Eliminated rival bosses to destabilize the hierarchy

Status

entradas.resumen: The Yakuza are organized underworld groups in Wano Country that operate outside the law and control illicit economic activity.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Yakuza are organized underworld groups in Wano Country that operate outside the law and control illicit economic activity.

Role
They function as a major economic and social force, regulating underground businesses and maintaining local order through authority and influence.

Operations
- Casino management and gambling control
- Red-light district involvement (courtesans, pleasure halls)
- Protection, enforcement, and financial control over businesses

Reputation
- Maintained a generally positive public image under structured leadership
- Known for discipline, honor codes, and controlled conduct
- Respected by both citizens and subordinate groups

Structure
- Organized into multiple families led by bosses
- Regional bosses govern specific areas
- Central leadership holds authority over subordinate families

Hierarchy
- Family Boss (Oyabun)
- Subordinate Officers
- General Members

Territorial Control
Each major region is overseen by a designated boss, forming a distributed but unified system of control.

Internal Relations
- Strong internal loyalty reinforced through formal bonds (e.g., sake exchange)
- Protection extends to all members regardless of rank
- Rivalries between families exist but are regulated by hierarchy

Affiliations
- Connected to national power structures
- Operate within the broader underworld network

claves: Family of the Will of D
entradas.resumen: The Davy Family is an ancient bloodline of Will of D. carriers descended from the pirate Davy D. Jones. Status
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Davy Family is an ancient bloodline of Will of D. carriers descended from the pirate Davy D. Jones.

Status
- Extant
- Affiliated with God Valley (historically)

Lineage
- Descendants of Davy D. Jones
- All known members carry the Will of D.

Notable Members
- Davy D. Jones
- Rocks D. Xebec (born Davy D. Xebec)
- Marshall D. Teach

Overview
The family is associated with the origin of the Davy Back Fight and holds significant historical influence.

Persecution
- Targeted by the World Government due to lineage and Will of D.
- Forced into secrecy and Underworld activity
- Many resided in God Valley to avoid detection

Threat Status
- Considered high-risk to the World Government and Celestial Dragons
- Specifically targeted during major events (e.g., Native Hunting Competition)

entradas.resumen: The Charlotte Family is the ruling family of Totto Land and the core foundation of the Big Mom Pirates, led by Charlotte Linlin.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Charlotte Family is the ruling family of Totto Land and the core foundation of the Big Mom Pirates, led by Charlotte Linlin.

Structure
- Matriarch: Charlotte Linlin (Big Mom)
- Total Children: 85 (39 daughters, 46 sons)
- Husbands: 43 (temporary, non-retained)

Composition
- Includes multiple generations (children + grandchildren)
- Built through political marriages to strengthen alliances

Birth Pattern
- Continuous childbirth over decades
- Includes multiple births (twins, triplets, etc.)

Role
- Serves as both a bloodline and military force
- Forms the main structure of the Big Mom Pirates
- Used to establish alliances through arranged marriages

Family System

Husbands
- Selected for reproduction only
- Discarded after childbirth
- Considered outsiders; expendable

Children
- Forced into political marriages
- Subject to strict control and punishment
- Not protected from Linlin’s violence

Siblings
- Operate as a coordinated force for missions
- Maintain hierarchy (respect toward older siblings)
- Relationships vary between cooperation and internal conflict

In-Laws
- Often align with their spouse over the family
- May oppose the Charlotte Family if interests conflict

Authority
- Absolute control held by Charlotte Linlin
- Defiance is met with severe punishment or death

Behavioral Traits
- Fear-based loyalty toward Linlin
- Internal relationships range from cooperative to hostile
- Some members show independence or betrayal

Status
- Active

entradas.resumen: World Government Organizations are the official groups operating under the authority of the World Government. Scope Includes all named organizations that function as part of the World Government’s structure.
entradas.texto:
Definition
World Government Organizations are the official groups operating under the authority of the World Government.

Scope
Includes all named organizations that function as part of the World Government’s structure.

Role
These organizations handle governance, enforcement, intelligence, and military operations.

claves: Kings Who Defeated the Great Kingdom
entradas.resumen: The First Twenty were twenty monarchs who formed the original alliance that defeated the Great Kingdom and founded the World Government.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The First Twenty were twenty monarchs who formed the original alliance that defeated the Great Kingdom and founded the World Government.

Role
They established the global ruling system that became the World Government.

Origin
- Formed ~800 years ago during the Void Century
- United as the “Alliance” to fight the Great Kingdom and Joy Boy
- Achieved victory and reshaped world order

Aftermath
- 19 families relocated to Mary Geoise
- 1 family (Nefertari) remained in their homeland (Arabasta)

World Government Formation
- Their alliance expanded into the modern World Government
- Their descendants became the ruling class

Legacy

Celestial Dragons
- Descendants of the 19 families in Mary Geoise
- Hold highest authority within the World Government
- Possess absolute privilege and legal immunity

Empty Throne Pact
- 19 monarchs placed weapons around the throne
- Symbolizes no single ruler should exist

Exception

Imu
- Sole known surviving member
- Secretly rules from the Empty Throne
- Contradicts the original pact

Nefertari Family
- Only founding family that refused relocation
- Did not become World Nobles

claves: Highest Authority of the World Government
Highest Authorities of the World Government
entradas.resumen: The Five Elders are the five highest-ranking public authorities of the World Government and the highest-ranking Celestial Dragons. Despite this status, they are secretly subordinate to Imu.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Five Elders are the five highest-ranking public authorities of the World Government and the highest-ranking Celestial Dragons. Despite this status, they are secretly subordinate to Imu.

Role
They serve as the executive leadership of the World Government, overseeing major political affairs, law enforcement, secrecy, and world balance.

Residence
- Mary Geoise
- Room of Authority in Pangaea Castle

Members
Current
- Figarland Garling
- Marcus Mars
- Topman Warcury
- Ethanbaron V. Nusjuro
- Shepherd Ju Peter

Former
- Jaygarcia Saturn

Structure
Each Elder holds the title of Warrior God and oversees a major field of government.

Fields
- Science and Defense
- Environment
- Justice
- Finance
- Agriculture

Authority
The Five Elders publicly stand at the top of the World Government’s chain of command.

Powers of Rule
- command Cipher Pol, especially CP0
- direct the Marines
- authorize extreme government action
- influence censorship and information control
- oversee weapons, military projects, and state operations

Functions
- maintain the balance of the world
- preserve World Government dominance
- suppress forbidden history, especially Void Century research
- respond to major global threats and political changes

Secrecy
- Rarely appear in public
- Their presence is heavily restricted
- Marines below a certain rank are not permitted to witness them
- Their authority is treated with near-mythical reverence

Social Status
- Consider themselves above other Celestial Dragons
- Possess extreme privilege and political supremacy
- Expect absolute deference from subordinates and commoners

Relationship to Imu
Though publicly supreme, the Five Elders are servants of Imu and carry out Imu’s will without question.

Loyalty
- obey Imu’s commands
- protect Imu’s existence from the world
- may be punished or replaced directly by Imu

Notable Succession
Saturn was killed by Imu and replaced by Figarland Garling.

Enemies and Targets
The Five Elders oppose individuals and groups that threaten World Government control.

Major Targets
- Monkey D. Luffy
- Nico Robin
- Ohara archaeologists
- Dr. Vegapunk
- other threats to hidden history or political order

Political Power
They possess near-total executive authority within the World Government.

Capabilities
- issue Buster Calls
- command Admirals and CP0
- control official narratives and suppression efforts
- influence military and scientific programs

Covenant
The Five Elders bear a Covenant granted by Imu.

Effects
- telepathic communication
- immortality
- access to Abyss portals
- vulnerability to Imu’s direct control and execution

Immortality
They possess extreme regeneration and do not visibly age, allowing them to survive otherwise fatal injuries.

Abyss
They can use special summoning circles to travel or summon one another across great distances.

Combat Ability
The Five Elders possess immense combat power in addition to political authority.

Traits
- monstrous durability
- overwhelming Haki
- Mythical Zoan abilities
- power sufficient to directly challenge top-tier fighters

Devil Fruits
The original Elders possessed awakened Mythical Zoan-type powers with unique beast forms.

Haki
They possess exceptionally powerful Haki, with some demonstrating Supreme King Haki and others multiple Haki types.

Significance
The Five Elders are among the central ruling forces of the World Government and major antagonistic powers in the final stage of the story.

entradas.resumen: Levely is a quadrennial global council held by the World Government where selected rulers meet to discuss world affairs.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Levely is a quadrennial global council held by the World Government where selected rulers meet to discuss world affairs.

Role
It serves as the highest political summit, influencing global decisions and policies.

Location
- Held at Pangaea Castle in Mary Geoise
- Duration: 7 days
- Occurs every 4 years

Participants
- 50 selected rulers from World Government-affiliated nations (out of 170+)
- Monarchs may bring family members, guards, or escorts

Selection
- Invitations based on status, influence, or circumstances
- Some rulers may be excluded due to political events or conditions

Procedures
- All attendees are disarmed during the meeting
- Rulers pledge allegiance before the Empty Throne
- Chairman role rotates among participants

Authority Influence
- Decisions can impact the entire world
- World Nobles may intervene freely despite not being formal participants

Risks

1. External Threats
- Pirate attacks on traveling monarchs or their nations
- Infiltration attempts targeting Mary Geoise

2. Internal Conflict
- Political tensions between rulers can escalate into conflict

3. Government Control
- Five Elders and Imu hold ultimate authority
- Monarchs deemed threats may be eliminated and replaced or framed

4. Noble Interference
- World Nobles can act without restriction, including harming attendees
- CP0 enforces their will

Security
- Heavy Marine presence around the Red Line
- Ongoing surveillance and protection during the event

entradas.resumen: Cipher Pol is a network of secret intelligence agencies operating under the World Government, specializing in investigation, espionage, and assassination.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Cipher Pol is a network of secret intelligence agencies operating under the World Government, specializing in investigation, espionage, and assassination.

Role
They function as the World Government’s covert enforcement and counter-insurgency force, targeting political threats and maintaining control beyond standard law enforcement.

Authority
- Operate independently of Marine jurisdiction
- Authorized to eliminate threats to World Government interests
- Restricted from engaging major global powers without approval

Structure
Cipher Pol is divided into multiple numbered units:
- CP1–CP8: standard intelligence and enforcement branches
- CP9: top-secret unit with full lethal authority
- CP0: elite unit serving directly under the World Nobles

Hierarchy Rule
Higher-numbered units are assigned more critical and sensitive operations.

Operations
- intelligence gathering and surveillance
- espionage and infiltration
- assassination and covert enforcement
- monitoring global communications (e.g. Den Den Mushi)

Recruitment
- Select individuals from across the world, including the underworld
- May influence or support Marine recruitment

Agents

Training
- Intensive conditioning from a young age (elite units)
- Emphasis on loyalty, discipline, and mission execution

Combat System
Six Powers (Rokushiki)
- Advanced martial arts style used by agents
- Enhances physical capabilities beyond normal human limits

Characteristics
- Emotion suppression and duty-first mindset
- Specialized skillsets for covert operations
- Operate in secrecy depending on unit classification

Function Distinction
- Marines: public military and law enforcement
- Cipher Pol: covert operations and political control

entradas.resumen: World Nobles, also called Celestial Dragons, are the aristocratic descendants of nineteen of the First Twenty who founded the World Government. Status They are the highest social class in the world and are treated as sacred nobility above ordinary law.
entradas.texto:
Definition
World Nobles, also called Celestial Dragons, are the aristocratic descendants of nineteen of the First Twenty who founded the World Government.

Status
They are the highest social class in the world and are treated as sacred nobility above ordinary law.

Residence
They live in Mary Geoise, primarily within the Domain of the Gods.

Authority
- Protected by the World Government
- Served by guards, staff, slaves, CP0, and even Marine Admirals when necessary
- Possess extreme political, legal, and social privilege

Origin
Their status descends from the royal families who relocated to Mary Geoise after founding the World Government.
- The Nefertari Family refused this role and did not become World Nobles

Identity
- Recognized as “Saints”
- Carry government-issued status identification
- Consider themselves separate from ordinary humans

Social Position
World Nobles view the outside world as the Lower World and regard common people as inherently beneath them.

Privileges
- Can travel with heavy protection
- Can command government resources
- Can enslave or claim people at will
- Can force state actors to serve their interests
- Can summon an Admiral in response to direct threats

Status Loss
A World Noble may renounce their status, but once lost, it cannot be reclaimed.
- Their family also loses noble protection and privilege

Outsider Access
Outsiders cannot normally become World Nobles.
Exceptions are rare and tied to extraordinary political value or direct approval from the highest authorities.

Sub-Groups

Five Elders
- Highest-ranking World Nobles
- Oversee the World Government and global affairs

Knights of God
- Armed elite with authority over noble disputes and enforcement
- May include non-Nobles in their ranks

Symbol

Hoof of the Soaring Dragon
- Official symbol of the World Nobles
- Used to brand slaves as marks of ownership

Culture

Belief System
- Claim the blood of the world’s creators
- View themselves as gods
- Place bloodline above justice, law, and morality

Lifestyle
- Extremely wealthy, hedonistic, and insulated
- Live through luxury, servants, and forced labor
- Depend on imported goods and the Heavenly Tribute

View of Commoners
- Treat non-Nobles as inferior
- Expect obedience, fear, and submission
- Frequently respond to resistance with violence or punishment

Law in the Holy Land
World Nobles are largely above ordinary law, but they can be punished if they act against other World Nobles.
- Judgment is carried out by the Knights of God

Economic Power

Heavenly Tribute
- Massive tax imposed on World Government-affiliated nations
- Major source of noble wealth
- Failure to pay can result in political ruin or exposure to outside threats

Slavery
Slavery is a core part of World Noble society.
- Slaves are branded with the Hoof of the Soaring Dragon
- Used for labor, transport, status, and personal abuse
- Escape is suppressed through violence, restraints, and intimidation

Traditions

Native Hunting Competition
- A recurring event where selected islands are used as hunting grounds
- Targets unaffiliated populations and resource-rich territories

Secrets
- Possess a hidden national treasure in Mary Geoise
- Maintain secrecy over the Void Century and other hidden history

Abilities and Power

Political Power
- Their influence shapes global policy and World Government behavior
- Their decisions can alter kingdoms, laws, and international affairs

Military Reach
- Can command CP0
- Can call Admirals for protection or retaliation
- High-ranking World Nobles such as the Five Elders and Knights of God possess major combat power

General Capability
Most ordinary World Nobles are not strong fighters and rely on inherited authority, protection, and state-backed force rather than personal ability.

Appearance
Typical World Nobles wear distinctive white noble attire and often use bubbles or helmets outside Mary Geoise to avoid breathing the same air as commoners.

entradas.resumen: CP5 is an official Cipher Pol unit operating publicly under the World Government.
entradas.texto:
Definition
CP5 is an official Cipher Pol unit operating publicly under the World Government.

Role
They handle government investigations and high-level missions requiring discretion but not full secrecy.

Authority
- Recognized branch of Cipher Pol
- Operates openly compared to covert units

Operations
- Retrieval missions (e.g. Pluton blueprints)
- Investigations into sensitive topics (e.g. Void Century research)

Reliability
- Considered trusted enough for important assignments
- Not fully effective, with recorded mission failures

Leadership
- Led by a figure with authority to influence justice-related decisions

Specialty
- Specific specialization unknown

claves: サイファーポールナンバーシックス
entradas.resumen: CP6 (Cipher Pol Number 6) is an official intelligence unit under the World Government.
entradas.texto:
Definition
CP6 (Cipher Pol Number 6) is an official intelligence unit under the World Government.

Role
They function as a mid-tier Cipher Pol branch responsible for investigative and support operations.

Specialty
- Unknown / not publicly defined
- Operate in both intelligence gathering and field support roles

Functions
- Information collection and documentation
- Infiltration and covert surveillance
- Support for higher Cipher Pol units during operations

Structure
- Composed of multiple field agents
- Operates under World Government authority
- Functions as part of the broader Cipher Pol network hierarchy

Position in Cipher Pol
- Lower than elite units such as CP9 and CP0
- Utilized for auxiliary and investigative assignments

entradas.resumen: CP7 (Cipher Pol Number 7) is a World Government intelligence unit within the Cipher Pol network.
entradas.texto:
Definition
CP7 (Cipher Pol Number 7) is a World Government intelligence unit within the Cipher Pol network.

Role
They function as a mid-tier branch supporting higher Cipher Pol units in operations.

Specialty
- Unknown / not publicly defined

Functions
- Support for higher-tier units (e.g., CP9)
- Assistance in transport and escort operations
- General intelligence and field support duties

Structure
- Composed of multiple agents
- Operates under World Government authority
- Integrated within the Cipher Pol hierarchy

Position in Cipher Pol
- Below elite units such as CP9 and CP0
- Utilized for auxiliary and support assignments

entradas.resumen: CP9 (Cipher Pol Number 9) is a covert World Government intelligence unit specializing in assassination and high-risk operations. Status Officially nonexistent; operates in secrecy outside public recognition.
entradas.texto:
Definition
CP9 (Cipher Pol Number 9) is a covert World Government intelligence unit specializing in assassination and high-risk operations.

Status
Officially nonexistent; operates in secrecy outside public recognition.

Role
Executes sensitive missions requiring elimination, infiltration, and covert enforcement.

Specialty
- Assassination
- Espionage
- Covert operations

Functions
- Target elimination
- Intelligence gathering
- Infiltration of hostile or restricted areas
- Enforcement of classified World Government directives

Structure
- Composed of elite, highly trained agents
- Operates under strict secrecy protocols
- Functions independently from standard military branches

Position in Cipher Pol
- One of the highest-level operational units within the Cipher Pol network
- Specialized beyond standard intelligence divisions

entradas.resumen: CP0 is the highest and strongest unit within the Cipher Pol intelligence network. Authority
entradas.texto:
Definition
CP0 is the highest and strongest unit within the Cipher Pol intelligence network.

Authority
- Operates directly under the World Nobles
- Functions above standard World Government command structures

Role
- Executes high-level intelligence, enforcement, and covert operations
- Acts as the direct agents of the ruling authority

Position
- Superior to all other Cipher Pol units
- Represents the peak of government-controlled covert power

Presence
- Their deployment signifies matters of extreme global importance
- Associated with large-scale or world-impacting situations

entradas.resumen: Marine Ranks define the hierarchical structure of the Marines under the World Government. Known as Marine Commissioned Officer. Hierarchy Ranks are clearly delineated, with Marine Headquarters officers considered significantly stronger than equivalent…
entradas.texto:
Definition
Marine Ranks define the hierarchical structure of the Marines under the World Government. Known as Marine Commissioned Officer.

Hierarchy
Ranks are clearly delineated, with Marine Headquarters officers considered significantly stronger than equivalent ranks at other bases.

Training
- Ranks from Lieutenant and above are typically trained at Headquarters
- Exceptions include officers assigned to external bases

Uniform System

General Rules
- No strict insignia system
- Uniforms vary by rank and personal choice
- Marines may use any weapon or fight unarmed

Standard Uniform (Low Ranks)
- White shirt with Marine emblem
- Blue neckerchief
- Dark trousers
- "MARINE" cap

Customization
- Petty Officer and above may wear personal clothing
- Higher ranks adopt more formal or symbolic attire

Justice Coat
- Worn by Ensign and above
- Displays "Justice" on the back
- Often worn as a cape

Formal Attire
- Lieutenant Commander and above commonly wear suits beneath the coat

Rank Structure (Highest to Lowest)

Commissioned Officers
- Fleet Admiral
- Admiral
- Vice Admiral
- Rear Admiral
- Commodore
- Captain
- Commander
- Lieutenant Commander
- Lieutenant
- Ensign

Infantry / Sailor Division
- Warrant Officer
- Master Chief Petty Officer
- Chief Petty Officer
- Petty Officer
- Seaman First Class
- Seaman Apprentice
- Seaman Recruit
- Chore Boy

Support Roles
- Base Commander
- Inspector General
- Cook
- Doctor
- Scientist

entradas.resumen: Fleet Admiral (元帥 Gensui) is the highest rank in the Marines and the commander of the entire organization. Authority
entradas.texto:
Definition
Fleet Admiral (元帥 Gensui) is the highest rank in the Marines and the commander of the entire organization.

Authority
- Commands all Marine forces
- Ranked above Admirals
- Subordinate only to the World Government Commander-in-Chief and the Five Elders

Powers
- Can initiate a Buster Call
- Can authorize others (agents or Marines) to initiate one
- Can revoke Warlord of the Sea status

Position
- One Fleet Admiral exists at a time

Appearance
- Typically wears a white suit
- Features gold epaulettes and stylized variations depending on the individual

entradas.resumen: Admiral is the second-highest rank in the Marines, positioned below Fleet Admiral and above Vice Admiral. Rank Structure
entradas.texto:
Definition
Admiral is the second-highest rank in the Marines, positioned below Fleet Admiral and above Vice Admiral.

Rank Structure
- Limited to three active positions
- Among the highest authorities within the Marine organization

Status
- Considered the World Government’s greatest military powers
- Represent the strongest active Marine officers
- Feared and respected globally

Authority

Command
- Control large-scale Marine forces
- Operate as top field commanders

Buster Call
- Authorized to initiate Buster Calls
- Can grant permission to others to use it

Government Authority
- Can revoke Warlord status with sufficient cause
- Can authorize exceptions or pardons under government systems

Chain of Command
- Directly subordinate to:
  - Fleet Admiral
  - Five Elders
  - World Government Commander-in-Chief

Special Obligation
- Serve as enforcers for the World Nobles
- Must prioritize the safety and authority of the World Nobles

Duties

Deployment
- Assigned to major threats (high-level pirates, large-scale incidents)
- Act as reinforcement for Marine operations when required

Protection
- Serve as escorts or defense for high-ranking government figures

Mobility
- Typically stationed at Marine Headquarters
- Can operate independently when not on assignment

Restrictions
- Must follow Marine and World Government directives
- Actions cannot endanger World Nobles
- Subject to consequences if acting outside authority

entradas.resumen: Vice Admiral is the third highest rank in the Marines.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Vice Admiral is the third highest rank in the Marines.

Role
They serve as high-level officers with authority over fleets, operations, and other Marine personnel.

Authority
- Can command other officers and Vice Admirals
- May authorize engagement against major threats (e.g., Emperors)
- Core participants in large-scale operations (e.g., Buster Call; minimum of five deployed)

Abilities
- Possess high combat capability
- Commonly skilled in swordsmanship
- Many can use Rokushiki (Six Powers)
- All possess at least one form of Haki

Traits
- Rank includes some of the strongest Marines (including Giants)
