- Authority and responsibilities vary by individual

Bounty Status
- Most Vice Admirals have a bounty of 500,000,000 Beli (post Cross Guild system)

Appearance
- Standard Marine coat with epaulets over formal attire
- Variations in uniform and epaulet color may occur

entradas.resumen: Rear Admiral (少将 Shōshō) is the fourth highest rank in the Marines. Authority
entradas.texto:
Definition
Rear Admiral (少将 Shōshō) is the fourth highest rank in the Marines.

Authority
- Commands all lower-ranking Marines
- Holds full operational control within assigned scope

Role
Rear Admirals are high-level officers known for strong combat ability and leadership.

Special Status
- Some are granted additional authority based on rank, reputation, or assignment (e.g., Headquarters officers)

Requirement
- Minimum rank required to be permitted audience with the Five Elders

entradas.resumen: Commodore (准将 Junshō) is the fifth highest rank in the Marines. Authority
entradas.texto:
Definition
Commodore (准将 Junshō) is the fifth highest rank in the Marines.

Authority
- Commands all lower-ranking Marines
- Handles operations beyond Captain-level responsibility

Role
Commodores oversee high-priority matters and enforce Marine authority at an elevated level.

Special Status
- Headquarters Commodores may hold responsibilities equal to higher ranks
- Example: bounty assignment and direct reporting to the Fleet Admiral

entradas.resumen: Captain is the sixth highest rank in the Marines.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Captain is the sixth highest rank in the Marines.

Role
Captains serve as mid-to-high level officers responsible for leadership, enforcement, and combat operations.

Command
- May command Marine bases or branches across islands
- Often lead ships when no higher-ranking officer is present
- Any ship commander may be addressed as "Captain" regardless of rank (naval custom)

Duties
- Capture pirates and maintain order at sea
- Oversee lower-ranking Marines
- Report threats and influence bounty assignments
- Participate in large-scale operations (e.g., Buster Call support)

Abilities
- Highly skilled combatants with strong experience
- May possess:
  - Devil Fruit powers
  - Haki
  - Advanced combat techniques (e.g., Rokushiki)
- Capable of leadership and tactical decision-making

Positioning
- Can act as base commanders
- May serve under higher-ranking officers (e.g., Vice Admirals)
- Operate independently or within larger Marine structures

Corruption
- Some captains abuse authority (extortion, bribery, neglect of duty)
- Exposure can result in demotion or imprisonment
- Corruption varies depending on oversight and concealment

Value (Cross Guild)
- Standard: 1 Star (~100,000,000 Beli)
- Exceptions exist for notable individuals

entradas.resumen: Commander is the seventh highest rank in the Marines. Position
entradas.texto:
Definition
Commander is the seventh highest rank in the Marines.

Position
- Mid-level officer rank
- Below Captain, above Lieutenant Commander

entradas.resumen: Lieutenant Commander (少佐, Shōsa) is the eighth highest rank in the Marines. Notes
entradas.texto:
Definition
Lieutenant Commander (少佐, Shōsa) is the eighth highest rank in the Marines.

Notes
- Sometimes localized as "Major"

entradas.resumen: Lieutenant (大尉, Taii) is the ninth highest rank in the Marines.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Lieutenant (大尉, Taii) is the ninth highest rank in the Marines.

entradas.resumen: Lieutenant Junior Grade (中尉, Chūi) is a Marine rank. Rank
entradas.texto:
Definition
Lieutenant Junior Grade (中尉, Chūi) is a Marine rank.

Rank
- 10th highest rank within the Marines

entradas.resumen: Ensign (少尉 Shōi) is the lowest commissioned officer rank in the Marines. Rank Position
entradas.texto:
Definition
Ensign (少尉 Shōi) is the lowest commissioned officer rank in the Marines.

Rank Position
- Eleventh highest overall Marine rank
- Final entry rank within commissioned officers

Authority
- Permitted to wear the “Justice” (正義 Seigi) kanji on their uniform

entradas.resumen: Warrant Officer (准尉, Jun'i) is the twelfth highest rank in the Marines. Rank Position
entradas.texto:
Definition
Warrant Officer (准尉, Jun'i) is the twelfth highest rank in the Marines.

Rank Position
- Highest rank within the Infantry and Sailor Division

entradas.resumen: Master Chief Petty Officer (曹長, Sōchō) is a high-ranking enlisted Marine position. Rank
entradas.texto:
Definition
Master Chief Petty Officer (曹長, Sōchō) is a high-ranking enlisted Marine position.

Rank
- 13th highest rank in the Marine hierarchy

Notes
- Sometimes translated as Petty Officer First Class

entradas.resumen: Chief Petty Officer (軍曹, Gunsō) is a mid-level Marine rank. Rank
entradas.texto:
Definition
Chief Petty Officer (軍曹, Gunsō) is a mid-level Marine rank.

Rank
- Fourteenth highest rank in the Marines

Notes
- Sometimes referred to as Petty Officer Second Class

entradas.resumen: Petty Officer is the fifteenth rank in the Marines. Rank Position
entradas.texto:
Definition
Petty Officer is the fifteenth rank in the Marines.

Rank Position
- Lower-tier enlisted rank

Uniform
- Allowed flexible attire (uniform or civilian clothing)
- Most retain standard sailor-style uniforms

entradas.resumen: Seaman First Class is a Marine rank and the sixteenth position in the hierarchy.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Seaman First Class is a Marine rank and the sixteenth position in the hierarchy.

entradas.resumen: Seaman Apprentice (二等兵, Nitōhei) is the seventeenth rank in the Marines.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Seaman Apprentice (二等兵, Nitōhei) is the seventeenth rank in the Marines.

entradas.resumen: Seaman Recruit is the lowest rank in the Marines. Position
entradas.texto:
Definition
Seaman Recruit is the lowest rank in the Marines.

Position
- Eighteenth rank in the Marine hierarchy

Alias
- Recruit

entradas.resumen: Chore Boy (雑用 Zatsuyō) is the lowest rank in the Marines.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Chore Boy (雑用 Zatsuyō) is the lowest rank in the Marines.

Role
Entry-level personnel responsible for basic tasks and support duties.

Rank
- Lowest Marine rank

Appearance
- White Marine shirt (no insignia)
- Blue Marine trousers

entradas.resumen: Base Commander is the officer designated as the leader of a Marine base.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Base Commander is the officer designated as the leader of a Marine base.

Role
They oversee operations and authority within a specific base.

Assignment
- Typically the highest-ranking Marine stationed at the base
- Only one individual holds the commander position at a time

Note
Multiple Marines may share the same rank, but only one is officially assigned as Base Commander.

entradas.resumen: Inspector General (大目付 Ōmetsuke) is a special Marine rank responsible for investigating corruption, misconduct, and defection within the organization.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Inspector General (大目付 Ōmetsuke) is a special Marine rank responsible for investigating corruption, misconduct, and defection within the organization.

Role
- Detect maladministration
- Investigate internal violations
- Maintain organizational integrity

entradas.resumen: Instructor (教官 Kyōkan) is a Marine rank responsible for training recruits.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Instructor (教官 Kyōkan) is a Marine rank responsible for training recruits.

Role
They develop recruits’ strength and prepare them for advancement within the Marines.

Selection
- Often high-prestige or veteran Marines
- Retired or resigned members may be retained as instructors

entradas.resumen: The Marines are the World Government’s naval military force responsible for law enforcement, warfare, and global authority at sea. Affiliation
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Marines are the World Government’s naval military force responsible for law enforcement, warfare, and global authority at sea.

Affiliation
- World Government

Role
- Enforce law and order
- Hunt criminals (primarily pirates)
- Protect World Government interests
- Conduct naval and military operations

Status
- One of the Three Great Powers
- Major global military authority

Presence
- Active across all seas
- Numerous branch bases worldwide
- Main power concentrated in the Grand Line
- Headquarters: Marine Headquarters

Enlistment
- Entry via Marine bases with officer approval

Special Cases
- Forced enlistment possible
- Pardoned or recommended criminals may join
- SWORD members relinquish Marine Code

World Military Draft
A recruitment program drawing strong fighters from affiliated nations.

Effect
- Strengthens Marine forces
- Weakens contributing nations’ militaries

Duties
- Patrol and secure seas
- Capture and process criminals
- Transport prisoners
- Protect World Nobles
- Respond to large-scale threats and wars
- Execute operations
- Conduct intelligence and infiltration

Restrictions
- Only Rear Admirals and above may appear before the Five Elders
- Violation results in execution

Rank System

Commissioned Officers
- Fleet Admiral
- Admiral
- Vice Admiral
- Rear Admiral
- Commodore
- Captain
- Commander
- Lieutenant Commander
- Lieutenant
- Lieutenant Junior Grade
- Ensign

Enlisted / Non-Commissioned
- Warrant Officer
- Master Chief Petty Officer
- Chief Petty Officer
- Petty Officer
- Seaman First Class
- Seaman Apprentice
- Seaman Recruit / Recruit
- Chore Boy (unofficial)

Special Positions
- Inspector General
- Instructor
- Base Commander

Command Structure
- Officers command; enlisted execute
- Authority and strength scale with rank

Uniforms
- Standard uniforms for lower ranks
- Justice coat worn by Ensign+
- Higher ranks have increased freedom and variation

Promotion
- Promotions and demotions occur
- Promotions can be refused
- Demotions used as punishment or conditions

Divisions

Science Unit

Giant Squad

SWORD
- Operates independently of standard command
- Can be disavowed by the government

Bureau of Investigation
- Handles investigations and intelligence

Communications Department
- Monitors and intercepts Den Den Mushi transmissions

Photography Department
- Produces wanted posters

Military Power
The largest formal military force in the world.

Assets
- Global manpower
- Battleship fleets
- Admirals and elite officers
- Giants
- Pacifista
- Seraphim
- Former Warlord support

Buster Call
Definition
A large-scale destruction operation using 10 battleships and 5 Vice Admirals.

Authority
- Authorized by Admirals or Fleet Admiral
- Authority may be delegated

Headquarters
Marine Headquarters is the primary base and a major military fortress.

Justice
- Core ideology guiding Marines
- Interpretation varies by individual

Corruption
- Political influence and moral inconsistency present

Examples
- Obedience to unjust orders
- Propaganda and censorship
- Cooperation with Warlords
- Tolerance of slavery under World Nobles
- Civilian and subordinate mistreatment

Internal Conflict
- Individual Marines may uphold justice
- Institution prioritizes authority and control

entradas.resumen: Marine enlistment is the process of joining the Marines through approval by a ranking officer at a Marine base. Process
entradas.texto:
Definition
Marine enlistment is the process of joining the Marines through approval by a ranking officer at a Marine base.

Process
- Applicant reports to a Marine base
- Enlistment approved by a commanding officer
- Assigned rank, unit, and identification

Requirements
- No confirmed restrictions on gender
- No confirmed restrictions on nationality
- Primarily human, but other races accepted (e.g., giants, Longarm Tribe)

Standard Issue
- Rank assignment
- Unit placement
- Photo ID
- Marine Code (identification number)

Marine Code
- Used for identification and authorization
- Required for communication, verification, and operations (e.g., Buster Call access)

Special Cases

Forced Enlistment
- Individuals may be enlisted against their will

Criminal Entry
- Former criminals may join if pardoned or recommended by a Marine officer
- Some infiltrators enter undetected

SWORD Status
- Members relinquish their Marine Code
- Can be removed from the Marines at any time

Age
- No confirmed minimum age
- Known enlistments include teenagers and younger recruits

Security
- Background checks may be conducted
- Not fully reliable against infiltration

entradas.resumen: The World Military Draft is a World Government order to recruit powerful soldiers from affiliated nations to strengthen the Marines.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The World Military Draft is a World Government order to recruit powerful soldiers from affiliated nations to strengthen the Marines.

Purpose
- Increase overall Marine military power
- Acquire high-level fighters from across member countries

Consequences
- Weakened national militaries of participating countries
- Contributed to the Eight-Nation Revolution due to reduced defenses

entradas.resumen: SWORD is a secret Marine special force composed of operatives who have formally resigned from the command structure but continue to act on behalf of the Marines.
entradas.texto:
Definition
SWORD is a secret Marine special force composed of operatives who have formally resigned from the command structure but continue to act on behalf of the Marines.

Nature
Members are "Marines, but not officially," operating outside standard authority while retaining loyalty to the organization.

Authority Status
- No longer bound by Marine command hierarchy
- Free to ignore orders and act independently
- Actions are not recognized or protected by the World Government

Operational Freedom
- Can undertake high-risk or unauthorized missions
- May engage targets without approval
- Allowed to operate without standard restrictions or clearance

Liability
- The World Government and Marines hold no responsibility for their actions
- Members may be disavowed at any time
- No obligation exists to rescue captured operatives

Flexibility
- Can operate within Marine bases or alongside official units
- May act independently or in coordination when needed
- Can be reinstated into the Marine structure if necessary

Cover Operations
- Members may assume criminal or pirate identities to carry out missions

Internal Relations
- Operates separately from Cipher Pol divisions
- Limited coordination with other World Government agencies

Function
SWORD acts as a black-ops division within the Marines, handling missions requiring deniability, autonomy, and unrestricted action.

entradas.resumen: SSG (Special Science Group) is a Marine-affiliated scientific division responsible for advanced research and weapons development for the World Government.
entradas.texto:
Definition
SSG (Special Science Group) is a Marine-affiliated scientific division responsible for advanced research and weapons development for the World Government.

Role
It serves as the primary technological branch of the Marines, creating high-level military innovations and strategic weapon systems.

Affiliation
- Marines
- World Government

Leadership
- Led by Vegapunk

Base
- Egghead (primary research facility and residence)

Functions
- Research and development of advanced technology
- Creation of military-grade weapons and systems

Key Creations
- Pacifista
- Seraphim

Purpose
Designed to strengthen the World Government’s military power and act as a replacement force within the global power balance.

entradas.resumen: Seraphim are advanced living weapons created by the SSG, designed to replace the Seven Warlords as a power within the Three Great Powers.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Seraphim are advanced living weapons created by the SSG, designed to replace the Seven Warlords as a power within the Three Great Powers.

Origin
- Developed by the Special Science Group (SSG)
- Produced using Lineage Factor engineering and advanced cybernetics
- Stationed at Egghead

Design
- Clones modeled after former Warlords (youth forms)
- Augmented with Lunarian traits
- Integrated with Pacifista-level technology

Physical Traits
- Brown skin, white hair, black wings
- Flame on back (Lunarian trait)
- Star-shaped pupils
- PX designation markings

Biology
- Possess Lunarian Lineage Factor (enhanced durability and adaptive speed)
- Artificially grown with accelerated development
- Capable of aging and increasing in strength over time

Green Blood
- Synthetic substance enabling replication of Paramecia abilities
- Grants artificial Devil Fruit powers
- Subject to standard Devil Fruit weaknesses

Combat Capabilities
- Extremely high durability and resilience
- Enhanced physical strength and speed
- Equipped with built-in laser weaponry
- Capable of using Observation and Armament Haki

Lineage Inheritance
- Retain combat traits and skills from original templates
- Can inherit racial advantages depending on source DNA

Behavior
- Operate under programmed command structure
- Execute orders with minimal restraint
- Possess limited autonomy and decision-making

Authority System
Command hierarchy:
- Five Elders
- Vegapunk (all bodies)
- Sentomaru
- Authority chip holders

Rules
- Higher authority overrides lower commands
- Equal authority cannot override existing orders
- Direct presence required for command override

Role
- Serve as military assets of the World Government
- Function as replacements for the Warlords within global power balance

entradas.resumen: Giant Squad is a Marine unit composed of giant soldiers. Affiliation
entradas.texto:
Definition
Giant Squad is a Marine unit composed of giant soldiers.

Affiliation
- Marines

Role
- Heavy combat unit
- Assigned to high-security and critical operations

Composition
- Consists of multiple giants (at least eight confirmed)

entradas.resumen: Marine Headquarters Court is a judicial body of the Marines responsible for ruling on criminal cases. Affiliation
entradas.texto:
Definition
Marine Headquarters Court is a judicial body of the Marines responsible for ruling on criminal cases.

Affiliation
- Marines
- World Government

Structure
- Composed of three judges

Role
- Delivers final rulings on cases
- Has authority to remove an individual's criminal status

Behavior
- Judges vary in demeanor (stern, neutral, relaxed)
- Capable of discretionary decisions influenced by circumstances

entradas.resumen: Marine Headquarters is the central command division of the Marines, overseeing operations across the Grand Line.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Marine Headquarters is the central command division of the Marines, overseeing operations across the Grand Line.

Role
It serves as the primary military authority of the World Government and is one of the Three Great Powers.

Authority
- Direct jurisdiction over Grand Line operations
- Centralized command for Marine forces
- Strategic enforcement of global order

Personnel
- Staffed by elite Marines
- Standards exceed other bases (rank equivalency is higher than standard branches)

Structure
- Large-scale fortified military complex
- Designed as a defensive stronghold and command center
- Includes central headquarters tower and surrounding fortifications

Fortress Design
- Multi-layered defenses with heavy artillery
- Elevated central structure for command operations
- Reinforced perimeter with additional defensive installations

Surroundings
- Adjacent military-controlled zones
- May include residential and operational support areas
- Positioned near critical global routes for rapid deployment

Environmental Features
- Coastal access designed for large-scale naval movement

entradas.resumen: Buster Call is the highest-level Marine military operation used to completely annihilate a designated target.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Buster Call is the highest-level Marine military operation used to completely annihilate a designated target.

Role
It serves as the ultimate enforcement of Absolute Justice, eliminating threats to the World Government without regard for collateral damage.

Scale
- Standard force equals a nation-level military
- Default composition:
  - 10 battleships
  - 5 Vice Admirals
- Can be expanded depending on threat level

Authority
Only top-ranking authorities can initiate a Buster Call.

Authorized Individuals
- Fleet Admiral
- Admirals
- Five Elders
- Commander-in-Chief
- Possible: Imu

Delegation
Lower-ranking individuals may initiate it only if granted authority and a Golden Den Den Mushi.

Initiation
- Triggered using a Golden Den Den Mushi
- Signal is received by Marine Headquarters via a Silver Den Den Mushi
- Target location is immediately confirmed

Procedure
1. Fleet Deployment
- Nearest fleet is mobilized toward the target

2. Encirclement
- Target area is surrounded by battleships

3. Bombardment
- Coordinated artillery fire is launched
- Fire is triangulated to ensure full coverage

4. Total Destruction
- All life and structures within the target zone are eliminated

Rules
- Cannot be rescinded once confirmed
- Priority is total eradication of the target
- Collateral damage is disregarded

Target Scope
- Individuals
- Groups (e.g., pirate crews)
- Entire islands

Doctrine
- Based on Absolute Justice
- Eliminates current and potential threats preemptively

entradas.resumen: Blood Type is a biological classification based on substances present in blood. System The most common classification system uses:
entradas.texto:
Definition
Blood Type is a biological classification based on substances present in blood.

System
The most common classification system uses:
- F
- S
- X
- XF

Alternate System
Some regions use:
- A
- B
- C

RH Classification
- Blood may include RH- designation
- S (RH-) is notably rare

Compatibility
- Blood transfusions require matching blood types

Species Compatibility
- Humans and Fish-Men share identical blood types
- Cross-species transfusion is biologically possible

Restrictions
- Fish-Man Island law forbids human–fish-man blood sharing
- Originated from human discrimination
- Violations may result in punishment by extremist groups

Notable Event
- Jinbe donated blood to Luffy, defying the law
- King Neptune later denounced the law as unjust

Notes
- FSX system parallels real-world ABO system
- RH classification parallels real-world Rh factor

entradas.resumen: Animal Species are non-humanoid, non-technological creatures found in the world. Exclusions
entradas.texto:
Definition
Animal Species are non-humanoid, non-technological creatures found in the world.

Exclusions
- Humanoids (humans, giants, dwarves, fish-men, mermen, wotans)
- Artificial beings (cyborgs, robots)

Classification
Species are categorized by size and behavior:

- Type A: Large, friendly
- Type B: Small, friendly
- Type C: Large, aggressive
- Type D: Small, aggressive

Notes
- Includes both unique fantasy creatures and real-world animals

entradas.resumen: Sea Beasts are large aquatic mammalian creatures that inhabit the Grand Line, resembling surface animals adapted for underwater life. Distinction
entradas.texto:
Definition
Sea Beasts are large aquatic mammalian creatures that inhabit the Grand Line, resembling surface animals adapted for underwater life.

Distinction
- Separate from Sea Kings (larger, non-mammalian, more aggressive)

Habitat
- Grand Line
- Areas near Fish-Man Island
- Various ocean regions

Appearance
- Based on surface mammals (e.g., cows, cats, boars)
- Features:
  - scales
  - fins and tail fin instead of limbs
  - underwater breathing (gill-like function)
- Size:
  - typically massive (comparable to large sea monsters)
  - some smaller variants exist (near human-scale)

Behavior
- Generally aggressive toward smaller creatures (including humans and merfolk)
- Less hostile and more controllable than Sea Kings
- Can be:
  - intimidated
  - domesticated
  - used for transport (especially near Fish-Man Island)

Intelligence
- Some variants show advanced intelligence
- Capable of forming structured communities with basic systems (e.g., settlements, order)

Variants
Includes multiple forms based on animals:
- Sea Cow
- Sea Cat
- Sea Boar
- Sea Monkey
- Sea Rabbit
- Sea Bear
- Sea Dog
- Others

Special Types

Sea Beast Weapons
- Cyborg-modified Sea Beasts
- Used as controlled weapons under Vegapunk

entradas.resumen: Sea Cows are a type of Sea Beast resembling land-based cattle but possessing aquatic adaptations and carnivorous traits. Appearance
entradas.texto:
Definition
Sea Cows are a type of Sea Beast resembling land-based cattle but possessing aquatic adaptations and carnivorous traits.

Appearance
- Cow-like body structure with horns and patchy coloration
- Fleshy nose and sharp teeth
- Covered in hardened, scale-like skin functioning as armor

Biology
- Possess four stomachs capable of digesting nearly any substance
- Internal bacteria and parasites allow consumption of toxic or venomous material
- Highly resistant to poisoning

Abilities
- Swim speeds up to ~70 km/h
- Fins contain retractable, claw-like bones
- Hardened skin provides strong physical defense

Mobility
- Capable of functioning both in water and on land (unique among Sea Beasts)

Behavior
- Classified as “Type A: Big Friendly”
- Known to attack and overturn ships
- Do not typically consume humans

entradas.resumen: Sea Cats are a type A Sea Beast resembling cats, known for their size, behavior, and cultural significance. Appearance
entradas.texto:
Definition
Sea Cats are a type A Sea Beast resembling cats, known for their size, behavior, and cultural significance.

Appearance
- Cat-like features (pointed ears, slit pupils, paws)
- Possess philtrum-like lips
- Often perform a beckoning gesture when surfacing

Size
- Adults: Comparable to large Sea Beasts
- Juveniles: Slightly larger than Jinbe (~3m+)

Classification
- Type A: “Big Friendly”

Behavior
- May attack ships
- Generally not considered hostile

Cultural Significance
- Revered in Arabasta
- Protected from harm by law/religion

Notable Presence
- Statues located in the Tomb of the Kings
- Some mechanisms (e.g., hidden switches) built into their likeness

entradas.resumen: Sea Boars are a type of Sea Beast resembling wild pigs, characterized by massive bodies and the ability to swallow large prey whole. Classification
entradas.texto:
Definition
Sea Boars are a type of Sea Beast resembling wild pigs, characterized by massive bodies and the ability to swallow large prey whole.

Classification
- Species: Sea Beast
- Type: A ("Big Friendly")

Appearance
- Boar-like head (flat snout, large nostrils, small mane)
- Two upward-curving tusks
- Scaled body with dorsal fin and fan-like tail

Size
- Large Sea Beast class
- Estimated range: ~50–55 meters
- Capable of swallowing multiple human-sized targets

Behavior
- Feeding: Opportunistic, swallows prey whole
- Aggression: Not inherently hostile; accidental predation possible
- Fear Response: Easily intimidated; may regurgitate prey and lose consciousness

Notable Example
- Appears in Hatchan’s Sea-Floor Stroll (Chapter 191)
- Regurgitated Camie and Pappag after being rescued

entradas.resumen: Sea Lions are massive Sea Beasts resembling lions, with manes and faces of a lion and fully flippered limbs. Characteristics
entradas.texto:
Definition
Sea Lions are massive Sea Beasts resembling lions, with manes and faces of a lion and fully flippered limbs.

Characteristics
- All limbs end in flippers (no paws)
- Approximate length: ~55 meters
- Aquatic predator-class Sea Beast

Behavior
- Reside in oceans, often near underwater ruins
- Can act aggressively when provoked or displaced

Usage
- Utilized by pirate crews as mounts or war assets
- Classified among Sea Beast Weapons in some cases

entradas.resumen: Sea Bears are large Sea Beasts resembling bears, with fur and facial features similar to land bears. Size
entradas.texto:
Definition
Sea Bears are large Sea Beasts resembling bears, with fur and facial features similar to land bears.

Size
- Approx. 50m in length

Affiliation
- Previously under control of the New Fish-Man Pirates

Behavior
- Can be aggressive but are responsive to fear-based deterrents (e.g., fire)

Etymology
- Name can also refer to “fur seal” in Chinese, reflecting its appearance

entradas.resumen: Sea Dog is a Sea Beast resembling a dog. Appearance
entradas.texto:
Definition
Sea Dog is a Sea Beast resembling a dog.

Appearance
- Can vary in form (e.g., standard canine, bulldog-like)
- May display human-like traits (facial hair, expressions)

Behavior
- Capable of human-like roles and interaction
- Example: functioning as a police officer

Occurrences
- Seen in underwater towns alongside other Sea Beasts
- Documented example includes a Sea Dog acting in law enforcement

Etymology
- Derived from mythological “sea dog” (dog-like creature with aquatic traits)

entradas.resumen: Sea Kings are massive, carnivorous marine creatures that inhabit the world’s oceans, especially the Calm Belt. Classification
entradas.texto:
Definition
Sea Kings are massive, carnivorous marine creatures that inhabit the world’s oceans, especially the Calm Belt.

Classification
- Type: Sea Monster
- Category: Type "C" (Big Savage)

Habitat
- Found throughout all seas
- Highly concentrated in the Calm Belt surrounding the Grand Line

Size
- Range: 100m+ to over 5000m
- Largest specimens can dwarf islands

Appearance
- Highly variable; no standard form
- Non-mammalian
- Common traits: large scale, often serpentine bodies (not universal)

Forms may resemble:
- fish
- reptiles
- amphibians
- insects
- birds

Behavior
- Extremely aggressive predators
- Attack relentlessly once prey is targeted
- Retreat only against overwhelming force

Intelligence
- Not mindless; capable of thought and awareness
- Can recognize and respect strength

Communication
- Use telepathy (not speech)
- Linked to Poseidon (mermaid with command authority)
- Refer to Poseidon as their "Queen"

Abilities

Physical Power
- Immense strength and durability
- Capable of destroying ships and isolating regions

Perception
- Can detect prey easily
- Can be bypassed using Seastone (temporarily)

Special State
- Berserk mode: eyes become slit-like, aggression increases

Weaknesses / Counters
- Seastone masking
- Overwhelming force

Natural Threats (rare)
- Bananawani (predator)
- Yuda (poisonous)
- Giants / powerful fighters

Human Interaction
- Extremely dangerous; engagement is considered suicidal
- Killing one is viewed as a major feat of strength

Poseidon Link
- A rare mermaid (Poseidon) can command Sea Kings
- Power considered world-level threat (Ancient Weapon tier)
- Loss of control can result in large-scale destruction

Notable Trait
- Some individuals can hear their voices (Voice of All Things)

Comparison
- Larger and more aggressive than Sea Beasts (distinct category)

entradas.resumen: Mottled is a Sea King that responds to Poseidon and is among those who communicate with her. Appearance
entradas.texto:
Classification
- Type: Sea King
- Habitat: Calm Belt
- Affiliation: Poseidon

Definition
Mottled is a Sea King that responds to Poseidon and is among those who communicate with her.

Appearance
- Resembles a massive moray eel
- Light blue dorsal fin
- Black-and-white mottled body pattern

Behavior
- Less aggressive than typical Sea Kings
- Recognizes and obeys Poseidon as its ruler
- Responds to her summons

Intelligence
- Capable of communication with other Sea Kings and Poseidon
- Demonstrates awareness and purpose

Abilities
- Massive size and physical power
- Generates strong force (e.g., sneeze capable of moving ships)

entradas.resumen: Birdy is a Sea King that responds to Poseidon and is among those who communicate with her. Appearance
entradas.texto:
Classification
- Type: Sea King
- Habitat: Calm Belt
- Affiliation: Poseidon

Definition
Birdy is a Sea King that responds to Poseidon and is among those who communicate with her.

Appearance
- Avian-like Sea King
- Yellow beak with purple markings around the eyes
- Pink body with down-like covering
- Long neck and tail
- Wing-like fins and large dorsal fin

Behavior
- Obeys Poseidon as its ruler
- Responds to her summons
- Acts to protect Noah

Intelligence
- Capable of communication with Sea Kings and Poseidon
- Demonstrates awareness and coordination

Abilities
- Massive size and physical strength typical of Sea Kings

entradas.resumen: Googly-Eyed is a Sea King that responds to Poseidon and is among those who communicate with her. Appearance
entradas.texto:
Classification
- Type: Sea King
- Habitat: Calm Belt
- Affiliation: Poseidon

Definition
Googly-Eyed is a Sea King that responds to Poseidon and is among those who communicate with her.

Appearance
- Resembles a giant frog
- Yellow body with pale underbelly
- Prominent dorsal fin
- Large, bulging eyes

Behavior
- Predatory; attacks ships
- Recognizes and obeys Poseidon as its ruler
- Responds to her summons

Intelligence
- Capable of communication with other Sea Kings and Poseidon
- Demonstrates awareness and coordination

Abilities
- Massive size and physical power
- Capable of large leaps from the water

entradas.resumen: Underbite is a Sea King that responds to Poseidon and communicates with her. Appearance
entradas.texto:
Classification
- Type: Sea King
- Habitat: Calm Belt
- Affiliation: Poseidon

Definition
Underbite is a Sea King that responds to Poseidon and communicates with her.

Appearance
- Massive, eel-like body
- Spined upper body
- Prominent underbite with tusks
- Yellow skin with brown spots
- Orange dorsal fin

Behavior
- Obeys Poseidon as its ruler
- Responds to her summons
- Supports preservation of Noah

Intelligence
- Capable of communication with Sea Kings and Poseidon
- Displays awareness and coordinated action

Abilities
- Extreme size and strength
- Can crush large ships with its jaws

entradas.resumen: Plants are biological organisms within the One Piece world. Scope This category includes all plant life found across the One Piece universe. Related
entradas.texto:
Definition
Plants are biological organisms within the One Piece world.

Scope
This category includes all plant life found across the One Piece universe.

Related
- Fungi

entradas.resumen: Treasure Tree Adam is a rare, legendary tree species known for producing the strongest and highest-quality wood in the world. Properties
entradas.texto:
Definition
Treasure Tree Adam is a rare, legendary tree species known for producing the strongest and highest-quality wood in the world.

Properties
- Wood is extremely durable and resistant to physical damage
- Capable of withstanding heavy impacts with minimal wear
- Highly stable over long periods

Value
- Considered one of the most valuable natural materials
- Rare availability makes it difficult to obtain
- Often traded at extremely high prices

Distribution
- Only a few Adam trees exist worldwide
- Typically found in isolated or protected regions

Structure
- Enormous in scale, reaching beyond cloud level
- Width comparable to large landmasses or mountain ranges
- Branch systems can support settlements and large structures

Ecology
- Remains intact even in extreme environments
- Serves as a stable foundation for surrounding civilizations
- Long lifespan spanning thousands of years

Limitations
- Despite durability, still combustible under extreme heat
- Structural damage possible under sustained environmental stress

entradas.resumen: The Tree of Knowledge is a massive, ancient tree located on Ohara that functions as a global library and research center.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Tree of Knowledge is a massive, ancient tree located on Ohara that functions as a global library and research center.

Role
It serves as the central hub for archaeological study and knowledge preservation.

Structure
- Over 5,000 years old
- Contains the oldest known library in the world
- Interior houses vast archives and research spaces

Function

Knowledge Repository
- Stores historical records and texts gathered worldwide over centuries
- Preserves rare and ancient information

Research Center
- Used by archaeologists studying history and Poneglyph-related knowledge
- Supports advanced scholarly research

Blue Planet Model
- Contains a geocentric model of the world
- Depicts the planet with six natural satellites
- Shows planetary tilt (~24–25 degrees)

Significance
- One of the oldest known structures in the world
- Centralized source of global historical knowledge

entradas.resumen: Pop Greens are organic seeds that instantly grow into fully developed plants upon activation.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Pop Greens are organic seeds that instantly grow into fully developed plants upon activation.

Origin
- Native to the Greenstone forest on the Boin Archipelago

Type
- Organic seed-based weapon and tool system

Growth Mechanics
- Rapid growth from seed to full plant in moments
- Activation varies by type (impact, proximity, mid-air, etc.)

Properties
- Each seed produces a different plant with unique effects
- Identifiable by color and type
- Effects include:
  - piercing
  - explosive growth
  - shockwave generation
  - environmental manipulation

Usage
- Can be thrown or launched as ammunition
- Commonly used with slingshot-type weapons
- Integrated into other tools via growth expansion mechanics

Function
- Serves as both offensive and utility-based equipment
- Adaptable for combat, support, and environmental control

entradas.resumen: Amiudake is a highly toxic mushroom species native to the Sakura Kingdom. Property
entradas.texto:
Definition
Amiudake is a highly toxic mushroom species native to the Sakura Kingdom.

Property
- Lethal upon ingestion

Effect
- Causes death approximately one hour after consumption

Classification
- Poisonous fungus

entradas.resumen: Mescal Cactus is a small, round cactus native to the Sandora Desert that induces hallucinations when consumed. Properties
entradas.texto:
Definition
Mescal Cactus is a small, round cactus native to the Sandora Desert that induces hallucinations when consumed.

Properties
- Psychoactive effect on ingestion
- Causes sensory distortion and hallucination-like experiences

Classification
- Desert plant
- Toxic / hallucinogenic organism

Notes
- Name likely derived from mescaline, a real-world psychoactive compound found in some cactus species

entradas.resumen: Giant Jack is a massive beanstalk located at the center of Upper Yard, towering over Skypiea.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Giant Jack is a massive beanstalk located at the center of Upper Yard, towering over Skypiea.

Role
It functions as a vertical structure connecting multiple sky levels and locations.

Structure
- Extends through Upper Yard and the ruins of Shandora
- Pierces multiple cloud layers and island clouds
- Serves as a central landmark due to its scale and height

Connections
- Passes through the area of Shandora
- Extends upward toward higher sky regions
- Supports access between cloud levels

Associated Locations
- God's Shrine (positioned on an upper island cloud along its height)
- Golden Belfry (displaced and located on a nearby cloud)

claves: ヤルキマン・マングローブ
entradas.resumen: Yarukiman Mangrove are massive striped trees that form the Sabaody Archipelago and produce bubble-generating resin.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Yarukiman Mangrove are massive striped trees that form the Sabaody Archipelago and produce bubble-generating resin.

Structure
- Composed of 79 trees forming the entire archipelago
- Roots extend ~10,000 meters to the seafloor
- Root tops remain above water at all times

Unique Trait
Each tree produces a special resin that forms air-filled bubbles through natural biological processes.

Bubble Properties
- Solid exterior (can be stood on)
- Permeable interior (objects and people can pass through)
- Can store or transport items and individuals

Environmental Limitation
- Bubbles only remain stable within the Sabaody environment or underwater
- Outside this range, they collapse immediately

Applications

Transportation
- Bubble coating allows ships to submerge and travel underwater
- Required for routes such as Fish-Man Island

Utility
- Used for storage, movement, and structural platforms

Equipment
- Can function as wearable air coverings due to permeability

Location
- Exclusive to Sabaody Archipelago
- No known growth elsewhere

entradas.resumen: Stomach Barons are massive carnivorous seaborne plants that form the island chains of the Boin Archipelago.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Stomach Barons are massive carnivorous seaborne plants that form the island chains of the Boin Archipelago.

Nature
- Living organisms that resemble islands due to their immense size
- Support forests and ecosystems on their surface

Structure
- Central “mouth” located at the core of the island
- Outer landmass functions as the body

Feeding Mechanism
- Produce highly nutritious, food-like vegetation
- Lure prey to the center of the island
- Consume anything that enters the “mouth”

Prey
- Marine life (including large sea creatures)
- Land-based organisms attracted by the food source

entradas.resumen: Weather Balls are specialized weather-manipulating constructs from Weatheria that contain and reproduce atmospheric phenomena.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Weather Balls are specialized weather-manipulating constructs from Weatheria that contain and reproduce atmospheric phenomena.

Origin
- Grown in Weather Patches
- Developed as a core technological system of Weatheria

Structure
- Spherical, similar to snow globes
- Contain miniature weather systems within

Function

1. Weather Storage
- Can store condensed atmospheric elements (e.g., clouds)

2. Weather Combination
- Multiple Weather Balls can merge their contents
- Produces larger, stable weather formations

3. Weather Output
- Stored phenomena can be released or activated
- Capable of generating effects such as lightning

Capabilities
- Scalable weather manipulation (small → large systems)
- Controlled deployment of atmospheric effects
- Potential for wide-area environmental impact

Risk
- Improper use can cause large-scale atmospheric disruption

entradas.resumen: Sapphire Scales is a rare, fatal disease that causes sapphire-like stones to form on the skin. Characteristics
entradas.texto:
Definition
Sapphire Scales is a rare, fatal disease that causes sapphire-like stones to form on the skin.

Characteristics
- Progressive growth of crystalline formations across the body
- Triggered and accelerated by exposure to natural light (sunlight or moonlight)
- Growth can be slowed by avoiding light but cannot be stopped entirely

Progression
- Stones gradually spread until the body is fully covered
- Leads to death within a few years

Nature
- Extremely rare and poorly documented
- Not contagious
- Likely hereditary

Medical Knowledge
- Known by very few specialists due to rarity

Treatment
- Only known method: stem cell transplantation

entradas.resumen: Five-Day Disease is a rare, fatal zoonotic illness caused by the bite of a Kestia tick. Source
entradas.texto:
Definition
Five-Day Disease is a rare, fatal zoonotic illness caused by the bite of a Kestia tick.

Source
- Kestia: a prehistoric tick species found in tropical, ancient-fauna environments

Transmission
- Triggered by a Kestia bite
- Not known to spread between humans

Effects
- Causes rapid systemic failure leading to death within five days

Symptoms
- Early: fatigue, sweating
- Progression: high fever, headache, loss of consciousness
- Advanced: escalating fever and organ failure (heart, brain, full body)

Physical Mark
- Distinct bite pattern of multiple circles surrounding a central mark

Cure
- Requires specialized medical treatment
- Recovery time varies depending on treatment effectiveness

entradas.resumen: Amber Lead is a rare white mineral found exclusively in Flevance, valued for its appearance and industrial use. Properties
entradas.texto:
Definition
Amber Lead is a rare white mineral found exclusively in Flevance, valued for its appearance and industrial use.

Properties
- Naturally occurring white ore
- Gives soil and plants a white coloration
- Produces a glossy white coating when processed

Usage
- Applied in manufacturing and decoration

Examples
- paint
- pottery
- cosmetics
- weapon finishes

Economic Role
- Highly valuable resource
- Primary driver of Flevance’s economic prosperity
- Enabled large-scale mining and trade

Toxicity
- Harmless while undisturbed underground
- Becomes toxic when extracted and handled
- Gradually accumulates in the body over time

Effect Profile
- Internal damage progression is slow and initially undetectable
- Long-term exposure leads to severe biological deterioration

Associated Condition

Amber Lead Syndrome
- Non-contagious, hereditary condition caused by accumulation of Amber Lead

Transmission
- Passed through bloodlines across generations

Progression
- Each generation experiences reduced lifespan
- Effects manifest earlier over time

Late-Stage Symptoms
- White skin blotches
- Hair discoloration (white)
- Chronic internal pain

Treatment
- No conventional medical treatment
- Can be cured through specialized abilities capable of removing or altering the substance

entradas.resumen: Love Sickness is a psychosomatic disease affecting Kuja empresses, triggered by intense romantic attachment.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Love Sickness is a psychosomatic disease affecting Kuja empresses, triggered by intense romantic attachment.

Origin
- Occurs within the Kuja leadership lineage
- Associated specifically with empress-level individuals

Cause
- Emotional suppression of romantic feelings
- Internal conflict between duty and personal attachment

Nature
- Emotion-driven condition linked to the heart and psyche
- Functions as an extreme amplification of love-related stress

Symptoms
- Severe chest pain and emotional distress
- Physical weakening over time
- Obsessive focus on the loved individual
- Distorted perception and impaired judgment

Behavioral Effects
- Heightened emotional instability
- Reduced awareness of surroundings
- Actions become centered entirely around the loved individual

Condition State
- Symptoms intensify when emotions are denied
- Stability improves when emotions are acknowledged

Survival Condition
- Requires acceptance of feelings
- Pursuit or alignment with the loved individual stabilizes the condition

entradas.resumen: Ice Oni is an artificial virus weapon that infects targets through chilled gas and rapidly transforms them into berserk, ice-covered oni-like entities.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Ice Oni is an artificial virus weapon that infects targets through chilled gas and rapidly transforms them into berserk, ice-covered oni-like entities.

Type
- Biological Weapon
- Viral Infection

Transmission
- Spreads through physical contact
- Can be transmitted via bodily exposure (e.g., biting)
- Requires avoiding direct contact to prevent infection

Infection Process
- Virus enters the body through cold-based medium
- Rapidly reproduces within the host
- Freezing effect spreads across the body

Effects

Physical Transformation
- Body covered in ice
- Manifestation of oni traits:
  - horns
  - fangs
  - claws

Stat Enhancement
- Increased strength
- Increased durability
- Enhanced muscle mass
- High endurance (zombie-like resilience)

Behavioral Effects
- Loss of reasoning
- Enters berserk state
- Attacks allies and enemies indiscriminately

Limitations
- Causes extreme strain on the body
- Leads to death after a short duration (~1 hour)

Immunities
- Ineffective on targets without biological tissue (e.g., no skin or blood)

Countermeasures

Antibody
- Direct cure requires a specific antibody to neutralize the virus

Countervirus
- Can be distributed in airborne form to treat multiple targets simultaneously

Heat Suppression
- External heat slows or halts viral progression
- Elevated body temperature prevents further spread temporarily

entradas.resumen: Mummy is an artificial virus weapon that infects targets through contact and induces extreme physical deterioration while keeping the host alive.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Mummy is an artificial virus weapon that infects targets through contact and induces extreme physical deterioration while keeping the host alive.

Type
- Biological Weapon
- Viral Infection

Transmission
- Spreads through direct contact with infected individuals
- Can be applied via weaponized delivery systems (projectiles)

Infection Process
- Virus enters through the skin
- Causes intense fever and internal bleeding
- Toxic substance spreads across the body
- Final stage dries and shrivels the body (mummification)

Effects

Physical Effects
- High fever
- Bleeding
- Body covered in toxic substance
- Skin becomes dry and shriveled

Condition State
- Victim remains alive
- Enters a zombie-like state
- Experiences continuous pain

Contagion
- Highly infectious
- Immediate transmission upon contact

Delivery Methods
- Projectile-based application (small-scale doses)
- High-volume discharge (large-scale infection)

Countermeasures
- Can be cured with proper medical treatment
- Not highly resistant to antidote development

entradas.resumen: Humans are the dominant race, characterized by high population, widespread distribution, and adaptability. Distribution
entradas.texto:
Definition
Humans are the dominant race, characterized by high population, widespread distribution, and adaptability.

Distribution
- Found across most islands, including the Grand Line
- Present in the highest numbers among all races

Characteristics
- Highly adaptable and technologically capable
- Wide variation in size, appearance, and physical traits
- Can develop unique or abnormal features

Biology
- Compatible blood types with fish-men and merfolk
- Significant variation in growth, size, and proportions
- Heredity is inconsistent and not strictly defined

Hybrids
Humans can reproduce with other races.

Traits
- Offspring inherit non-human features
- Traits may persist across generations

Inter-Species Relations
- Frequent conflict and discrimination between races
- Humans both experience and enforce racism
- Slave trade often targets non-human races due to higher value

Exceptions
- Some regions show peaceful coexistence
- Cross-race acceptance varies by culture

Societal Role
- Primary population driving global systems (economy, politics, technology)
- Most organized and widespread race

Strength
- Average humans are physically weaker than many races
- Strength is compensated through:
  - training
  - weapons
  - martial arts
  - intelligence

Capabilities
- Can achieve superhuman levels through training
- Able to learn advanced techniques (e.g., Fish-Man Karate)
- Utilize Devil Fruits, science, and technology

Specialization
- High intellectual potential (science, engineering, strategy)
- Capable of genetic modification and cybernetic enhancement

Variation
- Size ranges from average to extremely large individuals
- Exceptional individuals can rival or surpass stronger races

entradas.resumen: The Kumate Tribe is a human tribe known for cannibalistic practices.
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Kumate Tribe is a human tribe known for cannibalistic practices.

Origin
- Located in East Blue
- Homeland: Kumate Island

Population
- Small group (approximately 30–50 members)

Traits
- All members are human
- Share similar facial features (notably identical nose shape/color)
- Uniform appearance and styling across members

Appearance
- Hair: mostly shaved with a long top ponytail and short back hair
- Clothing:
  - striped shirt
  - torn skirt
  - grass necklace
  - long scarf
  - sandals
- Tribal symbol marked on hands

Culture
- Cannibalism is a defining practice
- Strong visual and cultural uniformity among members

Symbol
- Bear paw design (name origin)
- Also represents figures within a cooking pot (cultural meaning)

entradas.resumen: The Longarm Tribe is a human-like race distinguished by elongated arms with two elbow joints. Features
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Longarm Tribe is a human-like race distinguished by elongated arms with two elbow joints.

Features
- Double-jointed arms (two elbows per arm)
- Extended reach and flexibility
- Otherwise similar in appearance to humans

Homeland
- Kenzan Island

Biology
- Extra joint structure defines the race
- Upper and lower elbows are distinct (commonly differentiated)
- Physiology otherwise matches humans

Hybrids
- Can reproduce with humans and other tribes
- Known cross with Longleg Tribe → Longlimb Humans

Traits
- Hybrid offspring retain extended arm structure
- Non-human traits remain consistent across generations

Inter-Species Relations
- Subject to discrimination based on physical traits
- High value in slave trade markets

Notable Relations
- Long-standing tension with Longleg Tribe
- Capable of coexistence with other races in mixed societies

Combat Style
- Arm structure enables extended range and unpredictable attacks
- Extra joint allows compression and release for increased striking force

entradas.resumen: The Longleg Tribe is a race characterized by extremely elongated legs and tall stature. Features
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Longleg Tribe is a race characterized by extremely elongated legs and tall stature.

Features
- Legs significantly longer than torso
- Height greatly exceeds average humans (below giants)

Biology
- Physiology largely similar to humans aside from leg proportions
- Possess a single joint structure in their extended legs

Hybrids
Longlegs can reproduce with other races.

Types
- Human hybrids
- Longarm hybrids (Longlimb)

Traits
- Hybrids retain longleg physical structure and abilities

Strength
- Exceptional leg strength and striking power
- Legs function as primary combat tools
- Attacks are fast, long-range, and high-impact

Combat Traits
- Fighting style centers around leg usage
- Speed makes targeting legs difficult
- Legs are the main vulnerability if struck

Equipment
- Weapons are often scaled to match extended leg proportions

Inter-Species Relations
- Noted long-term rivalry with Longarm Tribe
- Also capable of coexistence depending on environment

Beliefs
- Cultural emphasis on leg appearance and pride
- Legs are often displayed and decorated

entradas.resumen: Longlimb Humans are hybrids between the Longarm Tribe and the Longleg Tribe. Traits
entradas.texto:
Definition
Longlimb Humans are hybrids between the Longarm Tribe and the Longleg Tribe.

Traits
- Extended limbs (arms and legs)
- Combination of both parent tribe characteristics

Arm Structure
- Longarms: double-jointed arms

Leg Structure
- Longlegs: elongated legs

Biology
- Hybrid inheritance combines traits from both lineages
- Likely retain full functionality of both limb types

Classification
- Hybrid Race
- Subtype of Human lineage

entradas.resumen: The Snakeneck Tribe is a humanoid race distinguished by elongated neck structures. Traits
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Snakeneck Tribe is a humanoid race distinguished by elongated neck structures.

Traits
- Significantly extended neck length compared to humans
- Increased overall height due to neck extension
- Neck size and width vary between individuals
- Often possess slender, elongated body proportions

Physical Variation
- Body shape ranges from slender to standard humanoid builds
- Neck proportions differ in length and thickness
- Hybrids may display partial trait inheritance

Cultural Features
- Neck adornment is common (rings, markings, or similar decorations)

Hybrids
- Can interbreed with humans
- Offspring inherit elongated neck traits to varying degrees

Value
- Classified as a high-value race in the slave market

entradas.resumen: The Three-Eye Tribe is a rare humanoid race distinguished by a third eye located on the forehead. Features
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Three-Eye Tribe is a rare humanoid race distinguished by a third eye located on the forehead.

Features
- Three eyes (two standard + one centered on the forehead)
- Otherwise physically similar to humans

Rarity
- Extremely rare population
- Exists in very limited numbers

Biology
- Possess a latent ability tied to the third eye
- Awakening state enhances perception beyond normal senses

Awakening
- True awakening of the third eye grants access to higher-level perception
- Associated with the ability to interpret otherwise incomprehensible information

Special Ability

Voice of All Things
- Enables perception and understanding of hidden or ancient information
- Allows interpretation of encoded or lost languages (e.g., Poneglyph-like systems)

Limitations
- Awakening conditions are unknown
- Ability may not fully manifest in non-pure lineage

Value
- Highly valuable due to their rare perceptual abilities
- Sought after for their potential to access restricted or ancient knowledge

entradas.resumen: The Tontatta Tribe are a dwarf race native to Tontatta Kingdom on Green Bit. Characteristics
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Tontatta Tribe are a dwarf race native to Tontatta Kingdom on Green Bit.

Characteristics
- Extremely small in size
- Very strong for their size
- Highly gullible
- Skilled gardeners

Appearance
- Small enough to fit in a person’s palm
- Often have pointy noses
- Possess furry tails

Homeland
- Tontatta Kingdom
- Located on Green Bit

Society
- Organized under their own kingdom and royal leadership
- Maintain a tribal community structure

Strength
- Possess great physical strength despite their size
- Capable of overpowering ordinary humans
- Use their own fighting style, Tontatta Combat

Culture
- Deep connection to nature and cultivation
- Known for gardening and maintaining lush plant life

entradas.resumen: The Kuja are an all-female human tribe native to Amazon Lily. Homeland
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Kuja are an all-female human tribe native to Amazon Lily.

Homeland
- Amazon Lily

Leadership
- Ruled by the tribe’s empress
- Boa Hancock is the current ruler

Core Traits
- Entirely female population
- Highly isolated from the outside world
- Historically unfamiliar with men due to that isolation

Biology
- Biologically human
- Women who leave the island may return pregnant
- Children born to the tribe are always female
- Empresses may suffer from Love Sickness, a fatal condition caused by suppressed love

Culture
- Warrior society
- Strength is treated as beauty and status
- The empress is typically the strongest and most admired warrior
- Traditional laws historically barred men from entering the island

Isolation
- Protected by the Calm Belt and Sea Kings
- Long-term isolation limited their knowledge of men and much of the outside world
- Their security weakened as Seastone travel technology improved

Combat Ability
- Raised as warriors from youth
- Skilled in combat, hunting, labor, and survival work
- Capable of defending themselves without outside support

Haki
- Strong natural proficiency with Haki
- Commonly use Armament Haki
- Can coat arrows and attacks with Haki

Snake Weapons
The Kuja use companion snakes as multipurpose weapons and tools.

Functions
- bows
- staffs
- restraints
- support tools
- elevated platforms

Beliefs
- Strength defines worth
- Weakness, greed, and foolishness are looked down on
- Many cultural views are shaped by isolation and limited knowledge of men

entradas.resumen: World Nobles are descendants of the World Government’s founders who possess absolute political authority.
entradas.texto:
Classification
A human-derived ruling class that identifies itself as separate from standard humanity.

Definition
World Nobles are descendants of the World Government’s founders who possess absolute political authority.

Nature
- Biologically human
- Socially self-defined as superior to all races

Ideology
- View themselves as gods
- Regard all others as inferior beings
- Treat other races as property or slaves

Lifestyle
- Live in isolation within Mary Geoise
- Avoid contact with the outside world

Practices
- Wear protective suits supplying purified air when outside
- Maintain strict separation from "lower" populations

Status
- Highest social and political class in the world
- Operate above all standard laws

entradas.resumen: The Torino Tribe are a human sub-group native to the Torino Kingdom. Classification
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Torino Tribe are a human sub-group native to the Torino Kingdom.

Classification
- Human Sub-Race / Tribe

Origin
- Torino Kingdom (South Blue)

Characteristics
- Short stature (~1.2 meters)
- Rotund body type

Lifestyle
- Hunter-gatherer society
- Primitive appearance and living style

Capabilities
- Highly advanced in medicine
- Maintain a medical knowledge library
- Develop specialized weapons (e.g., missile-like spears)

History
- Previously in conflict with Goayu Birds (dominant island species)
- Conflict ended through external mediation

entradas.resumen: Fish-Men are a humanoid sea-dwelling race with fish-like traits and human-like bodies. Features
entradas.texto:
Definition
Fish-Men are a humanoid sea-dwelling race with fish-like traits and human-like bodies.

Features
- Fish-like physical traits
- Human legs
- Gills
- Often webbed hands and feet
- May possess species-specific traits or extra limbs

Homeland
- Fish-Man Island

Classification
- One of the two primary races that inhabit and rule the seas
- Classified as Type C creatures

Biology
- Amphibious
- Breathe underwater with gills and on land with lungs
- Give birth to live young
- Share blood compatibility with humans and merfolk

Variation
- Great diversity in size, appearance, and subspecies
- Each Fish-Man is typically based on a specific aquatic species
- Traits vary by species

Examples of Species Traits
- Shark: strong jaws, sharp teeth
- Cephalopod: tentacles, ink, camouflage
- Crustacean: shell, pincers
- Walrus: tusks

Hybrids
Fish-Men can reproduce with:
- Humans
- Merfolk
- Giants

Hybrid Traits
- Offspring may inherit fish-man biology or visible species traits
- Children of Fish-Man and Merfolk unions may be either race

Inter-Species Relations
- Generally close to merfolk
- Historically conflicted with humans due to oppression, slavery, and racism
- Some Fish-Men view humans as inferior
- Others support coexistence and equality

Social Conditions
- Frequently targeted by discrimination and slavery
- Slave value is higher than humans

Strength
- Naturally far stronger than normal humans
- Especially powerful underwater
- Excellent swimmers and aquatic fighters
- Can breathe underwater and cannot drown under normal conditions

Combat Ability
- Possess strong natural physical ability
- Can use Fish-Man Karate
- Can manipulate water in combat
- Species traits can grant additional combat advantages

Limits
- Devil Fruit users lose the ability to swim
- Still retain underwater breathing, but cannot move properly in water

Special Abilities
- Can communicate with some sea creatures
- Some can influence or provoke large marine animals
- Strong individuals can affect currents and water flow

Beliefs
- Some Fish-Men believe in superiority over humans
- These beliefs often come from long histories of persecution
- Not all Fish-Men share these views

Cultural Traits
- Physical diversity is normalized within their culture due to ancestral trait variation

claves: Mixed Relations Between Humans and Fish-Men
entradas.resumen: Relations Merfolk
entradas.texto:
Relations

Merfolk
- Generally cooperative and closely related
- Occasional exploitation due to merfolk traits

Humans
- Historically hostile relationship
- Fish-Men often view humans as weaker and oppressive
- Humans frequently view Fish-Men as inferior or non-human

Conflict Causes
- Slavery and discrimination
- Long-term racial prejudice from both sides
- Misclassification of Fish-Men as animals

Variation
- Not all Fish-Men share hostile views
- Some support coexistence and equality

Consequences
- Cycles of retaliation and violence
- Reinforcement of negative stereotypes on both sides

Coexistence
- Exists in certain regions (e.g., mixed societies)
- Cultural acceptance varies by location

Hybrids
- Interbreeding between Fish-Men and humans occurs
- Hybrids appear despite social tensions

Social Status
- High slave market value compared to humans

entradas.resumen: Fish-Men are amphibious humanoids with both fish-like and mammalian traits. Respiration
entradas.texto:
Nature
Fish-Men are amphibious humanoids with both fish-like and mammalian traits.

Respiration
- Use gills underwater and lungs on land
- Gills must remain unobstructed in water to function

Physiology
- Classified as mammals
- Give birth to live young
- Capable of human speech

Genetics
- Traits are not strictly inherited from parents
- Features may originate from distant ancestors
- High variation in appearance and subspecies

Species Variation
- Based on aquatic species (e.g., shark, cephalopod, crustacean)
- Physical traits reflect species type
- Size ranges from normal to extremely large

Compatibility
- Share blood types with humans and merfolk
- Blood transfusions are possible if matched

Cross-Traits
- Some Fish-Men display abilities similar to merfolk
- Some can communicate with marine animals

Diet
- Carnivorous; may consume fish

entradas.resumen: Merfolk are one of the two main humanoid sea-dwelling races, alongside fish-men. Features
entradas.texto:
Definition
Merfolk are one of the two main humanoid sea-dwelling races, alongside fish-men.

Features
- Human upper body
- Aquatic lower body
- Based on fish or other sea creatures

Homeland
- Fish-Man Island

Sexual Dimorphism
- Mermaids: generally more human in appearance
- Mermen: often retain more aquatic features

Biology
- Can interbreed with humans and fish-men
- Share compatible blood types with humans and fish-men
- Offspring race may vary by inheritance
- Traits can reappear from distant ancestors

Female Development
- A mermaid’s tail splits at age 30, allowing movement on land
- Split tails can merge again while swimming

Variation
- Wide differences in size, appearance, and species traits
- Can possess traits of many aquatic lifeforms, not only standard fish

Diet
- Primarily non-meat based, aside from shellfish

Inter-Species Relations
- Generally more peaceful than fish-men
- Often secretive and friendly toward sea life
- Subject to discrimination, slavery, and commodification by humans
- Some regions allow peaceful coexistence with other races

Capabilities
- Fastest swimmers in the sea
- Can communicate with fish
- Some can manipulate water through Merman Combat
- Can use Haki

Strength
- Physical ability varies by individual
- Greater strength lies in swimming ability, aquatic mobility, communication with sea life, and water-based combat

Beliefs
- Less likely to judge appearance due to ancestral trait variation
- Tend to view physical difference with less prejudice than humans

entradas.resumen: Wotans are a hybrid race formed from giants and fish-men. Classification
entradas.texto:
Definition
Wotans are a hybrid race formed from giants and fish-men.

Classification
- Giant / Fish-Man hybrid

Characteristics
- Large size (smaller than full giants, larger than humans)
- Possess both giant strength and fish-man traits

Biology
- Inherit fish-man abilities, including enhanced strength and underwater capability
- Display fewer visible fish-man features (e.g., reduced gills or webbing)

Scale
- Below full giants in size
- Comparable to oversized human variants

entradas.resumen: Sky Island Residents are winged humanoid tribes descended from the Moon People, inhabiting the Sky Islands.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Sky Island Residents are winged humanoid tribes descended from the Moon People, inhabiting the Sky Islands.

Origin
- Descended from lunar civilization (Moon People)
- Migrated to the Blue Planet
- Split into distinct tribes

Core Trait
- Possess wings on their backs (varies by tribe)

Tribes

Birkans
- Originated from Birka
- Wing orientation: downward
- Notable for varied, sometimes animal-like features
- Strong affinity for advanced abilities (e.g., enhanced perception)

Shandia
- Originated from Shandora (Jaya)
- Wing structure similar to Skypieans
- Known for warrior culture and combat specialization

Skypieans
- Originated from Skypiea
- Most widespread population
- Wings: shorter, rounded
- Distinctive antenna-like hairstyles
- Culture values "vearth" (soil) as a vital resource

Shared Characteristics
- Common lunar ancestry
- Similar base physiology with tribal variation
- Capable of advanced sensory abilities (e.g., mantra/observation)

Society
- Organized into separate tribal groups
- Each tribe maintains distinct identity and culture

Environment
- Reside in Sky Islands (high-altitude regions)
- Limited interaction with surface populations

entradas.resumen: Skypieans are a Sky Island tribe residing on Angel Island and surrounding regions. Alternate Term
entradas.texto:
Definition
Skypieans are a Sky Island tribe residing on Angel Island and surrounding regions.

Alternate Term
- Sky People

Traits
- Small wings angled upward
- Antenna-like hairstyles (natural ad / “nat ad”)

Culture
- Generally peaceful and community-oriented
- Maintain a comfort-focused lifestyle
- Use “Heso” as a common greeting gesture

Technology
- Skilled in creating and using Dial-based devices
- Apply Dials for transport, utilities, and daily life

Beliefs
- Revere “Vearth” (soil) as a sacred resource
- Use “God” as a governmental title rather than a literal deity

entradas.resumen: Shandia are a Sky Island tribe known for their warrior-based culture and strong ancestral identity.
entradas.texto:
Definition
Shandia are a Sky Island tribe known for their warrior-based culture and strong ancestral identity.

Origin
- Originally settled on Jaya (Blue Sea)
- Later inhabit Sky Islands

Traits
- Wings larger than Skypieans, angled upward
- Physically oriented toward combat and endurance

Culture
- Warrior-centric society valuing strength and heritage
- Emphasis on ancestral reverence
- Retain elements of traditional practices and identity

Society
- Highly combat-capable population
- Structured around warriors and defense roles

Adaptation
- Integrated some modern practices and lifestyle elements from other Sky Island cultures

entradas.resumen: Birkans are a Sky Island tribe originating from the island of Birka. Traits
entradas.texto:
Definition
Birkans are a Sky Island tribe originating from the island of Birka.

Traits
- Large wings angled downward (distinct from other sky tribes)
- Some individuals display animal-like features (horns, ear-like growths)

Appearance
- Wide physical variation within the population
- Common use of simple robes or ceremonial attire

Culture
- Structured, discipline-oriented society
- Strong alignment with religious or ceremonial practices
- Emphasis on power, hierarchy, and devotion-based systems

Beliefs
- Elevated reverence for “Vearth” (soil) as a sacred concept

Society
- Organized with clear rank distinctions
- Higher-ranking individuals display greater autonomy and variation in appearance and attire

entradas.resumen: The Mink Tribe is a race of furry mammalian humanoids, also known as the Warrior Beast Tribe. Homeland
entradas.texto:
Definition
The Mink Tribe is a race of furry mammalian humanoids, also known as the Warrior Beast Tribe.

Homeland
- Primarily native to Zou
- Most live in the Mokomo Dukedom
- Largely isolated from human civilization for around 1,000 years

Characteristics
- Humanoids with traits based on mammalian animals
- Bodies are covered in fur, which they consider a point of pride
- Each mink resembles a specific animal species
- Males tend to appear more beast-like
- Females tend to appear more human-like
- Possess humanoid hands and feet, though some retain paw traits

Biology
- Species traits are not strictly hereditary
- Offspring may resemble different mammalian lineages within their ancestry
- All minks are natural-born warriors regardless of age
- Maintain strong physical ability even in old age
- Possess fast recovery and strong metabolism
- Thick fur makes them vulnerable to heat

Inter-Species Relations
- Often call humans “Lesser Minks” due to viewing them as sparsely furred relatives
- Do not inherently hate humans
- Some admire, trust, or live among them
- Welcoming to guests despite their isolationist reputation
- Highly loyal to allies and willing to sacrifice themselves to protect them
- Valued heavily in the slave trade

Strength
- Physically superior to normal humans
- Naturally agile, strong, and stealth-capable
- Skilled fighters from birth
- Capable of high-level combat even without formal training

Electro
Definition
Electro is the natural ability of all minks to generate and discharge electricity.

Rule
Lack of Electro indicates an animal-like being is not a mink.

Sulong
Definition
Sulong is the mink tribe’s full-moon transformation, considered their true form.

Trigger
- Activated by looking directly at the full moon

Beliefs and Culture
- Fur is a major part of mink identity
- They appear to revere deities
- Recognize internal species distinctions within the tribe
- Avoid eating animals with fur
- Freely eat fish, reptiles, amphibians, and non-furred animals

Customs
- “Garchu” is used as both greeting and thanks
- Show affection through “minkship,” including cuddling, licking, nibbling, and exchanging clothes
- Tend to openly follow instincts tied to their animal nature

Speech
- Some use distinctive verbal patterns tied to gender
- This trait may fade in minks who live away from Zou

entradas.resumen: Sulong is a temporary full-moon transformation of the Mink Tribe that drastically enhances physical abilities and Electro, considered their true form. Activation
entradas.texto:
Definition
Sulong is a temporary full-moon transformation of the Mink Tribe that drastically enhances physical abilities and Electro, considered their true form.

Activation
- Triggered by directly viewing the full moon
- Requires continuous exposure during transformation
- Can be prevented if moonlight is obstructed

Transformation Effects
- Fur turns pure white and grows significantly
- Body size increases
- Eyes change (red coloration)
- Constant electrical discharge (Electro)

Enhancements
- Massive increase in strength, speed, and agility
- Electro output becomes significantly stronger
- Instincts become heightened and more primal
- Combat capability increases exponentially

Control
- Untrained users lose rationality and enter a berserk state
- Trained users can retain awareness and control

Limitations
- Extremely short duration (minutes)
- Heavy physical strain on the body
- Overuse leads to exhaustion or death

Deactivation
- Occurs when:
  - moonlight is blocked
  - time limit is reached
  - user is incapacitated

Weaknesses
- Requires full moon (limited availability)
- Requires direct line of sight to the moon
- Transformation time is not instant (can be interrupted)
- Does not significantly increase durability

Role
- Considered the Mink Tribe’s primary combat trump card
- Used for high-level or decisive battles

entradas.resumen: Electro is a natural bio-electric ability used by the Mink Tribe to generate and channel electricity. Users
entradas.texto:
Definition
Electro is a natural bio-electric ability used by the Mink Tribe to generate and channel electricity.

Users
- Mink Tribe (all members, regardless of age)

Function
- Electricity is produced within the body
- Can be discharged through physical contact
- Can be channeled through weapons

Effects
- Enhances attack power
- Causes electric burns
- Can paralyze or incapacitate targets

Amplification
- Significantly strengthened in Sulong form
- May emit continuous electrical output during transformation

Rule
- All minks possess Electro
- Lack of Electro indicates the user is not a mink

Application
- Techniques vary per individual
- Usage style is flexible and adaptable in combat

entradas.resumen: Lunarians are a near-extinct race from the Red Line capable of generating and controlling fire. Status
entradas.texto:
Definition
Lunarians are a near-extinct race from the Red Line capable of generating and controlling fire.

Status
- Considered extinct
- Only one confirmed natural survivor
- Few possible descendants remain

Origin
- Formerly lived on top of the Red Line
- Once associated with a “Land of Gods”

Characteristics
- Brown skin
- White hair
- Large black wings
- Flame burning on upper back

Biology
- Can ignite and manipulate fire for combat
- Able to shape, project, and weaponize flames
- Possess extreme durability and vitality
- Capable of surviving in nearly any environment
- Wings allow natural flight

Flame Mechanic
- Active flame grants high durability
- Flame extinguishing reduces durability
- Loss of durability is exchanged for increased speed
- Trigger conditions for flame state are not fully defined

Strength
- Fire-based attacks (projectiles, constructs, enhanced strikes)
- Can produce large-scale or explosive outputs
- Physical resilience borders on invulnerability
- Capable of enduring extreme damage without injury

Weakness
- Reduced durability when flame is inactive
- Standard Devil Fruit weaknesses apply if applicable

Inter-Species Relations
- Historically regarded as “gods”
- Targeted and hunted by the World Government
- High-value bounty placed on information about them
- Absent from major multi-race societies (e.g., Totto Land)

Legacy
- Genetic material used to create Seraphim
- Seraphim inherit:
  - lunarian traits (wings, flame, durability)
  - enhanced survivability

entradas.resumen: Ancient Giants are a distinct giant subtype known for extreme size and monstrous features. Traits
entradas.texto:
Giants are a humanoid race defined by immense size, making them the largest known natural race in the world.

Homeland
- Found on multiple islands
- Most famously associated with Elbaph

Characteristics
- Vastly larger than humans and most other races
- Normal giants are at least 12 meters tall
- Most adults are far taller than even unusually large humans
- Possess exaggerated proportions compared to humans

Subgroups
- Elbaph Giants
- Ancient Giants
- Other giant tribes

Ancient Giants
Definition
Ancient Giants are a distinct giant subtype known for extreme size and monstrous features.

Traits
- Far larger than normal giants
- Often possess horns and sharp teeth
- May have unusual skin colors
- Resemble oni or ogre-like beings

Status
- Pure-blooded ancient giants are believed extinct
- Some modern giants retain traces of their blood

Biology
- Lifespan is far longer than humans
- Age and mature more slowly
- Reach adulthood much later than humans
- Remain physically massive throughout all life stages
- Physical decline becomes more severe in advanced age

Hybrids
Giants can interbreed with other races.

Gigantification
Definition
Gigantification is the artificial attempt to recreate giant size through science.

Inter-Species Relations
- Generally able to coexist with other races
- Often respected or feared due to their size and strength
- Highly valued in the slave trade

Strength
- Naturally possess overwhelming physical power
- Far stronger and more durable than ordinary humans
- Make exceptional warriors, guards, and soldiers
- Even untrained giants are dangerous in combat

Combat Traits
- Extreme strength
- High durability
- Large-scale destructive power
- Massive reach and physical dominance

Relative Power
- Larger giants generally possess greater physical advantage
- Most non-giants require strategy, teamwork, or special powers to defeat them

Weaknesses
- Large size makes them easier to target
- Require space to move effectively
- Can be exploited through tactics or coordination

Relation to Other Powers
- Some giants can use Haki
- Some giants use Devil Fruits
- External powers can offset a non-giant’s physical disadvantage against them

Beliefs
- Many Elbaph giants view battle as sacred
- Dying in battle is often considered honorable
- Dishonorable death is viewed with contempt
- Some giants reject Elbaph’s battle-centered worldview
- Giants also observe long-standing spiritual and cultural traditions

Culture
